88.s:
īśvara uvāca
sandhānaṃ śāntyatītāyāḥ śāntyā sārdhaṃ viśuddhayā /
kurvīta pūrvavattatra tattvavarṇādi tad yathā //
oṃ hīṃ kṣauṃ hauṃ hāṃ iti sandhānāni
88.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
सन्धानं शान्त्यतीतायाः शान्त्या सार्धं विशुद्धया /
कुर्वीत पूर्ववत्तत्र तत्त्ववर्णादि तद् यथा //
ओं हीं क्षौं हौं हां इति सन्धानानि
88.m:
The Lord said: / One should perform the junction of Śāntyatītā together with the purified Śānti / as before; there the principles, phonemes, and so forth are as follows:
"Oṃ hīṃ kṣauṃ hauṃ hāṃ"—these are the junctions.

88.s:
ubhau śaktiśivau tattve bhuvanāṣṭakasiddhikaṃ /
dīpakaṃ rocikañcaiva mocakaṃ cordhvagāmi ca //
88.d:
उभौ शक्तिशिवौ तत्त्वे भुवनाष्टकसिद्धिकं /
दीपकं रोचिकञ्चैव मोचकं चोर्ध्वगामि च //
88.m: Both Śakti and Śiva are the principles; the eight worlds to be attained are: / Dīpaka, Rocika, Mocaka, Ūrdhvagāmin,

88.s:
vyomarūpamanāthañca syādanāśritanaṣṭamaṃ /
oṅkārapadamīśāne mantro varṇāś ca ṣoḍaśa //
88.d:
व्योमरूपमनाथञ्च स्यादनाश्रितनष्टमं /
ओङ्कारपदमीशाने मन्त्रो वर्णाश् च षोडश //
88.m: Vyomarūpa, Anātha, and Anāśrita is the eighth; / the word is the Oṅkāra in the Īśāna [direction]; the mantra and sixteen phonemes:

88.s:
akārādivisargāntā vījena dehakārakau /
kuhūś ca śaṅkhinī nāḍyau devadattadhanañjayau //
88.d:
अकारादिविसर्गान्ता वीजेन देहकारकौ /
कुहूश् च शङ्खिनी नाड्यौ देवदत्तधनञ्जयौ //
88.m: Beginning with "a" and ending with visarga; the body-makers through the seed-syllable; / the channels are Kuhū and Śaṅkhinī; the two winds Devadatta and Dhanañjaya;

88.s:
marutau sparśanaṃ śrotraṃ indriye viṣayo nabhaḥ /
:p 278
śabdo guṇo 'syāvasthā tu turyātītā tu pañcamī //
88.d:
मरुतौ स्पर्शनं श्रोत्रं इन्द्रिये विषयो नभः /
:प् 278
शब्दो गुणो ऽस्यावस्था तु तुर्यातीता तु पञ्चमी //

88.s:
hetuḥ sadāśivo deva iti tattvādisañcayaṃ /
sañcintya śāntyatītākhyaṃ vidadhyāttāḍanādikaṃ //
88.d:
हेतुः सदाशिवो देव इति तत्त्वादिसञ्चयं /
सञ्चिन्त्य शान्त्यतीताख्यं विदध्यात्ताडनादिकं //
88.m: The presiding cause is the god Sadāśiva. Having thus contemplated the collection of principles / belonging to Śāntyatītā, he should perform striking and the other rites.

88.s:
kalāpāśaṃ samātāḍya phaḍantena vibhidya ca /
praviśyāntar namo 'ntena phaḍantena viyojayet //
88.d:
कलापाशं समाताड्य फडन्तेन विभिद्य च /
प्रविश्यान्तर् नमो ऽन्तेन फडन्तेन वियोजयेत् //
88.m: Having struck the bond of the kalā, pierced it with [a mantra] ending in "phaṭ", / entered within with [one] ending in "namaḥ", he should sever it with [one] ending in "phaṭ".

88.s:
śikhāhṛtsampuṭībhūtaṃ svāhāntaṃ sṛṇimudrayā /
pūrakeṇa samākṛṣya pāśaṃ mastakasūtrataḥ //
88.d:
शिखाहृत्सम्पुटीभूतं स्वाहान्तं सृणिमुद्रया /
पूरकेण समाकृष्य पाशं मस्तकसूत्रतः //
88.m: Enclosed by the crest and heart [mantras] and ending in "svāhā", with the goad gesture, / drawing the bond out from the cord on the head by inhalation,

88.s:
kumbhakena samādāya recakenodbhavākhyayā /
hṛtsampuṭanamo 'ntena vahniṃ kuṇḍe niveśayet //
88.d:
कुम्भकेन समादाय रेचकेनोद्भवाख्यया /
हृत्सम्पुटनमो ऽन्तेन वह्निं कुण्डे निवेशयेत् //
88.m: Holding it by retention, and by exhalation with the gesture called Udbhava / and [the mantra] enclosed by the heart and ending in "namaḥ", he should deposit it in the fire in the fire-pit.

88.s:
asyāḥ pūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ nivṛtteriva sādhayet /
sadāśivaṃ samāvāhya pūjayitvā pratarpya ca //
88.d:
अस्याः पूजादिकं सर्वं निवृत्तेरिव साधयेत् /
सदाशिवं समावाह्य पूजयित्वा प्रतर्प्य च //
88.m: He should perform all the worship and other rites of this [kalā] just like those of Nivṛtti; / having invoked Sadāśiva, worshipped him, and offered libation,

88.s:
sadā khyāte 'dhikāre 'smin mumukṣuṃ dīkṣayāmyahaṃ /
bhāvyaṃ tvayānukūlena bhaktyā vijñāpayediti //
88.d:
सदा ख्याते ऽधिकारे ऽस्मिन् मुमुक्षुं दीक्षयाम्यहं /
भाव्यं त्वयानुकूलेन भक्त्या विज्ञापयेदिति //
88.m: He should devoutly address him thus: "In this jurisdiction that is ever renowned, I initiate one who desires liberation; / you should be favorable [to him]!"

88.s:
pitrorāvāhanaṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā tarpaṇasannidhī /
hṛtsampuṭātmavījena śiṣyaṃ vakṣasi tāḍayet //
oṃ hāṃ hūṃ haṃ phaṭ
88.d:
पित्रोरावाहनं पूजां कृत्वा तर्पणसन्निधी /
हृत्सम्पुटात्मवीजेन शिष्यं वक्षसि ताडयेत् //
ओं हां हूं हं फट्
88.m:
Having performed the invocation and worship of the [divine] parents and libation in their presence, / he should strike the disciple on the chest with his own seed-syllable enclosed by the heart [mantra]:
"Oṃ hāṃ hūṃ haṃ phaṭ!"

88.s:
praviśya cāpyanenaiva caitanyaṃ vibhajettataḥ /
śastreṇa pāśasaṃyuktaṃ jyeṣṭhayāṅkuśamudrayā //
oṃ hāṃ hūṃ haṃ phaṭ(1)
88.d:
प्रविश्य चाप्यनेनैव चैतन्यं विभजेत्ततः /
शस्त्रेण पाशसंयुक्तं ज्येष्ठयाङ्कुशमुद्रया //
ओं हां हूं हं फट्(1)
88.m:
And entering with this very [mantra], he should then separate consciousness / bound to the bond with the weapon [mantra], using the supreme goad gesture.
"Oṃ hāṃ hūṃ haṃ phaṭ!"

88.s:
svāhāntena tadākṛṣya tenaiva puṭitātmanā /
gṛhītvā tannamo 'ntena nijātmani niyojayet //
oṃ hāṃ haṃ hīṃ ātmane namaḥ(2)
:n
1 oṃ hāṃ huṃ haḥ phaṭ iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 oṃ hāṃ haṃ hrīmātmane nama iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 279
88.d:
स्वाहान्तेन तदाकृष्य तेनैव पुटितात्मना /
गृहीत्वा तन्नमो ऽन्तेन निजात्मनि नियोजयेत् //
ओं हां हं हीं आत्मने नमः(2)
:न्
1 ओं हां हुं हः फट् इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 ओं हां हं ह्रीमात्मने नम इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 279
88.m:
Drawing it out with [the mantra] ending in "svāhā", with the self enclosed by that very [mantra], / taking it with [the mantra] ending in "namaḥ", he should unite it into his own soul:
"Oṃ hāṃ haṃ hīṃ to the soul, namaḥ!"
[Notes]
1 "oṃ hāṃ huṃ haḥ phaṭ" is the reading in the book marked kha.
2 "oṃ hāṃ haṃ hrīmātmane namaḥ" is the reading in the book marked kha. / [p. 279]

88.s:
pūrvavat pitṛsaṃyogaṃ bhāvayitvodbhavākhyayā /
vāmayā tadanenaiva(1) devyā garbhe niyojayet //
88.d:
पूर्ववत् पितृसंयोगं भावयित्वोद्भवाख्यया /
वामया तदनेनैव(1) देव्या गर्भे नियोजयेत् //
88.m: Having meditated on the union of the parents as before, with the [gesture] called Udbhava, / he should deposit [the soul] into the womb of the goddess with Vāmā and with this very [mantra].

88.s:
garbhādhānādikaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā caret /
mūlena pāśaśaithilye niṣkṛtyaiva śataṃ japet //
88.d:
गर्भाधानादिकं सर्वं पूर्वोक्तविधिना चरेत् /
मूलेन पाशशैथिल्ये निष्कृत्यैव शतं जपेत् //
88.m: He should perform all [rites] such as impregnation according to the previously stated rule; / with the root mantra, having performed expiation for the loosening of the bonds, he should recite a hundred times.

88.s:
malaśaktitirodhāne pāśānāñca viyojane /
pañcapañcāhutīrdadyādāyudhena yathā purā //
88.d:
मलशक्तितिरोधाने पाशानाञ्च वियोजने /
पञ्चपञ्चाहुतीर्दद्यादायुधेन यथा पुरा //
88.m: For the obscuration of the power of impurity and the severing of the bonds, / he should offer five oblations for each with the weapon [mantra] as before.

88.s:
pāśānāyudhamantreṇa sapravārābhijaptayā /
chindyādastreṇa kartaryā kalāvījayujā yathā //
oṃ hāṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśāya haḥ hūṃ phaṭ
88.d:
पाशानायुधमन्त्रेण सप्रवाराभिजप्तया /
छिन्द्यादस्त्रेण कर्तर्या कलावीजयुजा यथा //
ओं हां शान्त्यतीतकलापाशाय हः हूं फट्
88.m:
With the weapon mantra consecrated with a single recitation, / he should cut the bonds with scissors [formed of] the weapon [mantra] joined with the seed-syllable of the kalā, as before:
"Oṃ hāṃ, to the bond of the Śāntyatīta-kalā: haḥ hūṃ phaṭ!"

88.s:
visṛjya vartulīkṛtya pāśānastreṇa pūrvavat /
ghṛtapūrṇe śruve datvā kalāstreṇaiva homayet //
88.d:
विसृज्य वर्तुलीकृत्य पाशानस्त्रेण पूर्ववत् /
घृतपूर्णे श्रुवे दत्वा कलास्त्रेणैव होमयेत् //
88.m: Having released the bonds and rolled them into a ball with the weapon [mantra] as before, / placing them in a ladle filled with ghee, he should offer them into the fire with the weapon mantra of the kalā.

88.s:
astreṇa juhuyāt pajca pāśāṅkuśanivṛttaye /
prāyaścittaniṣedhārthaṃ dadyādaṣṭāhutīstataḥ //
88.d:
अस्त्रेण जुहुयात् पज्च पाशाङ्कुशनिवृत्तये /
प्रायश्चित्तनिषेधार्थं दद्यादष्टाहुतीस्ततः //
88.m: He should offer five oblations with the weapon [mantra] to remove the bond-goad; / then he should offer eight oblations to prevent [any need for] expiation.

88.s:
sadāśivaṃ hṛdāvāhya kṛtvā pūjanatarpaṇe /
pūrvoktavidhinā kuryādadhikārasamarpaṇaṃ //
oṃ hāṃ sadāśiva manovindu śulkaṃ gṛhāṇa svāhā
88.d:
सदाशिवं हृदावाह्य कृत्वा पूजनतर्पणे /
पूर्वोक्तविधिना कुर्यादधिकारसमर्पणं //
ओं हां सदाशिव मनोविन्दु शुल्कं गृहाण स्वाहा
88.m:
Having invoked Sadāśiva with the heart [mantra] and performed worship and libation, / he should make the offering of the jurisdiction according to the previously stated rule:
"Oṃ hāṃ, Sadāśiva, accept the mind and bindu as your toll, svāhā!"

88.s:
niḥśeṣadagdhapāśasya paśorasya sadāśiva /
bandhāya na tvayā stheyaṃ śivājñāṃ śrāvayediti //
88.d:
निःशेषदग्धपाशस्य पशोरस्य सदाशिव /
बन्धाय न त्वया स्थेयं शिवाज्ञां श्रावयेदिति //
88.m: "O Sadāśiva, of this bound soul whose bonds are completely burned away, / you must not remain for bonding!" Thus he should proclaim Śiva's command.

88.s:
mūlena juhuyāt pūrṇāṃ visṛjettu sadāśivaṃ /
tato viśuddhamātmānaṃ śaraccandramivoditaṃ //
88.d:
मूलेन जुहुयात् पूर्णां विसृजेत्तु सदाशिवं /
ततो विशुद्धमात्मानं शरच्चन्द्रमिवोदितं //
88.m: He should offer the full oblation with the root mantra and dismiss Sadāśiva; / then [regarding] the purified soul risen like an autumn moon,

88.s:
saṃhāramudrayā raudryā saṃyojya gururātmani /
kurvīta śiṣyadehasthamuddhṛtyodbhavamudrayā //
88.d:
संहारमुद्रया रौद्र्या संयोज्य गुरुरात्मनि /
कुर्वीत शिष्यदेहस्थमुद्धृत्योद्भवमुद्रया //
88.m: Uniting it into himself by the fierce Saṃhāra-mudrā, the guru / should extract it with the Udbhava-mudrā and place it in the disciple's body.

88.s:
dadyādāpyāyanāyāsya mastake 'rghyāmbuvindukaṃ /
kṣamayitvā mahābhaktyā pitarau visṛjettathā //
:n
1 vāmayā hṛdayenaiveti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 280
88.d:
दद्यादाप्यायनायास्य मस्तके ऽर्घ्याम्बुविन्दुकं /
क्षमयित्वा महाभक्त्या पितरौ विसृजेत्तथा //
:न्
1 वामया हृदयेनैवेति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 280
88.m:
To invigorate him, he should place a drop of water from the water offering upon his head; / having asked forgiveness with great devotion, he should likewise dismiss the [divine] parents:
[Notes]
1 "vāmayā hṛdayenaiva" is the reading in the book marked ga. / [p. 280]

88.s:
kheditau śiṣyadīkṣāyai yanmayā pitarau yuvāṃ /
kāruṇyanānmokṣayitvā tadvraja tvaṃ sthānamātmanaḥ //
88.d:
खेदितौ शिष्यदीक्षायै यन्मया पितरौ युवां /
कारुण्यनान्मोक्षयित्वा तद्व्रज त्वं स्थानमात्मनः //
88.m: "O parents, because you were troubled by me for the initiation of the disciple, / release [me] out of compassion; therefore go to your own abode!"

88.s:
śikhāmantritakartaryā bodhaśaktisvarūpiṇīṃ /
śikhāṃ chidyācchivāstreṇa śiṣyasya caturaṅgulāṃ //
oṃ klīṃ śikhāyai hūṃ phaṭ(1) oṃ haḥ astrāya hūṃ
phaṭ
88.d:
शिखामन्त्रितकर्तर्या बोधशक्तिस्वरूपिणीं /
शिखां छिद्याच्छिवास्त्रेण शिष्यस्य चतुरङ्गुलां //
ओं क्लीं शिखायै हूं फट्(1) ओं हः अस्त्राय हूं
फट्
88.m:
With scissors consecrated with the crest mantra, he should cut the disciple's topknot, / four fingers [long], embodying the power of awareness, with the weapon mantra of Śiva:
"Oṃ klīṃ to the crest: hūṃ phaṭ! Oṃ haḥ to the weapon: hūṃ phaṭ!"

88.s:
sruci tāṃ ghṛtapūrṇāyāṃ goviḍgolakamadhyagāṃ(2) /
saṃvidhāyāstramantreṇa hūṃ phaḍantena homayet //
oṃ hauṃ haḥ astrāya hūṃ phaṭ
88.d:
स्रुचि तां घृतपूर्णायां गोविड्गोलकमध्यगां(2) /
संविधायास्त्रमन्त्रेण हूं फडन्तेन होमयेत् //
ओं हौं हः अस्त्राय हूं फट्
88.m:
Placing it inside a ball of cow dung in an offering spoon filled with clarified butter, / he should offer it as a fire oblation with the weapon mantra ending in hūṃ phaṭ.
“Oṃ hauṃ haḥ, to the weapon, hūṃ phaṭ!”

88.s:
prakṣālya sruksruvau śiṣyaṃ saṃsnāpyācamya ca svayaṃ /
yojanikāsthānamātmānaṃ śastramantreṇa tāḍayet //
88.d:
प्रक्षाल्य स्रुक्स्रुवौ शिष्यं संस्नाप्याचम्य च स्वयं /
योजनिकास्थानमात्मानं शस्त्रमन्त्रेण ताडयेत् //
88.m: Having washed the two ladles, bathed the disciple, and sipped water himself, / he should strike his own self, the site of union, with the weapon mantra.

88.s:
viyojyākṛṣya sampūjya(3) pūrvavad dvādaśāntataḥ /
ātmīyahṛdayāmbhojakarṇikāyāṃ niveśayet //
88.d:
वियोज्याकृष्य सम्पूज्य(3) पूर्ववद् द्वादशान्ततः /
आत्मीयहृदयाम्भोजकर्णिकायां निवेशयेत् //
88.m: Having detached, drawn forth, and worshipped [it] as before, from the dvādaśānta, / he should place [it] in the pericarp of the lotus of his own heart.

88.s:
pūritaṃ śruvamājyena vihitādhomukhaśrucā /
nityoktavidhinā.adāya śaṅkhasannibhamudrayā //
88.d:
पूरितं श्रुवमाज्येन विहिताधोमुखश्रुचा /
नित्योक्तविधिना.अदाय शङ्खसन्निभमुद्रया //
88.m: Having taken up the sruva filled with clarified butter with the sruc turned downwards, / according to the procedure stated for daily rites, using the gesture resembling a conch,

88.s:
prasāritaśirogrīvo nādoccārānusārataḥ /
samadṛṣṭiśivaścāntaḥ parabhāvasamanvitaḥ //
88.d:
प्रसारितशिरोग्रीवो नादोच्चारानुसारतः /
समदृष्टिशिवश्चान्तः परभावसमन्वितः //
88.m: with head and neck stretched out, following the resonance of the nāda, / with an even gaze, composed within, endowed with the supreme state,

88.s:
kumbhamaṇḍalavahnibhyaḥ(4) śiṣyādapi nijātmanaḥ /
gṛhītvā ṣaḍvidhavidhānaṃ śrugagre prāṇanāḍikaṃ //
88.d:
कुम्भमण्डलवह्निभ्यः(4) शिष्यादपि निजात्मनः /
गृहीत्वा षड्विधविधानं श्रुगग्रे प्राणनाडिकं //
88.m: taking from the pot, the maṇḍala, the fire, / from the disciple, and also from himself, the sixfold order [of the channels] of the prāṇa-nāḍī at the tip of the sruc,

88.s:
sañcintya vinduvad dhyātvā kramaśaḥ saptadhā yathā /
prathamaṃ prāṇasaṃyogasvarūpamaparantataḥ //
:n
1 oṃ hūṃ śikhāyai hūṃ phaṭ iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
/ oṃ hrīṃ śikhāyai hraṃ phaḍiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 govindalokamadhyagāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 viyojyākṛṣya saṅgṛhyeti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 kuṇḍamaṇḍalavahnibhya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 281
88.d:
सञ्चिन्त्य विन्दुवद् ध्यात्वा क्रमशः सप्तधा यथा /
प्रथमं प्राणसंयोगस्वरूपमपरन्ततः //
:न्
1 ओं हूं शिखायै हूं फट् इति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
/ ओं ह्रीं शिखायै ह्रं फडिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 गोविन्दलोकमध्यगामिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 वियोज्याकृष्य सङ्गृह्येति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 कुण्डमण्डलवह्निभ्य इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 281
88.m:
contemplating [it] as a bindu, meditating [on it] progressively as sevenfold: / first the nature of the conjunction of prāṇa, and then the next.
[Gap in text]
[Variant reading note]
[Variant reading note]
[Variant reading note]
[Variant reading note]

88.s:
hṛdayādikramoccāravisṛṣṭaṃ mantrasañjñakaṃ /
pūrakaṃ kumbhakaṃ kṛtvā vyādāya vadanaṃ manāk //
88.d:
हृदयादिक्रमोच्चारविसृष्टं मन्त्रसञ्ज्ञकं /
पूरकं कुम्भकं कृत्वा व्यादाय वदनं मनाक् //
88.m: Uttered in sequence from the heart and so forth, emitted and called mantra; / having performed inhalation and retention, opening the mouth slightly,

88.s:
suṣumṇānugataṃ nādasvarūpantu tṛtīyakaṃ /
saptame kāraṇe tyāgātpraśāntavikharaṃ layaḥ //
88.d:
सुषुम्णानुगतं नादस्वरूपन्तु तृतीयकं /
सप्तमे कारणे त्यागात्प्रशान्तविखरं लयः //
88.m: the third is that which follows the suṣumṇā and has the nature of nāda; / by renunciation at the seventh cause, dissolution is the tranquil peak.

88.s:
śaktinādordhvasañcārastacchaktivikharaṃ mataṃ /
prāṇasya nikhilasyāpi śaktiprameyavarjitaṃ //
88.d:
शक्तिनादोर्ध्वसञ्चारस्तच्छक्तिविखरं मतं /
प्राणस्य निखिलस्यापि शक्तिप्रमेयवर्जितं //
88.m: The upward movement of energy and sound is considered the peak of energy; / devoid of the knowables of energy, of the entire prāṇa,

88.s:
tatkālavikharaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ śaktyatītañca saptamaṃ /
tadetad yojanāsthānaṃ vikharantattvasañjñakaṃ //
88.d:
तत्कालविखरं षष्ठं शक्त्यतीतञ्च सप्तमं /
तदेतद् योजनास्थानं विखरन्तत्त्वसञ्ज्ञकं //
88.m: the sixth is the peak of time, and the seventh transcends energy. / That is the place of union, called the highest principle.

88.s:
pūrakaṃ kumbhakaṃ kṛtvā vyādāya vadanaṃ manāk /
śanair udīrayan mūlaṃ kṛtvā śiṣyātmano layaṃ //
88.d:
पूरकं कुम्भकं कृत्वा व्यादाय वदनं मनाक् /
शनैर् उदीरयन् मूलं कृत्वा शिष्यात्मनो लयं //
88.m: Having performed inhalation and retention, opening the mouth slightly, / softly uttering the root mantra, having effected the dissolution of the disciple's self

88.s:
hakāre taḍidākāre ṣaḍadhvajaprāṇarūpiṇi /
ukāraṃ parato nābhervitastiṃ vyāpya saṃsthitaṃ //
88.d:
हकारे तडिदाकारे षडध्वजप्राणरूपिणि /
उकारं परतो नाभेर्वितस्तिं व्याप्य संस्थितं //
88.m: into the syllable Ha, which has the form of lightning and the nature of the vital breath of the six pathways; / then the syllable U, situated occupying a span from the navel;

88.s:
tataḥ paraṃ makārantu hṛdayāccaturaṅgulaṃ /
oṅkāraṃ vācakaṃ viṣṇostato 'ṣṭāṅgulakaṇṭhakaṃ //
88.d:
ततः परं मकारन्तु हृदयाच्चतुरङ्गुलं /
ओङ्कारं वाचकं विष्णोस्ततो ऽष्टाङ्गुलकण्ठकं //
88.m: then beyond that, the syllable Ma, four fingers above the heart; / the oṅkāra, expressing Viṣṇu, eight fingers from there up to the throat;

88.s:
caturaṅgulatālusthaṃ makāraṃ rudravācakaṃ /
tadvallalāṭamadhyasthaṃ vindumīśvaravācakaṃ //
88.d:
चतुरङ्गुलतालुस्थं मकारं रुद्रवाचकं /
तद्वल्ललाटमध्यस्थं विन्दुमीश्वरवाचकं //
88.m: the syllable Ma situated in the palate, four fingers [above], expressing Rudra; / likewise the bindu situated in the middle of the forehead, expressing Īśvara;

88.s:
nādaṃ sadāśivaṃ devaṃ brahmarandhrāvasānakaṃ /
śaktiṃ ca brahmarandhrasthāṃ tyajannityamanukramāt //
88.d:
नादं सदाशिवं देवं ब्रह्मरन्ध्रावसानकं /
शक्तिं च ब्रह्मरन्ध्रस्थां त्यजन्नित्यमनुक्रमात् //
88.m: nāda, [which is] the god Sadāśiva, ending at the brahmarandhra; / and leaving the energy located in the brahmarandhra in this regular order,

88.s:
divyaṃ pipīlikāsparśaṃ tasminnevānubhūya ca /
dvādaśānte pare tattve paramānandalakṣaṇe //
88.d:
दिव्यं पिपीलिकास्पर्शं तस्मिन्नेवानुभूय च /
द्वादशान्ते परे तत्त्वे परमानन्दलक्षणे //
88.m: and experiencing in that very state the divine sensation [like] crawling ants, / in the supreme principle at the dvādaśānta, characterized by supreme bliss,

88.s:
bhāvaśūnye mano 'tīte śive nityaguṇodaye /
vilīya mānase tasmin śiṣyātmānaṃ vibhāvayet //
88.d:
भावशून्ये मनो ऽतीते शिवे नित्यगुणोदये /
विलीय मानसे तस्मिन् शिष्यात्मानं विभावयेत् //
88.m: in Śiva, devoid of objective existence, beyond the mind, in whom eternal qualities arise; / having dissolved [it] mentally therein, he should meditate on the disciple's self,

88.s:
vimuñcan sarpiṣo dhārāṃ jvālānte 'pi pare śive /
yojanikāsthiratvāya vauṣaḍantaśivāṇunā(1) //
:n
1 vauṣaḍantaśivātmaneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 282
88.d:
विमुञ्चन् सर्पिषो धारां ज्वालान्ते ऽपि परे शिवे /
योजनिकास्थिरत्वाय वौषडन्तशिवाणुना(1) //
:न्
1 वौषडन्तशिवात्मनेति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 282
88.m:
releasing a stream of clarified butter into the supreme Śiva even at the end of the flame, / with the Śiva-mantra ending in vauṣaṭ, for the stability of the union.
[Gap in text]
[Variant reading note]

88.s:
datvā pūrṇāṃ vidhānena guṇāpadānamacaret /
oṃ hāṃ ātmane(1) sarvajño bhava svāhā / oṃ hāṃ ātmane(2)
paritṛpto bhava svāhā / oṃ hrūṃ ātmane(3) anādibodho bhava svāhā
/ oṃ hauṃ ātmane(4) svatantro bhava svāhā / oṃ hauṃ ātman(5)
aluptaśaktirbhava svāhā / oṃ haḥ ātmane(6) anantaśaktirbhava
svāhāitthaṃ ṣaḍguṇamātmānaṃ gṛhītvā paramākṣarāt //
88.d:
दत्वा पूर्णां विधानेन गुणापदानमचरेत् /
ओं हां आत्मने(1) सर्वज्ञो भव स्वाहा / ओं हां आत्मने(2)
परितृप्तो भव स्वाहा / ओं ह्रूं आत्मने(3) अनादिबोधो भव स्वाहा
/ ओं हौं आत्मने(4) स्वतन्त्रो भव स्वाहा / ओं हौं आत्मन्(5)
अलुप्तशक्तिर्भव स्वाहा / ओं हः आत्मने(6) अनन्तशक्तिर्भव
स्वाहाइत्थं षड्गुणमात्मानं गृहीत्वा परमाक्षरात् //
88.m:
Having offered the full oblation according to rule, he should perform the conferral of attributes:
“Oṃ hāṃ, to the Self, be omniscient, svāhā! Oṃ hāṃ, to the Self,
be fully satisfied, svāhā! Oṃ hrūṃ, to the Self, be of beginningless wisdom, svāhā!
/ Oṃ hauṃ, to the Self, be independent, svāhā! Oṃ hauṃ, O Self,
be of unfailing power, svāhā! Oṃ haḥ, to the Self, be of boundless power,
svāhā!” Having thus received the self endowed with six qualities from the supreme syllable,

88.s:
vidhinā bhāvanopetaḥ śiṣyadehe niyojayet /
tīvrāṇuśaktisampātajanitaśramaśāntaye //
88.d:
विधिना भावनोपेतः शिष्यदेहे नियोजयेत् /
तीव्राणुशक्तिसम्पातजनितश्रमशान्तये //
88.m: endowed with contemplation according to rule, he should unite it in the body of the disciple. / To calm the fatigue caused by the intense descent of the power of the soul,

88.s:
śiṣyamūrdhani vinyasyedarghyādamṛtavindukaṃ /
praṇamayyeśakumbhādīn śivāddakṣiṇamaṇḍale(7) //
88.d:
शिष्यमूर्धनि विन्यस्येदर्घ्यादमृतविन्दुकं /
प्रणमय्येशकुम्भादीन् शिवाद्दक्षिणमण्डले(7) //
88.m: he should deposit a drop of nectar from the arghya offering on the disciple's head. / Having caused him to bow down to the pot of Īśa and the rest, in the southern circle from Śiva,

88.s:
saumyavaktraṃ vyavasthāpya śiṣyaṃ dakṣiṇamātmanaḥ /
tvayaivānugṛhīto 'yaṃ mūrtimāsthāya māmakīṃ //
88.d:
सौम्यवक्त्रं व्यवस्थाप्य शिष्यं दक्षिणमात्मनः /
त्वयैवानुगृहीतो ऽयं मूर्तिमास्थाय मामकीं //
88.m: having placed the disciple to his right, with a pleasant countenance, [the guru prays]: / “This one has been graced by you alone, taking on my form.

88.s:
deve vahnau gurau tasmādbhaktiṃ cāpyasya vardhaya(8) /
iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ praṇamya ca guruḥ svayaṃ //
:n
1 oṃ hrīṃ ātmanniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ hauṃ
ātmanniti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 oṃ hrīṃ ātmane iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ hīṃ
ātmanniti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 oṃ hraiṃ ātmanniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ ātmanniti ga,
gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 oṃ hraiṃ ātmanniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ huṃ ātmanniti
ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ hauṃ ātmanniti gha, ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 oṃ haiṃ ātmanniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
7 śivadakṣiṇamaṇḍale iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
8 bhaktiṃ nāthāsya vardhayeti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 283
88.d:
देवे वह्नौ गुरौ तस्माद्भक्तिं चाप्यस्य वर्धय(8) /
इति विज्ञाप्य देवेशं प्रणम्य च गुरुः स्वयं //
:न्
1 ओं ह्रीं आत्मन्निति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / ओं हौं
आत्मन्निति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 ओं ह्रीं आत्मने इति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / ओं हीं
आत्मन्निति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 ओं ह्रैं आत्मन्निति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / ओं आत्मन्निति ग,
घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 ओं ह्रैं आत्मन्निति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / ओं हुं आत्मन्निति
ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / ओं हौं आत्मन्निति घ, ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 ओं हैं आत्मन्निति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
7 शिवदक्षिणमण्डले इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
8 भक्तिं नाथास्य वर्धयेति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 283
88.m:
Therefore, increase his devotion to the god, the fire, and the guru.” / Having thus addressed the Lord of the gods and bowed down himself, the guru
[Gap in text]
[Variant reading note]
[Variant reading note]
[Variant reading note]
[Variant reading note]
[Variant reading note]
[Variant reading note]
[Variant reading note]

88.s:
śreyastavāstviti brūyādāśiṣaṃ śiṣyamādarāt /
tataḥ paramayā bhaktyā datvā deve 'ṣṭapuṣpikāṃ /
putrakaṃ śivakumbhena saṃsnāpya visṛjenmakhaṃ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye nirvāṇadīkṣāsamāpanaṃ nāma
aṣṭāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athonanavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
ekatattvadīkṣākathanaṃ
88.d:
श्रेयस्तवास्त्विति ब्रूयादाशिषं शिष्यमादरात् /
ततः परमया भक्त्या दत्वा देवे ऽष्टपुष्पिकां /
पुत्रकं शिवकुम्भेन संस्नाप्य विसृजेन्मखं //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये निर्वाणदीक्षासमापनं नाम
अष्टाशीतितमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथोननवतितमो ऽध्यायः
एकतत्त्वदीक्षाकथनं
88.m:
should respectfully speak the blessing to the disciple: “May you have welfare!” / Then, having offered the eight-flower offering to the god with supreme devotion, / and having bathed the spiritual son with the Śiva-pot, he should conclude the sacrifice.
Thus ends the eighty-eighth chapter, called “The Completion of Liberating Initiation”, in the ancient Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
Now, eighty-ninth chapter.
The teaching of initiation through a single principle.

89.s:
īśvara uvāca
athaikatāttvikī dīkṣā laghutvādupadiśyate /
sūtrabandhādi kurvīta yathāyogaṃ nijātmanā //
89.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
अथैकतात्त्विकी दीक्षा लघुत्वादुपदिश्यते /
सूत्रबन्धादि कुर्वीत यथायोगं निजात्मना //
89.m: Īśvara said: / Now initiation consisting of a single principle is taught on account of its brevity. / One should perform the binding of the thread and the rest as appropriate with one's own self.

89.s:
kālāgnyādiśivāntāni tattvāni parabhāvayet /
samatattve samagrāṇi sūtre maṇigaṇāniva //
89.d:
कालाग्न्यादिशिवान्तानि तत्त्वानि परभावयेत् /
समतत्त्वे समग्राणि सूत्रे मणिगणानिव //
89.m: He should contemplate the principles from Kālāgni up to Śiva as supreme, / all of them in equal principles, like a collection of gems upon a string.

89.s:
āvāhya śivatattvādi garbhādhānādi pūrvavat /
mūlena kintu kurvīta sarvaśulkasamarpaṇaṃ //
89.d:
आवाह्य शिवतत्त्वादि गर्भाधानादि पूर्ववत् /
मूलेन किन्तु कुर्वीत सर्वशुल्कसमर्पणं //
89.m: Having invoked the Śiva principle and the rest, the impregnation rite and the rest are as before. / But with the root mantra he should perform the surrender of all fees.

89.s:
pradadīta tataḥ pūrṇāṃ tattvavātopagarbhitāṃ /
ekayaiva yayā śiṣyo nirvāṇamadhigacchati //
89.d:
प्रददीत ततः पूर्णां तत्त्ववातोपगर्भितां /
एकयैव यया शिष्यो निर्वाणमधिगच्छति //
89.m: He should then offer the full oblation impregnated with the breath of the principles, / by which alone the disciple attains liberation.

89.s:
yojanāyai śive cānyāṃ sthiratvāpādanāya ca /
datvā pūrṇāṃ prakurvīta śivakumbhābhiṣecanaṃ //
:e ity ādimahapurāṇe āgneye ekatattvadīkṣākathanaṃ nāma
ūnanavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:p 284
:ś atha navatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
abhiṣekādikathanaṃ
89.d:
योजनायै शिवे चान्यां स्थिरत्वापादनाय च /
दत्वा पूर्णां प्रकुर्वीत शिवकुम्भाभिषेचनं //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहपुराणे आग्नेये एकतत्त्वदीक्षाकथनं नाम
ऊननवतितमो ऽध्यायः
:प् 284
:श् अथ नवतितमो ऽध्यायः
अभिषेकादिकथनं
89.m:
And having offered another full oblation for union in Śiva and to bring about stability, / he should perform consecration by aspersion with the Śiva-pot.
Thus ends the eighty-ninth chapter, called “The Teaching of Initiation through a Single Principle”, in the ancient Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
Now, ninetieth chapter.
The teaching on consecration by aspersion and other rites.

90.s:
īśvara uvāca
śivamabhyarcyābhiṣekaṃ kuryācchiṣyādike śriye /
kumbhānīśādikāṣṭhāsu kramaśo nava vinyaset //
90.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
शिवमभ्यर्च्याभिषेकं कुर्याच्छिष्यादिके श्रिये /
कुम्भानीशादिकाष्ठासु क्रमशो नव विन्यसेत् //
90.m: Īśvara said: / Having worshipped Śiva, one should perform consecration by aspersion for the disciple and others for prosperity. / He should arrange nine pots in sequence in the directions starting with Īśāna.

90.s:
teṣu kṣārodaṃ kṣīrodaṃ dadhyudaṃ ghṛtasāgaraṃ /
ikṣukādambarīsvādumastūdānaṣṭasāgarān(1) //
90.d:
तेषु क्षारोदं क्षीरोदं दध्युदं घृतसागरं /
इक्षुकादम्बरीस्वादुमस्तूदानष्टसागरान्(1) //
90.m: In them, [he places waters representing] the eight oceans: salt water, milk ocean, curd water, clarified butter ocean, / sugarcane juice, wine, sweet water, and whey water.

90.s:
niveśayed yathāsaṅkhyamaṣṭau vidyeśvarānatha /
ekaṃ śikhaṇḍinaṃ rudraṃ śrīkaṇṭhantu dvitīyakaṃ //
90.d:
निवेशयेद् यथासङ्ख्यमष्टौ विद्येश्वरानथ /
एकं शिखण्डिनं रुद्रं श्रीकण्ठन्तु द्वितीयकं //
90.m:
Then one should seat the eight Lord-of-Knowledge deities in order:
first Śikhaṇḍin the Rudra, and Śrīkaṇṭha second,

Trimūrti, Ekarudrākṣa, Ekanetra, Śivottama,
the seventh named Sūkṣma, and Ananta the Rudra as the eighth.

90.s:
madhye śivaṃ samudrañca śivamantraṃ ca vinyaset /
yāgālayān digīśasya racite snānamaṇḍape //
90.d:
मध्ये शिवं समुद्रञ्च शिवमन्त्रं च विन्यसेत् /
यागालयान् दिगीशस्य रचिते स्नानमण्डपे //
90.m:
In the center, one should place Śiva, the ocean, and the Śiva mantra.
In a bathing pavilion constructed [facing the direction] of the Regent of the Quarter from the sacrificial pavilion,

90.s:
kuryāt karadvayāyāmāṃ vedīmaṣṭāṅgulocchritāṃ /
śrīparṇādyāsane tatra vinyasyānantamānasaṃ //
90.d:
कुर्यात् करद्वयायामां वेदीमष्टाङ्गुलोच्छ्रितां /
श्रीपर्णाद्यासने तत्र विन्यस्यानन्तमानसं //
90.m:
one should make an altar two cubits long and eight finger-breadths high.
Placing there a seat of śrīparṇī wood or the like, having ananta in the mind,

90.s:
śiṣyaṃ niveśya pūrvāsyaṃ sakalīkṛtya pūjayet /
kāñjikaudanamṛdbhasmadūrvāgomayagolakaiḥ //
90.d:
शिष्यं निवेश्य पूर्वास्यं सकलीकृत्य पूजयेत् /
काञ्जिकौदनमृद्भस्मदूर्वागोमयगोलकैः //
90.m:
seating the disciple facing east, having performed the ritual integration (sakalīkaraṇa), one should worship [him].
With fermented gruel, boiled rice, clay, ashes, dūrvā grass, and balls of cow dung,

90.s:
siddhārthadadhitoyaiś ca kuryānnirmañchanaṃ tataḥ /
kṣārodānukrameṇātha hṛdā vidyeśaśambaraiḥ //
90.d:
सिद्धार्थदधितोयैश् च कुर्यान्निर्मञ्छनं ततः /
क्षारोदानुक्रमेणाथ हृदा विद्येशशम्बरैः //
90.m:
and with mustard seeds, curds, and water, one should then perform the wave-offering of protection (nirmañchana).
Then, in the sequence of the ocean of salt water and the rest, with the heart-mantra, with the waters of the Lord-of-Knowledge deities,

90.s:
kalasaiḥ snāpayecchiṣyaṃ svadhādhāraṇayānvitaṃ /
paridhāpya site vastre niveśya śivadakṣiṇe //
90.d:
कलसैः स्नापयेच्छिष्यं स्वधाधारणयान्वितं /
परिधाप्य सिते वस्त्रे निवेश्य शिवदक्षिणे //
90.m:
one should bathe the disciple with the jars, joined with the svadhā-dharana rite.
Having dressed [him] in two white garments and seated [him] to the right of Śiva,

90.s:
pūrvoditāsane śiṣyaṃ punaḥ pūrvavadarcayet /
uṣṇīṣaṃ yogapaṭṭañca mukuṭaṃ kartarīṃ ghaṭīṃ //
90.d:
पूर्वोदितासने शिष्यं पुनः पूर्ववदर्चयेत् /
उष्णीषं योगपट्टञ्च मुकुटं कर्तरीं घटीं //
90.m:
upon the seat mentioned before, one should again worship the disciple as before.
A turban, a meditation-band, a crown, a pair of scissors, a water vessel,

90.s:
akṣamālāṃ pustakādi śivakādyadhikārakaṃ /
:n
1 svādugargodānaṣṭasāgarāniti ka, kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 285
dīkṣāvyākhyāpratiṣṭhādyaṃ jñātvādyaprabhṛti tvayā //
90.d:
अक्षमालां पुस्तकादि शिवकाद्यधिकारकं /
:न्
1 स्वादुगर्गोदानष्टसागरानिति क, ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 285
दीक्षाव्याख्याप्रतिष्ठाद्यं ज्ञात्वाद्यप्रभृति त्वया //
90.m:
a rosary, books and the like, conveying authority over Śaiva rites and other matters,
[Gap in text]
1 'svādugargodānaṣṭasāgarān' is the reading in the manuscripts marked ka and kha. / [page 285]
"Having understood initiation, exposition, consecration, and the like, from this day forth by you,

90.s:
suparīkṣya(1) vidhātavyamājñāṃ saṃśrāvayediti /
abhivādya tataḥ śiṣyaṃ praṇipatya maheśvaraṃ //
90.d:
सुपरीक्ष्य(1) विधातव्यमाज्ञां संश्रावयेदिति /
अभिवाद्य ततः शिष्यं प्रणिपत्य महेश्वरं //
90.m:
having thoroughly examined, [it] must be performed"—thus he should proclaim the command.
Then, greeting the disciple and bowing down to Maheśvara,

for the sake of dispelling the flare of obstacles, he should make a petition as follows:
"Directed for the purpose of consecration by aspersion by You in the form of the guru,

90.s:
saṃhitāpāragaḥ so 'yamabhiṣikto mayā śiva /
tṛptaye mantracakrasya pañcapañcāhutīryajet //
90.d:
संहितापारगः सो ऽयमभिषिक्तो मया शिव /
तृप्तये मन्त्रचक्रस्य पञ्चपञ्चाहुतीर्यजेत् //
90.m:
this one, master of the Saṃhitā, has been consecrated by me, O Śiva!"
For the satisfaction of the wheel of mantras, he should offer five oblations of five each.

90.s:
dadyāt pūrṇāṃ tataḥ śiṣyaṃ sthāpayennijadakṣiṇe /
śiṣyadakṣiṇapāṇisthā aṅguṣṭhādyaṅgulīḥ kramāt //
90.d:
दद्यात् पूर्णां ततः शिष्यं स्थापयेन्निजदक्षिणे /
शिष्यदक्षिणपाणिस्था अङ्गुष्ठाद्यङ्गुलीः क्रमात् //
90.m:
Then he should offer the full oblation and place the disciple to his own right.
The fingers, beginning with the thumb, situated on the disciple's right hand,

90.s:
lāñchayedupabaddhāya dagdhadarbhāgraśambaraiḥ /
kusumāni kare datvā praṇāmaṃ kārayedamuṃ //
90.d:
लाञ्छयेदुपबद्धाय दग्धदर्भाग्रशम्बरैः /
कुसुमानि करे दत्वा प्रणामं कारयेदमुं //
90.m:
he should mark in sequence for the bound one with the waters of burnt darbha tips.
Having placed flowers in his hand, he should make him offer obeisance.

90.s:
kumbhe 'nale śive svasmisaṃstataskṛtyamāviśet /
anugrāhyāstvayā śiṣyāḥ śāstreṇa suparīkṣitāḥ //
90.d:
कुम्भे ऽनले शिवे स्वस्मिसंस्ततस्कृत्यमाविशेत् /
अनुग्राह्यास्त्वया शिष्याः शास्त्रेण सुपरीक्षिताः //
90.m:
In the jar, in the fire, in Śiva, and in oneself, one should enter upon that rite.
"Disciples thoroughly examined according to the scripture are to be graced by you."

90.s:
bhūpavanmānavādīnāmabhiṣekādabhīpsitaṃ /
āṃ śrāṃ śrauṃ paśuṃ hūṃ phaḍiti astrarājābhiṣekataḥ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye abhiṣekādikathanaṃ nāma navatitamo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athaikanavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
vividhamantrādikathanaṃ
90.d:
भूपवन्मानवादीनामभिषेकादभीप्सितं /
आं श्रां श्रौं पशुं हूं फडिति अस्त्रराजाभिषेकतः //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये अभिषेकादिकथनं नाम नवतितमो
ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथैकनवतितमो ऽध्यायः
विविधमन्त्रादिकथनं
90.m:
The desired [object] of humans and others, as of kings, [is achieved] from consecration by aspersion,
by the consecration with the King of Astra mantras: "āṃ śrāṃ śrauṃ paśuṃ hūṃ phaṭ".
Thus in the primitive Great Purāṇa of Agni, the ninetieth chapter, entitled "The Description of Consecration by Aspersion and the Rest."
Now the ninety-first chapter.
The Description of Various Mantras and Other Matters

91.s:
īśvara uvāca
abhiṣiktaḥ śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ pūjayedbhāskarādikān /
śaṅkhabheryādinirghoṣaiḥ snāpayet pañcagavyakaiḥ //
:n
1 svayaṃ vīkṣyeti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 286
91.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
अभिषिक्तः शिवं विष्णुं पूजयेद्भास्करादिकान् /
शङ्खभेर्यादिनिर्घोषैः स्नापयेत् पञ्चगव्यकैः //
:न्
1 स्वयं वीक्ष्येति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 286
91.m:
Īśvara said:
The consecrated one should worship Śiva, Viṣṇu, the Sun, and other deities.
With the sounds of conches, kettle-drums, and the like, he should bathe [them] with the five products of the cow.
[Gap in text]
1 'svayaṃ vīkṣya' is the reading in the manuscript marked ga. / [page 286]

91.s:
yo devāndevalokaṃ sa yāti svakulamuddharan /
varṣakoṭisahasreṣu yat pāpaṃ smupārjitaṃ //
91.d:
यो देवान्देवलोकं स याति स्वकुलमुद्धरन् /
वर्षकोटिसहस्रेषु यत् पापं स्मुपार्जितं //
91.m:
Whoever [bathes] the deities, he goes to the realm of the gods, delivering his own family.
Whatever sin has been accumulated during thousands of crores of years,

91.s:
ghṛtābhyaṅgena devānāṃ bhasmībhavati pāvake /
āḍhakena ghṛtādyaiś ca devān snāpya suro bhavet //
91.d:
घृताभ्यङ्गेन देवानां भस्मीभवति पावके /
आढकेन घृताद्यैश् च देवान् स्नाप्य सुरो भवेत् //
91.m:
becomes ashes in the fire by anointing the deities with ghee.
Having bathed the deities with an āḍhaka measure of ghee and the like, one becomes a god.

91.s:
candanenānulipyātha gandhādyaiḥ pūjayettathā /
alpāyāsanaṃ stutibhistutā devāstu sarvadā //
91.d:
चन्दनेनानुलिप्याथ गन्धाद्यैः पूजयेत्तथा /
अल्पायासनं स्तुतिभिस्तुता देवास्तु सर्वदा //
91.m:
Having anointed [them] with sandalwood paste, he should then worship [them] with fragrances and the like.
Praised always with hymns requiring little effort, the deities

91.s:
atītānāgatajñānamantradhībhuktimuktidāḥ /
gṛhītvā praśnasūkṣmārṇe hṛte dvābhyāṃ śubhāśubhaṃ //
91.d:
अतीतानागतज्ञानमन्त्रधीभुक्तिमुक्तिदाः /
गृहीत्वा प्रश्नसूक्ष्मार्णे हृते द्वाभ्यां शुभाशुभं //
91.m:
bestow knowledge of past and future, mantras, intelligence, worldly enjoyment, and liberation.
Having taken the subtle letters of a question, when divided by two, [they indicate] good or evil fortune;

91.s:
tribhirjīvo mūladhātuś caturbhirbrāhmaṇādidhīḥ /
yañcādau bhūtatattvādi śeṣe caivaṃ japādikaṃ //
91.d:
त्रिभिर्जीवो मूलधातुश् चतुर्भिर्ब्राह्मणादिधीः /
यञ्चादौ भूततत्त्वादि शेषे चैवं जपादिकं //
91.m:
by three, the living being, root matter, and the minerals; by four, the intellect of a Brahmin and the like;
in groups of five and the rest, the elements, principles, and the like, and in the remainder, recitation and so forth.

91.s:
ekatrikātitrikānte pade dvipamakāntake /
aśubhaṃ madhyamaṃ madhyeṣvindrastriṣu nṛpaḥ śubhaḥ //
91.d:
एकत्रिकातित्रिकान्ते पदे द्विपमकान्तके /
अशुभं मध्यमं मध्येष्विन्द्रस्त्रिषु नृपः शुभः //
91.m:
At the end of a single triad, beyond the triad, [or] in a square ending in an elephant:
ill fortune; in the middle ones, intermediate; in three [squares] of Indra, a king, [indicating] good fortune.

91.s:
saṅkhyāvṛnde jīvitābdaṃ yamo 'bdadaśahā dhruvaṃ /
sūryebhāsyeśadurgāśrīviṣṇumantrair likhet kaje //
91.d:
सङ्ख्यावृन्दे जीविताब्दं यमो ऽब्ददशहा ध्रुवं /
सूर्येभास्येशदुर्गाश्रीविष्णुमन्त्रैर् लिखेत् कजे //
91.m:
In a group of numbers, the years of life; Yama certainly destroys ten years.
One should write on a lotus with the mantras of the Sun, the Elephant-faced one, Īśa, Durgā, Śrī, and Viṣṇu,

91.s:
kaṭhinyā japtayā spṛṣṭe gomūtrākṛtirekhayā /
ārabhyaikaṃ trikaṃ yāvattricatuṣkāvasānakaṃ //
91.d:
कठिन्या जप्तया स्पृष्टे गोमूत्राकृतिरेखया /
आरभ्यैकं त्रिकं यावत्त्रिचतुष्कावसानकं //
91.m:
touched by a piece of chalk empowered by recitation, with a line shaped like cow's urine,
beginning from one triad up to the end of three sets of four,

91.s:
marud vyoma marudvījaiś catuḥṣaṣṭipade tathā /
akṣāṇāṃ patanāt sparśādviṣamādau śubhādikaṃ //
91.d:
मरुद् व्योम मरुद्वीजैश् चतुःषष्टिपदे तथा /
अक्षाणां पतनात् स्पर्शाद्विषमादौ शुभादिकं //
91.m:
with the seed-syllables of wind, ether, and wind, likewise in sixty-four squares.
From the falling or touching of the dice, in the odd [numbers] and others, good fortune and so forth [are indicated].

91.s:
ekatrikādimārabhya ante cāṣṭatrikaṃ tathā /
dhvajādyāyāḥ samā hīnā viṣamāḥ śobhanādidāḥ(1) //
91.d:
एकत्रिकादिमारभ्य अन्ते चाष्टत्रिकं तथा /
ध्वजाद्यायाः समा हीना विषमाः शोभनादिदाः(1) //
91.m:
Beginning from one triad, and at the end eight triads likewise:
the banners and the like are even, lower ones, [while] odd ones bestow good fortune and the like.

91.s:
āipallavitaiḥ kādyaiḥ ṣoḍaśasvarapūrvagaiḥ /
ādyaistaiḥ sasvaraiḥ kādyaistripurānāmamantrakāḥ //
91.d:
आइपल्लवितैः काद्यैः षोडशस्वरपूर्वगैः /
आद्यैस्तैः सस्वरैः काद्यैस्त्रिपुरानाममन्त्रकाः //
91.m:
Sprouting with 'āi', beginning with ka, preceded by the sixteen vowels,
first with those accompanied by vowels, beginning with ka, are the mantras of the name of Tripurā.

91.s:
hrīṃ vījāḥ praṇavādyāḥspur namo 'ntā yatra pūjane /
mantrā viṃśatisāhasrāḥ śataṃ ṣaṣṭhyadhikaṃ tataḥ //
:n
1 śobhanādikāḥ iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 287
91.d:
ह्रीं वीजाः प्रणवाद्याःस्पुर् नमो ऽन्ता यत्र पूजने /
मन्त्रा विंशतिसाहस्राः शतं षष्ठ्यधिकं ततः //
:न्
1 शोभनादिकाः इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 287
91.m:
Having the seed-syllable 'hrīṃ', preceded by the praṇava, and ending with 'namaḥ', wherever [used] in worship,
the mantras are twenty thousand, one hundred and sixty in number.
[...]
1 'śobhanādikāḥ' is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / [page 287]

91.s:
āṃ hrīṃ mantrāḥ sarasvatyāś caṇḍikāyāstathaiva ca /
tathā gauryāś ca durgāyā āṃ śrīṃ mantrāḥ śriyas tathā //
91.d:
आं ह्रीं मन्त्राः सरस्वत्याश् चण्डिकायास्तथैव च /
तथा गौर्याश् च दुर्गाया आं श्रीं मन्त्राः श्रियस् तथा //
91.m:
The mantras of Sarasvatī are 'āṃ hrīṃ', and likewise of Caṇḍikā;
likewise of Gaurī and of Durgā; the mantras of Śrī are 'āṃ śrīṃ'.

91.s:
tathākṣauṃ krauṃ mantrāḥ sūryasya(1) āṃ hauṃ mantrāḥśivasya ca /
āṃ gaṃ mantrā gaṇeśasya āṃ mantrāś ca tathā hareḥ //
91.d:
तथाक्षौं क्रौं मन्त्राः सूर्यस्य(1) आं हौं मन्त्राःशिवस्य च /
आं गं मन्त्रा गणेशस्य आं मन्त्राश् च तथा हरेः //
91.m:
Likewise the mantras of the Sun are 'akṣauṃ krauṃ', and the mantras of Śiva are 'āṃ hauṃ';
the mantras of Gaṇeśa are 'āṃ gaṃ', and likewise the mantras of Hari are 'āṃ'.

91.s:
śatārdhaikādhikaiḥ kādyais tathā ṣoḍaśabhiḥ kharaiḥ /
kādyaistaiḥ sasvaraisādyaiḥ kāntair mantrās tathākhilāḥ //
91.d:
शतार्धैकाधिकैः काद्यैस् तथा षोडशभिः खरैः /
काद्यैस्तैः सस्वरैसाद्यैः कान्तैर् मन्त्रास् तथाखिलाः //
91.m:
With the fifty-one [letters] beginning with ka, and likewise with the sixteen vowels,
with those beginning with ka accompanied by vowels, ending in ka, all mantras [are formed].

91.s:
ravīśadevīviṣṇūnāṃ svābdhidevendravartanāt /
śatatrayaṃ ṣaṣṭyadhikaṃ pratyekaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kramāt /
abhiṣikto japed dhyāyecchiṣyādīn dīkṣayedguruḥ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye nānāmantrādikathanaṃ nāma
ekanavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha dvinavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
pratiṣṭhāvidhikathanaṃ
91.d:
रवीशदेवीविष्णूनां स्वाब्धिदेवेन्द्रवर्तनात् /
शतत्रयं षष्ट्यधिकं प्रत्येकं मण्डलं क्रमात् /
अभिषिक्तो जपेद् ध्यायेच्छिष्यादीन् दीक्षयेद्गुरुः //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये नानामन्त्रादिकथनं नाम
एकनवतितमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ द्विनवतितमो ऽध्यायः
प्रतिष्ठाविधिकथनं
91.m:
For the Sun, Īśa, the Goddess, and Viṣṇu, by the operation of their own ocean and king of gods,
three hundred and sixty is each maṇḍala in sequence.
The consecrated guru should recite, meditate, and initiate disciples and others.
Thus in the primitive Great Purāṇa of Agni, the ninety-first chapter, entitled "The Description of Various Mantras and Other Matters."
Now the ninety-second chapter.
The Description of the Rules for Consecration

92.s:
īśvara uvāca
pratiṣṭhāṃ sampravakṣyāmi kramāt saṅkṣepato guha /
pīṭhaṃ śaktiṃ śivo liṅgaṃ tadyogaḥ sā śivāṇubhiḥ //
92.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
प्रतिष्ठां सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि क्रमात् सङ्क्षेपतो गुह /
पीठं शक्तिं शिवो लिङ्गं तद्योगः सा शिवाणुभिः //
92.m:
Īśvara said:
I shall explain consecration in sequence and in brief, O Guha.
The pedestal is Śakti, Śiva is the liṅga; their union is that [consecration] through Śiva mantras.

92.s:
pratiṣṭhāyāḥ pañca bhedāsteṣāṃ rūpaṃ vadāmi te /
yatra brahmaśilāyogaḥ sā pratiṣṭhā viśeṣataḥ //
92.d:
प्रतिष्ठायाः पञ्च भेदास्तेषां रूपं वदामि ते /
यत्र ब्रह्मशिलायोगः सा प्रतिष्ठा विशेषतः //
92.m:
There are five varieties of consecration; I shall describe their nature to you.
Where there is union with the Brahmā stone, that is consecration in the specific sense.

92.s:
sthāpanantu yathāyogaṃ pīṭha eva niveśanaṃ /
pratiṣṭhābhinnapīṭhasya sthitasthāpanamucyate //
92.d:
स्थापनन्तु यथायोगं पीठ एव निवेशनं /
प्रतिष्ठाभिन्नपीठस्य स्थितस्थापनमुच्यते //
92.m:
Installation (sthāpana), however, is placement in the pedestal according to rule.
The placement of an already existing [liṅga] whose pedestal is separate is called sthitasthāpana.

92.s:
utthāpanañca sā proktā liṅgoddhārapuraḥsarā /
yasyāṃ tu liṅgamāropya saṃskāraḥ kriyate budhaiḥ //
:n
1 tathā kṣau hrau mantrāḥ sūryasyeti ga, gha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 288
92.d:
उत्थापनञ्च सा प्रोक्ता लिङ्गोद्धारपुरःसरा /
यस्यां तु लिङ्गमारोप्य संस्कारः क्रियते बुधैः //
:न्
1 तथा क्षौ ह्रौ मन्त्राः सूर्यस्येति ग, घ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 288
92.m:
And raising (utthāpana) is proclaimed as that which is preceded by the removal of the liṅga,
wherein having erected the liṅga, consecration is performed by the wise.
[...]
1 'tathā kṣau hrau mantrāḥ sūryasya' is the reading in the manuscripts marked ga and gha. / [page 288]

92.s:
āthāpanaṃ taduddiṣṭaṃ dvidhā viṣṇvādikasya ca(1) /
āsu sarvāsu caitanyaṃ niyuñjīta paraṃ śivam //
92.d:
आथापनं तदुद्दिष्टं द्विधा विष्ण्वादिकस्य च(1) /
आसु सर्वासु चैतन्यं नियुञ्जीत परं शिवम् //
92.m:
Fixing (āsthāpana) is declared to be of two kinds, for Viṣṇu and others.
In all of these, one should unite consciousness with supreme Śiva.

92.s:
yadādhārādibhedena(2) prāsādeṣvapi pañcadhā /
parīkṣamatha medinyāḥ kuryātprāsādakāmyayā //
92.d:
यदाधारादिभेदेन(2) प्रासादेष्वपि पञ्चधा /
परीक्षमथ मेदिन्याः कुर्यात्प्रासादकाम्यया //
92.m:
According to the distinction of receptacle and the like, [consecration] is also fivefold in temples.
Then one should perform examination of the earth with the desire of [building] a temple.

92.s:
śuklājyagandhā raktā ca raktagandhā sugandhinī(3) /
pītā kṛṣṇā surāgandhā viprādīnāṃ mahī kramāt //
92.d:
शुक्लाज्यगन्धा रक्ता च रक्तगन्धा सुगन्धिनी(3) /
पीता कृष्णा सुरागन्धा विप्रादीनां मही क्रमात् //
92.m:
White with the smell of clarified butter, red with the smell of blood, fragrant,
yellow, and black with the smell of liquor: such is the ground in order for Brahmins and the other [castes].

92.s:
pūrveśottarasarvatra pūrvā caiṣāṃ viśiṣyate(4) /
ākhāte hāstike yasyāḥ pūrṇe mṛdadhikā bhavet //
92.d:
पूर्वेशोत्तरसर्वत्र पूर्वा चैषां विशिष्यते(4) /
आखाते हास्तिके यस्याः पूर्णे मृदधिका भवेत् //
92.m:
In the east, northeast, or north everywhere, and among these the east is distinguished
[The soil] on which, when a cubit-sized pit is dug and refilled, the earth exceeds [the pit]—

92.s:
uttamāntāṃ mahīṃ vidyāttoyādyair vā samukṣitāṃ /
asthyaṅgārādibhirduṣṭāmatyantaṃ śodhayed guruḥ(5) //
92.d:
उत्तमान्तां महीं विद्यात्तोयाद्यैर् वा समुक्षितां /
अस्थ्यङ्गारादिभिर्दुष्टामत्यन्तं शोधयेद् गुरुः(5) //
92.m:
The teacher should recognize that earth as excellent, or [test it] when sprinkled with water and the like
If corrupted with bones, charcoal, and the like, he should purify it thoroughly.

92.s:
nagaragrāmadurgārthaṃ gṛhaprāsādakāraṇaṃ(6) /
khananair gokulāvāsaiḥ karṣaṇair vā muhurmuhuḥ //
92.d:
नगरग्रामदुर्गार्थं गृहप्रासादकारणं(6) /
खननैर् गोकुलावासैः कर्षणैर् वा मुहुर्मुहुः //
92.m:
For a city, a village, or a fort, or to prepare [ground] for a house or temple,
by repeated digging, by pasturing herds of cattle, or by plowing [he should purify it].

92.s:
maṇḍape dvārapūjādi mantratṛptyavasānakaṃ(7) /
karma nirvartyāghorāstraṃ sahasraṃ(8) vidhinā yajet //
92.d:
मण्डपे द्वारपूजादि मन्त्रतृप्त्यवसानकं(7) /
कर्म निर्वर्त्याघोरास्त्रं सहस्रं(8) विधिना यजेत् //
92.m:
In the pavilion, having performed the rites beginning with the worship of the door and ending with the satisfaction of mantras,
he should worship the Aghorāstra [mantra] a thousand times according to the rules.

92.s:
samīkṛtyopaliptāyāṃ bhūmau saṃśodhayeddiśaḥ /
svarṇadadhyakṣatai rekhāḥ prakurvīta(9) pradakṣiṇaṃ //
92.d:
समीकृत्योपलिप्तायां भूमौ संशोधयेद्दिशः /
स्वर्णदध्यक्षतै रेखाः प्रकुर्वीत(9) प्रदक्षिणं //
92.m:
Having leveled and smeared the ground, he should purify the directions
With gold, curd, and unbroken grains he should draw lines in a clockwise direction.

92.s:
madhyādīśānakoṣṭasthe pūrṇakumbhe(10) śivaṃ yajet /
vāstumabhyarcya tattoyaiḥ siñcet kuddālakādikaṃ //
:n
1 utthāpanaścetyādi, viṣṇvādikasya cetyetyantaḥ
sārdhaikaślokātmakapāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti
2 yathādhārābhibhedeneti ga..
3 raktagandhānugandhīti kha..
4 praśasyate iti gha..
5 śodhayetdhruvamiti gha..
6 nagaragrāmetyardhaśloko gha. pustake nāsti
7 mantradīptyavasānakamiti ga.. / mantrabhūmyavasānakamiti gha..
8 nirvartya ghorāstraṃ mahāstramiti ga..
10 svarṇakuṇḍe iti ga.. / svarṇakumbhe iti gha.. , ṅa.. , ca
:p 289
92.d:
मध्यादीशानकोष्टस्थे पूर्णकुम्भे(10) शिवं यजेत् /
वास्तुमभ्यर्च्य तत्तोयैः सिञ्चेत् कुद्दालकादिकं //
:न्
1 उत्थापनश्चेत्यादि, विष्ण्वादिकस्य चेत्येत्यन्तः
सार्धैकश्लोकात्मकपाठो ग.. पुस्तके नास्ति
2 यथाधाराभिभेदेनेति ग..
3 रक्तगन्धानुगन्धीति ख..
4 प्रशस्यते इति घ..
5 शोधयेत्ध्रुवमिति घ..
6 नगरग्रामेत्यर्धश्लोको घ. पुस्तके नास्ति
7 मन्त्रदीप्त्यवसानकमिति ग.. / मन्त्रभूम्यवसानकमिति घ..
8 निर्वर्त्य घोरास्त्रं महास्त्रमिति ग..
10 स्वर्णकुण्डे इति ग.. / स्वर्णकुम्भे इति घ.. , ङ.. , च
:प् 289
92.m:
In a full pitcher placed in the chamber of Īśāna [northeast] from the center, he should worship Śiva
Having worshipped the site architecture, he should sprinkle the spade and other tools with that water.
[...]
1 The reading of one and a half verses, beginning with 'utthāpanaś ca...' and ending with 'viṣṇvādikasya ca...', is absent in manuscript ga.
2 'yathādhārābhibhedena' in ga.
3 'raktagandhānugandhī' in kha.
4 'praśasyate' in gha.
5 'śodhayed dhruvam' in gha.
6 The half-verse 'nagaragrāma...' is absent in manuscript gha.
7 'mantradīptyavasānakam' in ga. / 'mantrabhūmyavasānakam' in gha.
8 'nirvartya ghorāstraṃ mahāstram' in ga.
10 'svarṇakuṇḍe' in ga. / 'svarṇakumbhe' in gha., ṅa., and ca.
[Page 289]

92.s:
bāhye rakṣogaṇāniṣṭvā vidhinā digbalaṃ kṣipet /
bhūmiṃ saṃsicya saṃsnāpya(1) kuddālādyaṃ(2) prapūjayet //
92.d:
बाह्ये रक्षोगणानिष्ट्वा विधिना दिग्बलं क्षिपेत् /
भूमिं संसिच्य संस्नाप्य(1) कुद्दालाद्यं(2) प्रपूजयेत् //
92.m:
Having worshipped the hosts of demons outside, he should cast the directional offering according to rule
Having sprinkled and bathed the ground, he should worship the spade and other [tools].

92.s:
anyaṃ vastrayugacchajñaṃ kumbhaṃ skandhe dvijanmanaḥ /
nidhāya gītavādyādibrahmagoṣasamākulaṃ //
92.d:
अन्यं वस्त्रयुगच्छज्ञं कुम्भं स्कन्धे द्विजन्मनः /
निधाय गीतवाद्यादिब्रह्मगोषसमाकुलं //
92.m:
Having placed another pitcher covered with a pair of cloths upon the shoulder of a twice-born,
resounding with singing, musical instruments, and the recitation of Vedic mantras,

92.s:
pūjāṃ kumbhe samāhṛtya prāpte lagne 'gnikoṣṭhake /
kuddālenābhiṣiktena madhvaktena tu khānayet //
92.d:
पूजां कुम्भे समाहृत्य प्राप्ते लग्ने ऽग्निकोष्ठके /
कुद्दालेनाभिषिक्तेन मध्वक्तेन तु खानयेत् //
92.m:
and having performed worship in the pitcher, when the astrological moment arrives in the fire [southeast] chamber,
he should dig with the consecrated spade smeared with honey.

92.s:
nairṛtyāṃ kṣepayenmṛtsnāṃ khāte kumbhajalaṃ kṣipet /
purasya pūrvasīmantaṃ(3) nayed yāvadabhīpsitaṃ //
92.d:
नैरृत्यां क्षेपयेन्मृत्स्नां खाते कुम्भजलं क्षिपेत् /
पुरस्य पूर्वसीमन्तं(3) नयेद् यावदभीप्सितं //
92.m:
He should throw the earth toward the southwest, and pour the pitcher's water into the pit
He should lead it to the eastern boundary of the town, as far as desired.

92.s:
atha tatra kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā bhrāmayet(4) paritaḥ puraṃ /
siñcan sīmantacihnāni yāvadīśānagocaraṃ //
92.d:
अथ तत्र क्षणं स्थित्वा भ्रामयेत्(4) परितः पुरं /
सिञ्चन् सीमन्तचिह्नानि यावदीशानगोचरं //
92.m:
Then, staying there for a moment, he should circumambulate around the town,
sprinkling boundary-marks as far as the domain of Īśāna [northeast].

92.s:
arghyadānamidaṃ proktaṃ tatra kumbhaparibramāt /
itthaṃ parigrahaṃ bhūmeḥ kurvīta tadanantaraṃ //
92.d:
अर्घ्यदानमिदं प्रोक्तं तत्र कुम्भपरिब्रमात् /
इत्थं परिग्रहं भूमेः कुर्वीत तदनन्तरं //
92.m:
This is declared to be the offering of water because of the circumambulation with the pitcher
In this manner he should take possession of the ground; thereafter:

92.s:
karkarāntaṃ jalāntaṃ vā śalyadoṣajighāṃsayā /
khānayed bhūḥ kumārīṃ ced vidhinā śalyamuddharet //
92.d:
कर्करान्तं जलान्तं वा शल्यदोषजिघांसया /
खानयेद् भूः कुमारीं चेद् विधिना शल्यमुद्धरेत् //
92.m:
Down to gravel or down to water, wishing to destroy the flaw of hidden foreign matter,
he should have it excavated; if the earth is virgin, he should extract the foreign matter according to rule.

92.s:
akacaṭatapayaśahān mānavaścet praśnākṣarāṇi tu(5) /
agnerdhvajādipātitāḥ svasthāne śalyamākhyānti //
92.d:
अकचटतपयशहान् मानवश्चेत् प्रश्नाक्षराणि तु(5) /
अग्नेर्ध्वजादिपातिताः स्वस्थाने शल्यमाख्यान्ति //
92.m:
From the letters A, Ka, Ca, Ṭa, Ta, Pa, Ya, and Śa, if a person [asks], the query's syllables
projected from Agni onto the banner [series] indicate the foreign matter in its proper place.

92.s:
kartuścāṅgavikāreṇa jānīyāttatpramāṇataḥ /
paśvādīnāṃ praveśena kīrtanair virutair diśaḥ //
92.d:
कर्तुश्चाङ्गविकारेण जानीयात्तत्प्रमाणतः /
पश्वादीनां प्रवेशेन कीर्तनैर् विरुतैर् दिशः //
92.m:
And from the bodily movement of the client he should know its measure
From the entrance of animals and the like, by the mentions and cries, [he should know] the directions.

92.s:
mātṛkāmaṣṭavargāḍhyāṃ phalake bhuvi vā likhet /
śalyajñānaṃ vargavaśāt pūrvādīśāntataḥ(6) kramāt //
92.d:
मातृकामष्टवर्गाढ्यां फलके भुवि वा लिखेत् /
शल्यज्ञानं वर्गवशात् पूर्वादीशान्ततः(6) क्रमात् //
92.m:
He should write the syllabary rich in eight groups on a board or on the ground
The knowledge of foreign matter is by virtue of the groups, in order from the east ending with the northeast.

92.s:
avarge caiva lohantu kavarge 'ṅgāramagnitaḥ /
:n
1 bhūmiṃ saṃsicya saṃsthāpyeti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca
2 kuddālākhyamiti ga..
3 pūrvamīśāntamiti kha..
4 srāvayet iti kha..
5 nava cet praśnākṣarāṇi bhāṣante iti ga.. , gha.. ca
6 pūrvādīnāṃ tata iti kha..
:p 290
cavarge bhasma dakṣe syāṭ ṭavarge 'sthi ca nairṛte //
92.d:
अवर्गे चैव लोहन्तु कवर्गे ऽङ्गारमग्नितः /
:न्
1 भूमिं संसिच्य संस्थाप्येति ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. च
2 कुद्दालाख्यमिति ग..
3 पूर्वमीशान्तमिति ख..
4 स्रावयेत् इति ख..
5 नव चेत् प्रश्नाक्षराणि भाषन्ते इति ग.. , घ.. च
6 पूर्वादीनां तत इति ख..
:प् 290
चवर्गे भस्म दक्षे स्याट् टवर्गे ऽस्थि च नैरृते //
92.m:
In the A-group [there is] iron; in the Ka-group, charcoal from fire
[...]
1 'bhūmiṃ saṃsicya saṃsthāpya' in ga., gha., and ṅa.
2 'kuddālākhyam' in ga.
3 'pūrvamīśāntam' in kha.
4 'srāvayet' in kha.
5 'nava cet praśnākṣarāṇi bhāṣante' in ga. and gha.
6 'pūrvādīnāṃ tataḥ' in kha.
[Page 290]
In the Ca-group, there would be ashes in the south; in the Ṭa-group, bone in the southwest

92.s:
tavarge ceṣṭakā cāpye kapālañca pavargake /
yavarge śavakītādi śavarge lohamādiśet //
92.d:
तवर्गे चेष्टका चाप्ये कपालञ्च पवर्गके /
यवर्गे शवकीतादि शवर्गे लोहमादिशेत् //
92.m:
In the Ta-group, a brick in the west; and a skull in the Pa-group
In the Ya-group, a corpse, worms, and the like; in the Śa-group, he should declare iron

92.s:
havarge rajataṃ tadvadavargāccānarthakarānapi /
prīkṣyātmabhiḥ karāpūrair aṣṭāṅgulamṛdantaraiḥ //
92.d:
हवर्गे रजतं तद्वदवर्गाच्चानर्थकरानपि /
प्रीक्ष्यात्मभिः करापूरैर् अष्टाङ्गुलमृदन्तरैः //
92.m:
In the Ha-group, silver; likewise from the vowel-group [he should determine] baneful objects as well
Having inspected [these], with the soil at intervals of eight inches filling cubit-measures,

92.s:
pādonaṃ khātamāpūrya sajalair mudgarāhataiḥ(1) /
liptāṃ samaplavāṃ tatra kārayitvā bhuvaṃ guruḥ //
92.d:
पादोनं खातमापूर्य सजलैर् मुद्गराहतैः(1) /
लिप्तां समप्लवां तत्र कारयित्वा भुवं गुरुः //
92.m:
filling the pit to three-quarters with [earth] moistened with water and beaten with mallets,
and having the ground smeared and leveled there, the teacher,

92.s:
sāmānyārghyakaro yāyānmaṇḍapaṃ vakṣyāmāṇakaṃ /
toraṇadvāḥpatīniṣṭvā pratyagdvāreṇa saṃviśet //
92.d:
सामान्यार्घ्यकरो यायान्मण्डपं वक्ष्यामाणकं /
तोरणद्वाःपतीनिष्ट्वा प्रत्यग्द्वारेण संविशेत् //
92.m:
holding the general water offering, should proceed to the pavilion to be described
Having worshipped the guardian deities of the arched gateway and doors, he should enter through the western door.

92.s:
kuryāttatrātmaśuddhyādi kuṇḍamaṇḍapasaṃskṛtiṃ /
kalasaṃ vardhanīsaktaṃ(2) lokapālaśivārcanaṃ //
92.d:
कुर्यात्तत्रात्मशुद्ध्यादि कुण्डमण्डपसंस्कृतिं /
कलसं वर्धनीसक्तं(2) लोकपालशिवार्चनं //
92.m:
He should perform the purification of himself and other rites there, the consecration of the fire-pit and pavilion,
the water-pot associated with the Vardhanī pitcher, and the worship of Śiva and the world-protectors.

92.s:
agnerjananapūjādi sarvaṃ pūrvavadācaret /
yajamānānvito(3) yāyācchilānāṃ snānamaṇḍapaṃ //
92.d:
अग्नेर्जननपूजादि सर्वं पूर्ववदाचरेत् /
यजमानान्वितो(3) यायाच्छिलानां स्नानमण्डपं //
92.m:
He should perform the birth and worship of the fire and all [else] as previously
Accompanied by the patron, he should go to the bathing pavilion of the stones.

92.s:
śilāḥ prāsādaliṅgasya pādadharmādisañjñakāḥ /
aṣṭāṅgulocchritāḥ śastāś caturasrāḥ karāyatāḥ //
92.d:
शिलाः प्रासादलिङ्गस्य पादधर्मादिसञ्ज्ञकाः /
अष्टाङ्गुलोच्छ्रिताः शस्ताश् चतुरस्राः करायताः //
92.m:
The stones of the temple and liṅga, named the 'foot', 'dharma', and so forth,
eight inches high, square, and a cubit in length are commended.

92.s:
pāṣāṇānāṃ śilāḥ kāryā iṣṭakānāṃ tadardhataḥ /
prāsāde 'śmaśilāḥ śaile iṣṭakā iṣṭakāmaye //
92.d:
पाषाणानां शिलाः कार्या इष्टकानां तदर्धतः /
प्रासादे ऽश्मशिलाः शैले इष्टका इष्टकामये //
92.m:
The stones should be made of rock, or of brick [at] half of that [size]
In a stone temple they are stone slabs; in a brick [temple], made of brick.

92.s:
aṅkitā navavaktrādyaiḥ(4) paṅkajāḥ paṅkajāṅkitāḥ /
nandā bhadrā jayā riktā pūrṇākhyā pañcamī matā(5) //
92.d:
अङ्किता नववक्त्राद्यैः(4) पङ्कजाः पङ्कजाङ्किताः /
नन्दा भद्रा जया रिक्ता पूर्णाख्या पञ्चमी मता(5) //
92.m:
Marked with the nine faces and the like, lotuses, marked with lotuses;
Nandā, Bhadrā, Jayā, Riktā, and Pūrṇā is considered the fifth.

92.s:
āsāṃ padmo mahāpadmaḥ śaṅkho 'tha makaras tathā /
samudraśceti pañcāmī nidhikumbhāḥ kramādhaḥ //
92.d:
आसां पद्मो महापद्मः शङ्खो ऽथ मकरस् तथा /
समुद्रश्चेति पञ्चामी निधिकुम्भाः क्रमाधः //
92.m:
Of these, Padma, Mahāpadma, Śaṅkha, then Makara,
and Samudra: these five are the treasure-pitchers [placed] below in order.

92.s:
nandā bhadrā jayā pūrṇā ajitā cāparājitā /
:n
1 muśalair mudgarāhatair iti ṅa..
2 vardhanīyuktamiti ga.. , ṅa.. ca
3 yajamānārcita iti gha..
4 navarudrādyair iti gha..
5 pāṣāṇānāmityādiḥ, pañcamīrmatā ity antaḥ
ślokadvayātmakapāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti
:p 291
vijayā maṅgalākhyā ca dharaṇī navamī śilā //
92.d:
नन्दा भद्रा जया पूर्णा अजिता चापराजिता /
:न्
1 मुशलैर् मुद्गराहतैर् इति ङ..
2 वर्धनीयुक्तमिति ग.. , ङ.. च
3 यजमानार्चित इति घ..
4 नवरुद्राद्यैर् इति घ..
5 पाषाणानामित्यादिः, पञ्चमीर्मता इत्य् अन्तः
श्लोकद्वयात्मकपाठो ग.. पुस्तके नास्ति
:प् 291
विजया मङ्गलाख्या च धरणी नवमी शिला //
92.m:
Nandā, Bhadrā, Jayā, Pūrṇā, Ajitā, and Aparājitā,
[...]
1 'muśalair mudgarāhataiḥ' in ṅa.
2 'vardhanīyuktam' in ga. and ṅa.
3 'yajamānārcitaḥ' in gha.
4 'navarudrādyaiḥ' in gha.
5 The reading of two verses, beginning with 'pāṣāṇānām...' and ending with 'pañcamī matā', is absent in manuscript ga.
[Page 291]
Vijayā, the one named Maṅgalā, and Dharaṇī as the ninth stone

92.s:
subhadraś ca vibhadraś ca sunandaḥ puṣpanandakaḥ(1) /
jayo 'tha vijayaś caiva kumbhaḥ pūrṇastathottaraḥ(2) //
92.d:
सुभद्रश् च विभद्रश् च सुनन्दः पुष्पनन्दकः(1) /
जयो ऽथ विजयश् चैव कुम्भः पूर्णस्तथोत्तरः(2) //
92.m:
Subhadra, Vibhadra, Sunanda, Puṣpanandaka,
Jaya, and Vijaya, Kumbha, Pūrṇa, and likewise Uttara

92.s:
navānāntu yathāsaṅkhyaṃ nidhikumbhaḥ pūrṇastathottaraḥ(2) /
āsanaṃ prathamaṃ dattvā(3) tāḍyollikhyaśarāṇunā(4)//
92.d:
नवानान्तु यथासङ्ख्यं निधिकुम्भः पूर्णस्तथोत्तरः(2) /
आसनं प्रथमं दत्त्वा(3) ताड्योल्लिख्यशराणुना(4)//
92.m:
are the treasure-pitchers of the nine in order of enumeration.
Having first given a seat, striking and inscribing with the arrow-mantra,

92.s:
sarvāsāmaviśeṣeṇa tanutreṇāvaguṇṭhanaṃ(5) /
mṛdbhirgomayayogāmūtrakaṣāyair gandhavāriṇā //
92.d:
सर्वासामविशेषेण तनुत्रेणावगुण्ठनं(5) /
मृद्भिर्गोमययोगामूत्रकषायैर् गन्धवारिणा //
92.m:
[there should be] veiling with the armor-mantra for all of them without distinction
With earths, a mixture of cow dung, urine, astringent decoctions, and perfumed water,

92.s:
astreṇa hūṃ phaḍantena(6) malasnānaṃ samācaret /
vidhinā pañcagavyena snānaṃ pañcāmṛtena ca //
92.d:
अस्त्रेण हूं फडन्तेन(6) मलस्नानं समाचरेत् /
विधिना पञ्चगव्येन स्नानं पञ्चामृतेन च //
92.m:
with the weapon-mantra ending in 'hūṃ phaṭ', he should perform the cleansing bath
according to rule, [followed by] a bath with the five products of the cow and with the five nectars.

92.s:
gandhatoyāntaraṃ kuryānnijanāmāṅkitāṇunā(7) /
phalaratnasuvarṇānāṃ gośṛṅgasalilaistataḥ //
92.d:
गन्धतोयान्तरं कुर्यान्निजनामाङ्किताणुना(7) /
फलरत्नसुवर्णानां गोशृङ्गसलिलैस्ततः //
92.m:
He should make an interval with perfumed water, using the mantra marked with its own name;
then with water [containing] fruits, gems, gold, and [water poured from] a cow's horn,

92.s:
candanena samālabhya(8) vastrair ācchādayecchilāṃ /
svarṇotthamāsanaṃ datvā nītvā yāgaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ //
92.d:
चन्दनेन समालभ्य(8) वस्त्रैर् आच्छादयेच्छिलां /
स्वर्णोत्थमासनं दत्वा नीत्वा यागं प्रदक्षिणं //
92.m:
anointing the stone with sandalwood paste, he should cover it with cloths
Having offered a seat made of gold, and leading [it] clockwise around the sacrifice,

92.s:
śayyāyāṃ kuśatalpe vā hṛdayena niveśayet(9) /
sampūjya nyasya buddhyādidharāntaṃ tattvasañcayaṃ //
92.d:
शय्यायां कुशतल्पे वा हृदयेन निवेशयेत्(9) /
सम्पूज्य न्यस्य बुद्ध्यादिधरान्तं तत्त्वसञ्चयं //
92.m: He should deposit [them] upon a couch or upon a bed of kuśa grass with the heart mantra, / having worshipped and placed the aggregate of cosmic principles from intellect ending with earth.

92.s:
trikhaṇḍavyāpakaṃ tattvatrayañcānukramān nyaset /
buddhyādau cittaparyante cintātanmātrakāvadhau(10) //
:n
1 puṣpadantaka it kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca
2 pūrvastathottara iti gha..
3 praṇavaṃ datvā iti kha..
4 śarātmaneti kha.. , ga.. , ca
5 tanmātreṇāvaguṇṭhanamiti kha..
6 huṃ phaḍanteneti ga..
7 kuryād dvijanāmāṅkitātmaneti kha.. / kuryān nijanāmāṅkitātmaneti
ga..
8 samālipyeti ga..
9 kuśatalpe vā hṝdayena viśeṣayet iti kha.. / kuśatalpe ca hṛdayena
niveśayet iti ga..
10 buddhyādau cittaparyante cittatanmātrakāvadhau iti gha.. / sampacya ity
ādiḥ tanmātrakāvadhāvityantaḥ sārdhaikaślokapāṭho ga.. pustake
nāsti
:p 292
92.d:
त्रिखण्डव्यापकं तत्त्वत्रयञ्चानुक्रमान् न्यसेत् /
बुद्ध्यादौ चित्तपर्यन्ते चिन्तातन्मात्रकावधौ(10) //
:न्
1 पुष्पदन्तक इत् ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. च
2 पूर्वस्तथोत्तर इति घ..
3 प्रणवं दत्वा इति ख..
4 शरात्मनेति ख.. , ग.. , च
5 तन्मात्रेणावगुण्ठनमिति ख..
6 हुं फडन्तेनेति ग..
7 कुर्याद् द्विजनामाङ्कितात्मनेति ख.. / कुर्यान् निजनामाङ्कितात्मनेति
ग..
8 समालिप्येति ग..
9 कुशतल्पे वा हॄदयेन विशेषयेत् इति ख.. / कुशतल्पे च हृदयेन
निवेशयेत् इति ग..
10 बुद्ध्यादौ चित्तपर्यन्ते चित्ततन्मात्रकावधौ इति घ.. / सम्पच्य इत्य्
आदिः तन्मात्रकावधावित्यन्तः सार्धैकश्लोकपाठो ग.. पुस्तके
नास्ति
:प् 292
92.m:
He should deposit in sequence the three cosmic principles that pervade the three sections, / from intellect down to the mind, extending up to the subtle elements of perception;
[...]
1. 'puṣpadantaka' in manuscripts kha, ga, gha, and ṅa.
2. 'eastern and likewise northern' in gha.
3. 'having given the praṇava' in kha.
4. 'by means of an arrow' in kha and ga.
5. 'veiling with the subtle element' in kha.
6. 'ending with huṃ phaṭ' in ga.
7. 'he should make it marked with the name of the twice-born' in kha; 'he should make it marked with his own name' in ga.
8. 'having smeared completely' in ga.
9. 'or upon a bed of kuśa grass he should distinguish with the heart mantra' in kha; 'and upon a bed of kuśa grass he should deposit with the heart mantra' in ga.
10. 'from intellect down to the mind, extending up to the mind and subtle elements' in gha. / The text of one and a half verses beginning with 'having cooked' and ending with 'extending up to the subtle elements' is absent in manuscript ga. / Page 292.

92.s:
tanmātrādau dharānte ca śivavidyātmanāṃ sthitiḥ /
tattvāni nijamantreṇa tattveśāṃś ca hṛdārcayet //
92.d:
तन्मात्रादौ धरान्ते च शिवविद्यात्मनां स्थितिः /
तत्त्वानि निजमन्त्रेण तत्त्वेशांश् च हृदार्चयेत् //
92.m: from the subtle elements down to earth is the presence of Śiva, Vidyā, and Ātman. / He should worship the cosmic principles with their own mantras and the lords of the cosmic principles with the heart mantra,

92.s:
sthāneṣu puṣpamālādicihniteṣu yathākramaṃ /
oṃ hūṃ(1) śivatattvāya namaḥ / oṃ hūṃ(2) śivatattvādhipataye
rudrāya namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ vidyātattvāya namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ(3)
vidyātattvādhipāya(4) viṣṇave namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ ātmatattvāya
namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ ātmatattvādhipataye brahmaṇe namaḥ(5)
kṣamāgniyajamānārkān jalavātendukhāni ca //
92.d:
स्थानेषु पुष्पमालादिचिह्नितेषु यथाक्रमं /
ओं हूं(1) शिवतत्त्वाय नमः / ओं हूं(2) शिवतत्त्वाधिपतये
रुद्राय नमः / ओं हां विद्यातत्त्वाय नमः / ओं हां(3)
विद्यातत्त्वाधिपाय(4) विष्णवे नमः / ओं हां आत्मतत्त्वाय
नमः / ओं हां आत्मतत्त्वाधिपतये ब्रह्मणे नमः(5)
क्षमाग्नियजमानार्कान् जलवातेन्दुखानि च //
92.m:
in their places marked with garlands of flowers and the like in due order:
‘Oṃ hūṃ, homage to the Śiva-principle! Oṃ hūṃ, homage to Rudra, the presiding lord of the Śiva-principle! Oṃ hāṃ, homage to the Vidyā-principle! Oṃ hāṃ, homage to Viṣṇu, the presiding lord of the Vidyā-principle! Oṃ hāṃ, homage to the Ātma-principle!
Oṃ hāṃ, homage to Brahmā, the presiding lord of the Ātma-principle!’
Earth, fire, sacrificer, sun, water, wind, moon, and ether—

92.s:
pratitattvaṃ nyasedaṣṭau mūrtīḥ pratiśilāṃ śilāṃ /
sarvaṃ paśupatiṃ cograṃ(6) rudraṃ bhavamatheśvaraṃ(7) //
92.d:
प्रतितत्त्वं न्यसेदष्टौ मूर्तीः प्रतिशिलां शिलां /
सर्वं पशुपतिं चोग्रं(6) रुद्रं भवमथेश्वरं(7) //
92.m: on each cosmic principle he should deposit the eight forms, stone by stone: / Śarva, Paśupati, and Ugra, Rudra, Bhava, then Īśvara,

92.s:
mahādevaṃ ca bhīmaṃ ca mūrtīśāṃś ca yathākramāt /
oṃ dharāmūrtaye namaḥ, oṃ dharādhipataye namaḥ,ityādimantrān lokapālān yathāsaṅkhyaṃ nijāṇubhiḥ(8) //
92.d:
महादेवं च भीमं च मूर्तीशांश् च यथाक्रमात् /
ओं धरामूर्तये नमः, ओं धराधिपतये नमः,इत्यादिमन्त्रान् लोकपालान् यथासङ्ख्यं निजाणुभिः(8) //
92.m: and Mahādeva and Bhīma, and the lords of the forms in due order: / mantras such as ‘Oṃ, homage to the Earth-form; Oṃ, homage to the Lord of the Earth,’ [and then] the guardians of the world according to their number with their own seeds.

92.s:
vinyasya pūjayet kumbhāṃstanmantrair vā nijāṇubhiḥ(9) /
indrādīnāṃ tu vījāni vakṣyamāṇakrameṇa tu //
lūṃ rūṃ śūṃ pūṃ vūṃ yūṃ mūṃ hūṃ
kṣūmiti(10)
92.d:
विन्यस्य पूजयेत् कुम्भांस्तन्मन्त्रैर् वा निजाणुभिः(9) /
इन्द्रादीनां तु वीजानि वक्ष्यमाणक्रमेण तु //
लूं रूं शूं पूं वूं यूं मूं हूं
क्षूमिति(10)
92.m:
Having deposited [them], he should worship the water jars with those mantras or with their own syllables. / The seed-syllables of Indra and the others, however, are in the order to be stated:
‘lūṃ, rūṃ, śūṃ, pūṃ, vūṃ, yūṃ, mūṃ, hūṃ, kṣūṃ.’

92.s:
ukto navaśilāpakṣaḥ śilā pañcapadā tathā /
:n
1,2 oṃ hraṃ iti ga.. , gha.. ca
3 oṃ hīṃ iti gha..
4 vidyātattvādhipataye iti kha..
5 oṃ hūṃ śivatattvādhipataye ity ādiḥ, oṃ hāṃ
ātmatattvādhipataye brahmaṇe nama ity antaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake
nāsti
6 paśupatiṃ bhīmamiti gha..
7 bhavamakheśvaram iti gha..
8,9 nijātmabhiriti kha.. , ga.. / vinyasyetyardhaśloko ga.. pustake nāsti
10 oṃ hūṃ ghūṃ būṃ yūṃ mūṃ haṃ kṣamitīti ga.. / oṃ
kaṃ sūṃ pūṃ śūṃ hrūṃ kṣamitīti gha.. / lūṃ rūṃ
śūṃ pūṃ vūṃ cūṃ mūṃ hūṃ kṣūmitīti kha..
:p 293
pratitattvaṃ nyasenmūrtīḥ sṛṣṭyā pañca dharādikāḥ //
92.d:
उक्तो नवशिलापक्षः शिला पञ्चपदा तथा /
:न्
1,2 ओं ह्रं इति ग.. , घ.. च
3 ओं हीं इति घ..
4 विद्यातत्त्वाधिपतये इति ख..
5 ओं हूं शिवतत्त्वाधिपतये इत्य् आदिः, ओं हां
आत्मतत्त्वाधिपतये ब्रह्मणे नम इत्य् अन्तः पाठो ग.. पुस्तके
नास्ति
6 पशुपतिं भीममिति घ..
7 भवमखेश्वरम् इति घ..
8,9 निजात्मभिरिति ख.. , ग.. / विन्यस्येत्यर्धश्लोको ग.. पुस्तके नास्ति
10 ओं हूं घूं बूं यूं मूं हं क्षमितीति ग.. / ओं
कं सूं पूं शूं ह्रूं क्षमितीति घ.. / लूं रूं
शूं पूं वूं चूं मूं हूं क्षूमितीति ख..
:प् 293
प्रतितत्त्वं न्यसेन्मूर्तीः सृष्ट्या पञ्च धरादिकाः //
92.m:
The nine-stone option has thus been described; likewise the five-station stone [option]:
[...]
1, 2. 'oṃ hraṃ' in ga and gha.
3. 'oṃ hīṃ' in gha.
4. 'vidyātattvādhipataye' in kha.
5. The reading beginning with 'oṃ hūṃ homage to the presiding lord of the Śiva-principle' and ending with 'oṃ hāṃ homage to Brahmā, the presiding lord of the Ātma-principle' is absent in manuscript ga.
6. 'paśupatiṃ bhīmam' in gha.
7. 'bhavamakheśvaram' in gha.
8, 9. 'nijātmabhiḥ' in kha and ga; the half-verse beginning with 'vinyasya' is absent in manuscript ga.
10. 'oṃ hūṃ ghūṃ būṃ yūṃ mūṃ haṃ kṣam' in ga; 'oṃ kaṃ sūṃ pūṃ śūṃ hrūṃ kṣam' in gha; 'lūṃ rūṃ śūṃ pūṃ vūṃ cūṃ mūṃ hūṃ kṣūm' in kha. / Page 293.
For each cosmic principle he should deposit five forms according to cosmic projection, beginning with earth:

92.s:
brahmā viṣṇus tathā rudra īśvaraś ca sadāśivaḥ /
ete ca pañca mūrtīśā yaṣṭavyāstāsu(1) pūrvavat //
oṃ pṛthvīmūrtaye namaḥ / oṃ pṛthvīmūrtyadhipataye
brahmaṇe namaḥ / ity ādi mantrāḥ
92.d:
ब्रह्मा विष्णुस् तथा रुद्र ईश्वरश् च सदाशिवः /
एते च पञ्च मूर्तीशा यष्टव्यास्तासु(1) पूर्ववत् //
ओं पृथ्वीमूर्तये नमः / ओं पृथ्वीमूर्त्यधिपतये
ब्रह्मणे नमः / इत्य् आदि मन्त्राः
92.m:
Brahmā, Viṣṇu, likewise Rudra, Īśvara, and Sadāśiva; / and these five lords of forms are to be worshipped upon them as before:
‘Oṃ, homage to the Earth-form! Oṃ, homage to Brahmā, the presiding lord of the Earth-form!’—such are the mantras.

92.s:
sampūjya kalaśān pañca krameṇa nijanāmabhiḥ /
nirundhīta(2) vidhānena nyāso madhyaśilākramāt //
92.d:
सम्पूज्य कलशान् पञ्च क्रमेण निजनामभिः /
निरुन्धीत(2) विधानेन न्यासो मध्यशिलाक्रमात् //
92.m: Having worshipped the five water pots in sequence with their own names, / he should confine [them] according to rule. The deposition is in the order of the central stone.

92.s:
kuryāt prākāramantreṇa bhūtidarbhaistataḥ /
kuṇḍeṣu dhārikāṃ śaktiṃ vinyasyābhyarcya tarpayet //
92.d:
कुर्यात् प्राकारमन्त्रेण भूतिदर्भैस्ततः /
कुण्डेषु धारिकां शक्तिं विन्यस्याभ्यर्च्य तर्पयेत् //
92.m: Then he should make an enclosure with the protective-wall mantra using ashes and darbha grass; / having deposited the bearing power into the fire-pits and worshipped her, he should offer libation

92.s:
tattvatattvādhipān mūrtīrmūrtīśāṃś ca(3) ghṛtādibhiḥ /
tato brahmāṃśaśuddhyarthaṃ mūlāṅgaṃ brahmabhiḥ kramāt //
92.d:
तत्त्वतत्त्वाधिपान् मूर्तीर्मूर्तीशांश् च(3) घृतादिभिः /
ततो ब्रह्मांशशुद्ध्यर्थं मूलाङ्गं ब्रह्मभिः क्रमात् //
92.m: with ghee and the like to the cosmic principles, their lords, the forms, and the lords of the forms. / Then, for the purification of the Brahmā-portion, performing in order the primary and secondary limbs with the Brahmā mantras,

92.s:
kṛtvā śatādipūrṇāntaṃ prokṣyāḥ śāntijalaiḥśilāḥ(4) /
pūjayecca kuśaiḥ spṛṣṭvā pratitattvamanukramāt //
92.d:
कृत्वा शतादिपूर्णान्तं प्रोक्ष्याः शान्तिजलैःशिलाः(4) /
पूजयेच्च कुशैः स्पृष्ट्वा प्रतितत्त्वमनुक्रमात् //
92.m: ending with one hundred [oblations] up to the full oblation, the stones are to be sprinkled with the water of pacification. / Touching them with kuśa grass, he should worship them in sequence for each cosmic principle.

92.s:
sāṃnidhyamatha sandhānaṃ kṛtvā śuddhaṃ(5) punarnyaset(6) /
evaṃ bhāgatraye karma gatvā gatvā samācaret //
92.d:
सांनिध्यमथ सन्धानं कृत्वा शुद्धं(5) पुनर्न्यसेत्(6) /
एवं भागत्रये कर्म गत्वा गत्वा समाचरेत् //
92.m: Having effected presence and then connection, he should deposit them purified once more; / thus, proceeding repeatedly, he should perform the rite upon the three divisions:

92.s:
oṃ āṃ īṃ ātmatattvavidyātattvābhyāṃ namaḥ(7) iti /
:n
1 nyastavystāsu iti kha..
2 nibadhnītīti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. ca
3 tatra tatrādhipān mūrtīrmūrtīśāṃśceti ṅa.. /
tantratattvādhipān mūrtīrmūrtīśāṃsveti kha..
4 prokṣya śāntijalaiḥ śilāmiti kha.. / prokṣya śāntijalaiḥ śilā
iti ga.. , gha.. ca
5 kṛtvā mantramiti ga..
6 sānnidhyamityarthaśloko ṅa.. pustake nāsti / sānnidhyamatha sandhānaṃ
ity ataḥ paraṃ hrasvadīrghaprayogataḥ ity ataḥ
prāṅmadhvagapāṭho gha.. pustake nāsti
7 oṃ āṃ hāṃ ātmatattvavidyātattvāya nama iti ga.. / oṃ āṃ iṃ
uṃ vidyātattvaśivatattvābhyāṃ nama iti ḍa.. / oṃ āṃ iṃ
ātmavidyātattvāya nama iti kha..
:p 294
saṃspṛśed darbhamūlādyair brahmāṅgāditrayaṃ kramāt /
kuryāttattvānusandhānaṃ hrasvadīrghaprayogataḥ //
92.d:
ओं आं ईं आत्मतत्त्वविद्यातत्त्वाभ्यां नमः(7) इति /
:न्
1 न्यस्तव्य्स्तासु इति ख..
2 निबध्नीतीति ख.. , ग.. , ङ.. च
3 तत्र तत्राधिपान् मूर्तीर्मूर्तीशांश्चेति ङ.. /
तन्त्रतत्त्वाधिपान् मूर्तीर्मूर्तीशांस्वेति ख..
4 प्रोक्ष्य शान्तिजलैः शिलामिति ख.. / प्रोक्ष्य शान्तिजलैः शिला
इति ग.. , घ.. च
5 कृत्वा मन्त्रमिति ग..
6 सान्निध्यमित्यर्थश्लोको ङ.. पुस्तके नास्ति / सान्निध्यमथ सन्धानं
इत्य् अतः परं ह्रस्वदीर्घप्रयोगतः इत्य् अतः
प्राङ्मध्वगपाठो घ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
7 ओं आं हां आत्मतत्त्वविद्यातत्त्वाय नम इति ग.. / ओं आं इं
उं विद्यातत्त्वशिवतत्त्वाभ्यां नम इति ड.. / ओं आं इं
आत्मविद्यातत्त्वाय नम इति ख..
:प् 294
संस्पृशेद् दर्भमूलाद्यैर् ब्रह्माङ्गादित्रयं क्रमात् /
कुर्यात्तत्त्वानुसन्धानं ह्रस्वदीर्घप्रयोगतः //
92.m:
‘Oṃ āṃ īṃ, homage to the Ātma-principle and the Vidyā-principle!’
[...]
1. 'nyastavyāstāsu' in kha.
2. 'nibadhnāti' in kha, ga, and ṅa.
3. 'tatra tatrādhipān mūrtīrmūrtīśāṃśceti' in ṅa.
4. 'tantratattvādhipān mūrtīrmūrtīśāṃsve' in kha.
5. 'prokṣya śāntijalaiḥ śilām' in kha; 'prokṣya śāntijalaiḥ śilā' in ga and gha.
6. 'kṛtvā mantram' in ga.
7. The half-verse beginning with 'sānnidhyam' is absent in manuscript ṅa. / The text between 'sānnidhyamatha sandhānam' and 'hrasvadīrghaprayogataḥ' is absent in manuscript gha.
8. 'oṃ āṃ hāṃ ātmatattvavidyātattvāya namaḥ' in ga; 'oṃ āṃ iṃ uṃ vidyātattvaśivatattvābhyāṃ namaḥ' in ḍa; 'oṃ āṃ iṃ ātmavidyātattvāya namaḥ' in kha. / Page 294.
He should touch the triad of the Brahmā-mantras, the limbs, and so forth in sequence with the roots and tips of darbha grass.
He should perform the unification of the cosmic principles through the application of short and long [vowels]:

92.s:
oṃ hāṃ uṃ(1) vidyātattvaśivatattvābhyāṃ namaḥ /
ghṛtena madhunā pūrṇāṃstāmrakumbhān saratnakān /
pañcagavyārghyarsasiktān(2) lokapālādhidaivatān //
92.d:
ओं हां उं(1) विद्यातत्त्वशिवतत्त्वाभ्यां नमः /
घृतेन मधुना पूर्णांस्ताम्रकुम्भान् सरत्नकान् /
पञ्चगव्यार्घ्यर्ससिक्तान्(2) लोकपालाधिदैवतान् //
92.m: ‘Oṃ hāṃ uṃ, homage to the Vidyā-principle and the Śiva-principle!’ / [Placing] copper jars filled with ghee and honey, containing gems, / sprinkled with pañcagavya and offering-water, having the world guardians as their presiding deities,

92.s:
pūjayitvā nijair mantraiḥ sannidhau homamācaret /
śilānāmatha sarvāsāṃ saṃsmaredadhidaivatāḥ //
92.d:
पूजयित्वा निजैर् मन्त्रैः सन्निधौ होममाचरेत् /
शिलानामथ सर्वासां संस्मरेदधिदैवताः //
92.m: and having worshipped them with their own mantras, he should perform fire oblation in their presence. / Then he should contemplate the presiding deities of all the stones:

92.s:
vidyārūpāḥ kṛtasnānā hemavārṇāḥ śilāmbarāḥ /
nyūnādidoṣamoṣārthaṃ(3) vāstubhūmeś ca śuddhaye /
yajedastreṇa mūrdhāntamāhutīnāṃ(4) śataṃ śataṃ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye śilānyāsakathanaṃ nāma dvinavatitamo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha trinavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
vāstupūjādividhānam
92.d:
विद्यारूपाः कृतस्नाना हेमवार्णाः शिलाम्बराः /
न्यूनादिदोषमोषार्थं(3) वास्तुभूमेश् च शुद्धये /
यजेदस्त्रेण मूर्धान्तमाहुतीनां(4) शतं शतं //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये शिलान्यासकथनं नाम द्विनवतितमो
ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ त्रिनवतितमो ऽध्यायः
वास्तुपूजादिविधानम्
92.m:
possessing the form of Vidyā, bathed, gold-coloured, wearing garments of stone. / For the eradication of defects such as deficiency and the like, and for the purification of the architectural site, / he should offer one hundred oblations for each with the weapon mantra, concluding at the crown.
Thus ends the ninety-second chapter, named “The Exposition of the Laying of the Foundation Stone,” in the venerable and great Āgneyapurāṇa.
Now, the ninety-third chapter:
The ritual rules for the worship of the site architecture deity, and related topics.

93.s:
īśvara uvāca
tataḥ prāsādamāsūtrya vartayedvāstumaṇḍapaṃ(5) /
kuryāt koṣṭhacatuḥṣaṣṭiṃ kṣetre vedāsrake same //
93.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
ततः प्रासादमासूत्र्य वर्तयेद्वास्तुमण्डपं(5) /
कुर्यात् कोष्ठचतुःषष्टिं क्षेत्रे वेदास्रके समे //
93.m: The Lord said: / Then, having demarcated the ground for the temple with cords, one should mark out the site architecture pavilion. / In a square, level plot, one should make sixty-four squares.

93.s:
koṇeṣu vinyased vaṃśau(6) rajjavo 'ṣṭau vikoṇagāḥ /
:n
1 oṃ iṃ uṃ iti gha.. , ṅ. ca
2 pañcagavyena saṃsiktān iti ga..
3 nyūnādidoṣanāśārthamiti gha..
4 yajedasreṇa śuddhyarthamāhutīnāmiti gha..
5 vāstumaṇḍalamiti ga. ṅa.. / tata iti ślokārdhaṃ gha.. pustake
nāsti
6 vinyasedvaṃśamiti kha..
:p 295
dvipadāḥ ṣaṭpadāstāstu vāstuntatrārcayed yathā //
93.d:
कोणेषु विन्यसेद् वंशौ(6) रज्जवो ऽष्टौ विकोणगाः /
:न्
1 ओं इं उं इति घ.. , ङ्. च
2 पञ्चगव्येन संसिक्तान् इति ग..
3 न्यूनादिदोषनाशार्थमिति घ..
4 यजेदस्रेण शुद्ध्यर्थमाहुतीनामिति घ..
5 वास्तुमण्डलमिति ग. ङ.. / तत इति श्लोकार्धं घ.. पुस्तके
नास्ति
6 विन्यसेद्वंशमिति ख..
:प् 295
द्विपदाः षट्पदास्तास्तु वास्तुन्तत्रार्चयेद् यथा //
93.m:
One should lay two diagonal beams across the corners, and eight cords along the oblique directions.
1. [Variant:] “oṃ iṃ uṃ” in manuscripts gha and ṅa.
2. [Variant:] “sprinkled with the five products of the cow” in manuscript ga.
3. [Variant:] “for the removal of defects such as deficiency” in manuscript gha.
4. [Variant:] “one should sacrifice with the weapon[-mantra] for purification…” in manuscript gha.
5. [Variant:] “vāstumaṇḍalam” in manuscripts ga and ṅa; the half-verse beginning with “tataḥ” is missing in manuscript gha.
6. [Variant:] “vinyasedvaṃśam” in manuscript kha.
These occupy two squares or six squares; therein one should worship the site architecture deity accordingly.

93.s:
ākuñcitakacaṃ(1) vāstumuttānamasurākṛtiṃ(2) /
smaret pūjāsu kuḍyādiniveśe uttarānanaṃ //
93.d:
आकुञ्चितकचं(1) वास्तुमुत्तानमसुराकृतिं(2) /
स्मरेत् पूजासु कुड्यादिनिवेशे उत्तराननं //
93.m: One should visualize the site architecture deity with curly hair, lying supine, having the form of an Asura, / facing north during rituals of worship and the positioning of walls and other structures.

93.s:
jānunī kūrparau śakthi diśi vātahutāśayoḥ /
paitryāṃ pādapuṭe raudryāṃ śiro 'sya hṛdaye 'ñjaliḥ //
93.d:
जानुनी कूर्परौ शक्थि दिशि वातहुताशयोः /
पैत्र्यां पादपुटे रौद्र्यां शिरो ऽस्य हृदये ऽञ्जलिः //
93.m: His knees and elbows are in the directions of Wind and Fire; / his feet are together in the ancestral [south-west] direction, his head is in the Rudra [north-east] direction, and his folded hands are upon his heart.

93.s:
asya dehe samārūḍhā devatāḥ pūjitāḥ śubhāḥ /
aṣṭau koṇādhipāstatra koṇārdheṣvaṣṭasu sthitāḥ(3) //
93.d:
अस्य देहे समारूढा देवताः पूजिताः शुभाः /
अष्टौ कोणाधिपास्तत्र कोणार्धेष्वष्टसु स्थिताः(3) //
93.m: Mounted upon his body, the deities are worshipped and bestow auspiciousness. / There, the eight corner lords are stationed in the eight half-corners.

93.s:
ṣaṭpadāstu marīcyādyā dikṣu pūrvādiṣu kramāt /
madhye catuṣpado brahmā śeṣāstu padikāḥ(4) smṛtāḥ //
93.d:
षट्पदास्तु मरीच्याद्या दिक्षु पूर्वादिषु क्रमात् /
मध्ये चतुष्पदो ब्रह्मा शेषास्तु पदिकाः(4) स्मृताः //
93.m: Marīci and the others occupy six squares in regular order in the directions beginning with the east. / In the middle is Brahmā, occupying four squares; the remaining deities are traditionally known to occupy one square each.

93.s:
samastanāḍīsaṃyoge mahāmarmānujaṃ phalaṃ /
triśūlaṃ svastikaṃ vajraṃ(5) mahāsvastikasampuṭau //
93.d:
समस्तनाडीसंयोगे महामर्मानुजं फलं /
त्रिशूलं स्वस्तिकं वज्रं(5) महास्वस्तिकसम्पुटौ //
93.m: At the intersection of all the subtle channels lies the fruit born of the major vital points: / the trident, the svastika, the thunderbolt, the two major svastika-boxes,

93.s:
trikuṭuṃ(9) maṇibandhaṃ ca suviśuddhaṃ padaṃ tathā /
iti dvādaśa marmāṇi vāstorbhittyādiṣu tyajet //
93.d:
त्रिकुटुं(9) मणिबन्धं च सुविशुद्धं पदं तथा /
इति द्वादश मर्माणि वास्तोर्भित्त्यादिषु त्यजेत् //
93.m: the three-roomed structure, the wrist, and the fully purified square. / Thus one should avoid these twelve vital points of the site architecture deity when erecting walls and other structures.

93.s:
sājyamakṣatamīśāya parjanyāyāmbujodakaṃ /
dadītātha jayantāya patākāṃ kuṅkumojjvalāṃ(7) //
93.d:
साज्यमक्षतमीशाय पर्जन्यायाम्बुजोदकं /
ददीताथ जयन्ताय पताकां कुङ्कुमोज्ज्वलां(7) //
93.m: One should offer unbroken grains with clarified butter to Īśa, lotus-water to Parjanya, / and a banner gleaming with saffron to Jayanta;

93.s:
ratnavāri mahendrāya ravau dhūmraṃ vitānakaṃ /
satyāya ghṛtagodhūmamājyabhaktaṃ bhṛśāya ca //
93.d:
रत्नवारि महेन्द्राय रवौ धूम्रं वितानकं /
सत्याय घृतगोधूममाज्यभक्तं भृशाय च //
93.m: jewel-water to Mahendra, a smoky canopy to the Sun, / wheat cooked with clarified butter to Satya, and boiled rice with clarified butter to Bhṛśa;

93.s:
vimāṃsamantarīkṣāya śuktuntebhyastu pūrvataḥ /
madhukṣīrājyasampūrṇāṃ pradadyādvahnaye śrucaṃ //
93.d:
विमांसमन्तरीक्षाय शुक्तुन्तेभ्यस्तु पूर्वतः /
मधुक्षीराज्यसम्पूर्णां प्रदद्याद्वह्नये श्रुचं //
93.m: meatless offerings and vinegar to Antarīkṣa. These are for those in the east. / One should offer a ladle full of honey, milk, and clarified butter to Fire;

93.s:
lājān pūrṇaṃ suvarṇāmbu vitathāya nivedayet /
:n
1 ākuñcitakaramiti gha..
2 kuryādityādiḥ muttānamasurākṛtimityantaḥ
ślokadvayātmakapāṭho ga.. pustakake nāsti
3 koṇārdheṣu vyavasthitā iti gha..
4 pādikā iti kha..
5 muṣṭikaṃ vaktramiti kha..
6 trikoṣṭhamiti ga..
7 dadīteti ardhaśloko ga.. pustake nāsti
:p 296
dadyād gṛhakṣate kṣaudraṃ(1) yamarāje palaudanaṃ(2) //
93.d:
लाजान् पूर्णं सुवर्णाम्बु वितथाय निवेदयेत् /
:न्
1 आकुञ्चितकरमिति घ..
2 कुर्यादित्यादिः मुत्तानमसुराकृतिमित्यन्तः
श्लोकद्वयात्मकपाठो ग.. पुस्तकके नास्ति
3 कोणार्धेषु व्यवस्थिता इति घ..
4 पादिका इति ख..
5 मुष्टिकं वक्त्रमिति ख..
6 त्रिकोष्ठमिति ग..
7 ददीतेति अर्धश्लोको ग.. पुस्तके नास्ति
:प् 296
दद्याद् गृहक्षते क्षौद्रं(1) यमराजे पलौदनं(2) //
93.m:
one should present parched grain and water filled with gold to Vitatha;
[Gap in text]
1. [Variant:] “with contracted hands” in manuscript gha.
2. [Variant:] The two verses beginning with “kuryāt” and ending with “muttānamasurākṛtim” are missing in manuscript ga.
3. [Variant:] “stationed in the half-corners” in manuscript gha.
4. [Variant:] “pādikāḥ” in manuscript kha.
5. [Variant:] “a fist, a mouth” in manuscript kha.
