6. [Variant:] “trikoṣṭham” in manuscript ga.
7. [Variant:] The half-verse beginning with “dadīta” is missing in manuscript ga.
one should give honey to Gṛhakṣata, and meat-rice to Yamarāja;

93.s:
gandhaṃ gandharvanāthāya jihvāṃ bhṛṅgāya pakṣiṇaḥ /
mṛgāya padmaparṇāni(3) yāmyāmityaṣṭadevatāḥ(4) //
93.d:
गन्धं गन्धर्वनाथाय जिह्वां भृङ्गाय पक्षिणः /
मृगाय पद्मपर्णानि(3) याम्यामित्यष्टदेवताः(4) //
93.m: perfume to the lord of Gandharvas, the tongue of a bird to Bhṛṅga, / and lotus petals to Mṛga. Thus are the eight deities in the south.

93.s:
pitre tilodakaṃ kṣīraṃ vṛkṣajaṃ dantadhāvanaṃ /
dauvārikāya devāya pradadyād dhenumudrayā(5) //
93.d:
पित्रे तिलोदकं क्षीरं वृक्षजं दन्तधावनं /
दौवारिकाय देवाय प्रदद्याद् धेनुमुद्रया(5) //
93.m: One should offer water with sesamum seeds to the Ancestor, and milk and a tree-twig tooth-cleaner / to the deity Dauvārika with the cow gesture.

93.s:
sugrīvāya diśet pūpān puṣpadantāya darbhakaṃ /
raktaṃ pracetase padmamasurāya(6) surāsavaṃ //
93.d:
सुग्रीवाय दिशेत् पूपान् पुष्पदन्ताय दर्भकं /
रक्तं प्रचेतसे पद्ममसुराय(6) सुरासवं //
93.m: One should assign cakes to Sugrīva, darbhā-grass to Puṣpadanta, / a red lotus to Pracetas, and liquor and distilled spirits to Asura;

93.s:
ghṛtaṃ guḍaudanaṃ śeṣe rogāya ghṛtamaṇḍakān /
lājān vā paścimāśāyāṃ devāṣṭakamitīritaṃ //
93.d:
घृतं गुडौदनं शेषे रोगाय घृतमण्डकान् /
लाजान् वा पश्चिमाशायां देवाष्टकमितीरितं //
93.m: clarified butter and jaggery-rice to Śeṣa, and flatbreads cooked in clarified butter to Roga, / or parched grain. Thus are declared the eight deities in the western direction.

93.s:
mārutāya dhvajaṃ pītaṃ nāgāya nāgakeśaraṃ /
mukhye bhakṣyāṇi bhallāṭe mudgasūpaṃ susaṃskṛtaṃ //
93.d:
मारुताय ध्वजं पीतं नागाय नागकेशरं /
मुख्ये भक्ष्याणि भल्लाटे मुद्गसूपं सुसंस्कृतं //
93.m: To Māruta, a yellow banner; to Nāga, nāgakeśara flowers; / to Mukhya, cooked savouries; to Bhallāṭa, well-prepared mung-bean soup;

93.s:
somāya pāyasaṃ sājyaṃ śālūkamūṣaye(7) diśet /
lopīmaditaye dityai purīmityuttarāṣṭakaṃ(8) //
93.d:
सोमाय पायसं साज्यं शालूकमूषये(7) दिशेत् /
लोपीमदितये दित्यै पुरीमित्युत्तराष्टकं(8) //
93.m: to Soma, sweet milk-rice with clarified butter; to the sage, one should assign water-lily roots; / sweet pastries to Aditi, and a city-offering to Diti. Thus are the eight deities of the north.

93.s:
modakān brahmaṇaḥ prācyāṃ ṣaṭpādāya marīcaye /
savitre raktapuṣpāṇi vahnyadhaḥkoṇakoṣṭhake //
93.d:
मोदकान् ब्रह्मणः प्राच्यां षट्पादाय मरीचये /
सवित्रे रक्तपुष्पाणि वह्न्यधःकोणकोष्ठके //
93.m: One should offer sweet dumplings to Marīci, who occupies six squares to the east of Brahmā; / red flowers to Savitṛ in the square below the fire corner;

93.s:
tadadhaḥkoṣṭhake dadyāt sāvitryai ca kuśodakaṃ(9) /
dakṣiṇe candanaṃ(10) raktaṃ ṣaṭpadāya vivasvate //
93.d:
तदधःकोष्ठके दद्यात् सावित्र्यै च कुशोदकं(9) /
दक्षिणे चन्दनं(10) रक्तं षट्पदाय विवस्वते //
93.m: and in the square below that, one should give water with kuśa-grass to Sāvitrī; / in the south, red sandalwood to Vivasvat, who occupies six squares;

93.s:
haridraudanamindrāya rakṣodhaḥkrīṇakoṣṭhake /
:n
1 bhūtakṣaye raudramiti kha.. , cha.. ca / gṛhakṛte kṣaudramiti
gha..
2 phalaudanamiti kha. gha.. ca
3 yavaparṇānīti gha.. / padmavarṇānīti kha.. cha.. ca
4 yāmyāmityaṣṭadevatā iti kha..
5 pradadyādaghamudrayeti kha.. / pradadyādvanamudrayeti gha.. , cha.. ca
6 padmaṃ sambarāyeti gha..
7 śālūkaṃ śṛṇayeti kha.. , cha.. ca
8 purīmityavarāṣṭakamiti ga..
9 savitre ca kuśodakamiti ga..
10 sāvitryai candanamiti ga..
:p 297
indrajayāya miśrānnamindrādhastānnivedayet //
93.d:
हरिद्रौदनमिन्द्राय रक्षोधःक्रीणकोष्ठके /
:न्
1 भूतक्षये रौद्रमिति ख.. , छ.. च / गृहकृते क्षौद्रमिति
घ..
2 फलौदनमिति ख. घ.. च
3 यवपर्णानीति घ.. / पद्मवर्णानीति ख.. छ.. च
4 याम्यामित्यष्टदेवता इति ख..
5 प्रदद्यादघमुद्रयेति ख.. / प्रदद्याद्वनमुद्रयेति घ.. , छ.. च
6 पद्मं सम्बरायेति घ..
7 शालूकं शृणयेति ख.. , छ.. च
8 पुरीमित्यवराष्टकमिति ग..
9 सवित्रे च कुशोदकमिति ग..
10 सावित्र्यै चन्दनमिति ग..
:प् 297
इन्द्रजयाय मिश्रान्नमिन्द्राधस्तान्निवेदयेत् //
93.m:
rice cooked with turmeric to Indra in the square below the demon [south-west] corner;
[Gap in text]
1. [Variant:] “terrific offering in Bhūtakṣaya” in manuscripts kha and cha; “honey in Gṛhakṛta” in manuscript gha.
2. [Variant:] “fruit-rice” in manuscripts kha and gha.
3. [Variant:] “barley leaves” in manuscript gha; “lotus-coloured” in manuscripts kha and cha.
4. [Variant:] “thus the eight deities in the south” in manuscript kha.
5. [Variant:] “with the Aghamudrā” in manuscript kha; “with the Vanamudrā” in manuscripts gha and cha.
6. [Variant:] “a lotus to Sambara” in manuscript gha.
7. [Variant:] “śālūkaṃ śṛṇaye” in manuscripts kha and cha.
8. [Variant:] “the lower eight deities” in manuscript ga.
9. [Variant:] “and kuśa-water to Savitṛ” in manuscript ga.
10. [Variant:] “sandalwood to Sāvitrī” in manuscript ga.
one should present mixed rice to Indrajaya beneath Indra;

93.s:
varuṇyāṃ ṣaṭpadāsīne mitre saṅuḍamodanaṃ /
rudrāya ghṛtasiddhānnaṃ vāyukoṇādhare pade //
93.d:
वरुण्यां षट्पदासीने मित्रे सङुडमोदनं /
रुद्राय घृतसिद्धान्नं वायुकोणाधरे पदे //
93.m: in the western direction, boiled rice mixed with jaggery to Mitra seated on six squares; / rice cooked with clarified butter to Rudra in the square below the wind corner;

93.s:
tadadho rudradāsāya māsaṃ mārgamathottare /
dadīta māṣanaivedyaṃ(1) ṣaṭpadasthe dharādhare(2) //
93.d:
तदधो रुद्रदासाय मासं मार्गमथोत्तरे /
ददीत माषनैवेद्यं(1) षट्पदस्थे धराधरे(2) //
93.m: beneath that, deer meat to Rudradāsa; then in the north, / one should give an offering of black gram to Dharādhara, who is stationed on six squares;

93.s:
āpāya śivakoṇādhaḥ tadvatsāya ca tatsthale(3) /
kramāddadyāddadhikṣīraṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ //
93.d:
आपाय शिवकोणाधः तद्वत्साय च तत्स्थले(3) /
क्रमाद्दद्याद्दधिक्षीरं पूजयित्वा विधानतः //
93.m: to Āpa beneath the Śiva corner, and to his son in that same place, / one should duly worship and give curd and milk in succession.

93.s:
catuṣpade niviṣṭāya brahmaṇe madhmadeśataḥ /
pañcagavyākṣatopetañcaruṃ sājyaṃ nivedayet //
93.d:
चतुष्पदे निविष्टाय ब्रह्मणे मध्मदेशतः /
पञ्चगव्याक्षतोपेतञ्चरुं साज्यं निवेदयेत् //
93.m: To Brahmā, who is seated on four squares in the central region, / one should present boiled sacrificial rice mixed with clarified butter, accompanied by the five products of the cow and unbroken grains.

93.s:
īśādivāyuparyantakoṇeṣvatha yathākramaṃ /
vāstuvāhye carakyādyāś catasraḥ pūjayed yathā //
93.d:
ईशादिवायुपर्यन्तकोणेष्वथ यथाक्रमं /
वास्तुवाह्ये चरक्याद्याश् चतस्रः पूजयेद् यथा //
93.m: Then, in succession, in the corners from the north-east to the north-west, / outside the site architecture area, one should worship the four goddesses beginning with Carakī accordingly:

93.s:
carakyai(4) saghṛtaṃ māṃsaṃ vidāryai(5) dadhipaṅkaje /
pūtanāyai palaṃ pittaṃ rudhiraṃ ca nivedayet //
93.d:
चरक्यै(4) सघृतं मांसं विदार्यै(5) दधिपङ्कजे /
पूतनायै पलं पित्तं रुधिरं च निवेदयेत् //
93.m: meat with clarified butter to Carakī; curd and lotus flowers to Vidārī; / flesh, bile, and blood to Pūtanā;

93.s:
asthīni pāparākṣasyai raktapittapalāni ca /
tato māṣaudanaṃ(6) prācyāṃ skandāya vinivedayet //
93.d:
अस्थीनि पापराक्षस्यै रक्तपित्तपलानि च /
ततो माषौदनं(6) प्राच्यां स्कन्दाय विनिवेदयेत् //
93.m: bones, blood, bile, and flesh to Pāparākṣasī. / Then, in the east, one should present black gram cooked with rice to Skanda.

93.s:
aryamṇe dakṣiṇāśāyāṃ pūpān kṛsarayā yutān /
jambhakāya(7) ca vāruṇyāmāmiṣaṃ rudhirānvitaṃ //
93.d:
अर्यम्णे दक्षिणाशायां पूपान् कृसरया युतान् /
जम्भकाय(7) च वारुण्यामामिषं रुधिरान्वितं //
93.m: To Aryaman in the southern quarter [one should offer] cakes mixed with rice cooked with sesame and pulses, / and to Jambhaka in the western quarter, meat accompanied by blood.

93.s:
udīcyāṃ pilipiñjāya(8) raktānnaṃ kusumāni ca /
yajedvā sakalaṃ vāstuṃ kuśadadhyakṣaterjalaiḥ //
:n
1 māṃsanaivedyamiti kha.. , cha.. , ca
2 varādhare iti gha..
3 āpavatsacatuṣṭaye iti kha.. / tadvatsāyai ca tattale iti gha.. , ja.. ca
4 vārāhyai iti ṅa.. , cha.. ca
5 vipace iti kha.. , cha.. ca
6 tato māṃsaudanamiti kha. gha.. cha.. ca
7 kumbhakāyeti cha..
8 pilipicchāyeti ṅa.. / lipipiñjāyeti cha..
:p 298
93.d:
उदीच्यां पिलिपिञ्जाय(8) रक्तान्नं कुसुमानि च /
यजेद्वा सकलं वास्तुं कुशदध्यक्षतेर्जलैः //
:न्
1 मांसनैवेद्यमिति ख.. , छ.. , च
2 वराधरे इति घ..
3 आपवत्सचतुष्टये इति ख.. / तद्वत्सायै च तत्तले इति घ.. , ज.. च
4 वाराह्यै इति ङ.. , छ.. च
5 विपचे इति ख.. , छ.. च
6 ततो मांसौदनमिति ख. घ.. छ.. च
7 कुम्भकायेति छ..
8 पिलिपिच्छायेति ङ.. / लिपिपिञ्जायेति छ..
:प् 298
93.m:
In the northern quarter, to Pilipiñja, red rice and flowers. / Or one may worship the entire site architecture with kuśa grass, curd, unbroken rice grains, and water.
[Notes]
1 kha, cha, and ca read māṃsanaivedyam.
2 gha reads varādhare.
3 kha reads āpavatsacatuṣṭaye; gha and ja read tadvatsāyai ca tattale.
4 ṅa and cha read vārāhyai.
5 kha and cha read vipace.
6 kha, gha, and cha read tato māṃsaudanam.
7 cha reads kumbhakāya.
8 ṅa reads pilipicchāya; cha reads lipipiñjāya. / [Page 298]

93.s:
gṛhe ca nagarādau ca ekāśītipadair yajet /
tripadā rajjavaḥ kāryāḥ ṣaṭpadāś ca vikoṇake //
93.d:
गृहे च नगरादौ च एकाशीतिपदैर् यजेत् /
त्रिपदा रज्जवः कार्याः षट्पदाश् च विकोणके //
93.m: In a house and in a city and the like, one should worship with eighty-one squares. / Cords should be made of three squares [in length], and six squares in the corner-spaces.

93.s:
īśādyāḥ pādikāstasminnāgadyāś ca dvikoṣṭhagāḥ(1) /
ṣaṭpadasthā marīcyādyā brahmā navapadaḥ smṛtaḥ //
93.d:
ईशाद्याः पादिकास्तस्मिन्नागद्याश् च द्विकोष्ठगाः(1) /
षट्पदस्था मरीच्याद्या ब्रह्मा नवपदः स्मृतः //
93.m: In it, [deities] beginning with Īśa occupy one square; those beginning with Nāga occupy two compartments. / Those beginning with Marīci stand in six squares; Brahmā is traditionally known to have nine squares.

93.s:
nagaragrāmakheṭādau vāstuḥ śatapado 'pi(2) vā /
vaṃśadvayaṃ koṇagataṃ durjayaṃ durdharaṃ sadā //
93.d:
नगरग्रामखेटादौ वास्तुः शतपदो ऽपि(2) वा /
वंशद्वयं कोणगतं दुर्जयं दुर्धरं सदा //
93.m: In a city, village, market-town, and the like, the site architecture may also have a hundred squares. / The pair of bamboo axes going through the corners is always invincible and difficult to support.

93.s:
yathā devālaye nyasas tathā śatapade hitaḥ /
grahāḥ skandādayastatra vijñeyāś caiva ṣaṭpadāḥ //
93.d:
यथा देवालये न्यसस् तथा शतपदे हितः /
ग्रहाः स्कन्दादयस्तत्र विज्ञेयाश् चैव षट्पदाः //
93.m: As ritual deposition is performed in a temple, so it is beneficially done on [a site of] a hundred squares. / The planets, Skanda, and others there are known indeed to occupy six squares.

93.s:
carakyādyā bhūtapadā rajjuvaṃśādi pūrvavat /
deśasaṃsthāpane(3) vāstu catustriṃśacchataṃ(4) bhavet //
93.d:
चरक्याद्या भूतपदा रज्जुवंशादि पूर्ववत् /
देशसंस्थापने(3) वास्तु चतुस्त्रिंशच्छतं(4) भवेत् //
93.m: Carakī and the others have five squares; the cords, bamboos, and so forth are as before. / In laying out a territory, the site architecture should consist of one hundred and thirty-four [squares].

93.s:
catuḥṣaṣṭipado(5) brahmā marīcyādyāś ca devatāḥ /
catuḥpañcāśatpadikā āpādyaṣṭau rasāgnibhiḥ //
93.d:
चतुःषष्टिपदो(5) ब्रह्मा मरीच्याद्याश् च देवताः /
चतुःपञ्चाशत्पदिका आपाद्यष्टौ रसाग्निभिः //
93.m: Brahmā occupies sixty-four squares, and the deities beginning with Marīci / occupy fifty-four squares; the eight beginning with Āpa [occupy] thirty-six squares.

93.s:
īśānādyā navapadāḥ skandādyāḥ śaktikāḥ(6) smṛtāḥ /
carakyādyāstadvadeva rajjuvaṃśādi pūrvavat(7) //
93.d:
ईशानाद्या नवपदाः स्कन्दाद्याः शक्तिकाः(6) स्मृताः /
चरक्याद्यास्तद्वदेव रज्जुवंशादि पूर्ववत्(7) //
93.m: Those beginning with Īśāna have nine squares; those beginning with Skanda are remembered as occupying one square. / Those beginning with Carakī are likewise; the cords, bamboos, and the rest are as before.

93.s:
jñeyo vaṃśasahasraistu vāstumaṇḍalagaḥ padaiḥ /
nyāso navaguṇastatra kartavyo deśavāstuvit //
93.d:
ज्ञेयो वंशसहस्रैस्तु वास्तुमण्डलगः पदैः /
न्यासो नवगुणस्तत्र कर्तव्यो देशवास्तुवित् //
93.m: Site architecture on a maṇḍala is known by squares through a thousand bamboo lines; / one who knows the site architecture of a territory must perform a ninefold ritual deposition there.

93.s:
pañcaciṃśatpado vāsturvaitālākhyaścitau smṛtaḥ /
anyo navapado vāstuḥ ṣoḍaśāṅghris tathāparaḥ //
93.d:
पञ्चचिंशत्पदो वास्तुर्वैतालाख्यश्चितौ स्मृतः /
अन्यो नवपदो वास्तुः षोडशाङ्घ्रिस् तथापरः //
93.m: The site architecture of thirty-five squares is taught as named Vaitāla on a funeral pyre; / another site architecture has nine squares, and yet another has sixteen squares.

93.s:
ṣaḍasratryasravṛttādermadhye syāccaturasrakaṃ /
:n
1 nāgādyāścārdhakoṣṭagā iti kha.. , cha.. ca
2 śatapade 'pīti ga..
3 daśamaṃ sthāpane iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca
4 caturviṃśacchatamiti ga..
5 catuḥṣaṣṭipade iti gha..
6 īśānādyāḥ śivapadā skandādyāḥ padikā iti gha..
7 samañca sthāpane vāstuś catustriṃśacchataṃ bhavediti gha.. pustake
'dhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ / catuḥṣaṣṭipado brahmā ity ādiḥ,
rajjuvaṃśādi pūrvavat ity antaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti
:p 299
khāte vāstoḥ samaṃ pṛṣṭhe(1) nyāse brahmaśilātmake //
93.d:
षडस्रत्र्यस्रवृत्तादेर्मध्ये स्याच्चतुरस्रकं /
:न्
1 नागाद्याश्चार्धकोष्टगा इति ख.. , छ.. च
2 शतपदे ऽपीति ग..
3 दशमं स्थापने इति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. च
4 चतुर्विंशच्छतमिति ग..
5 चतुःषष्टिपदे इति घ..
6 ईशानाद्याः शिवपदा स्कन्दाद्याः पदिका इति घ..
7 समञ्च स्थापने वास्तुश् चतुस्त्रिंशच्छतं भवेदिति घ.. पुस्तके
ऽधिकः पाठः / चतुःषष्टिपदो ब्रह्मा इत्य् आदिः,
रज्जुवंशादि पूर्ववत् इत्य् अन्तः पाठो ग.. पुस्तके नास्ति
:प् 299
खाते वास्तोः समं पृष्ठे(1) न्यासे ब्रह्मशिलात्मके //
93.m:
In the middle of a hexagon, triangle, circle, and the like, there should be a square.
[Notes]
1 kha and cha read nāgādyāścārdhakoṣṭagāḥ.
2 ga reads śatapade 'pi.
3 kha, ga, gha, ṅa, and cha read daśamaṃ sthāpane.
4 ga reads caturviṃśacchataṃ.
5 gha reads catuḥṣaṣṭipade.
6 gha reads īśānādyāḥ śivapadā skandādyāḥ padikā.
7 Manuscript gha contains the additional reading samañca sthāpane vāstuś catustriṃśacchataṃ bhavet. The reading from catuḥṣaṣṭipado brahmā up to rajjuvaṃśādi pūrvavat is absent in manuscript ga. / [Page 299]
When the foundation trench of the site architecture is level on the surface, at the time of ritual deposition consisting of the foundation stone of Brahmā,

93.s:
śāṣākasya niveśe ca(2) mūrtisaṃsthāpane tathā /
pāyasena tu naivedyaṃ sarveṣāṃ vā pradāpayet //
93.d:
शाषाकस्य निवेशे च(2) मूर्तिसंस्थापने तथा /
पायसेन तु नैवेद्यं सर्वेषां वा प्रदापयेत् //
93.m: and at the erection of the doorframe, as well as at the installation of the image, / one should present an offering of milk-rice to all [the deities].

93.s:
uktānukte tu vai vāstuḥ pañcahastapramāṇataḥ /
gṛhaprāsādamānena vāstuḥ śreṣṭhastu sarvadā(4) //
:e ity ādimahapurāṇe āgneye vāstupūjākathanaṃ nāma trinavatitamo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha caturṇavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
śilāvinyāsavidhānaṃ
93.d:
उक्तानुक्ते तु वै वास्तुः पञ्चहस्तप्रमाणतः /
गृहप्रासादमानेन वास्तुः श्रेष्ठस्तु सर्वदा(4) //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहपुराणे आग्नेये वास्तुपूजाकथनं नाम त्रिनवतितमो
ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ चतुर्णवतितमो ऽध्यायः
शिलाविन्यासविधानं
93.m:
Whether prescribed or unprescribed, the site architecture is five cubits in measure; / the site architecture proportioned to the house or temple is always supreme.
Thus ends the ninety-third chapter, entitled “The Teaching on the Worship of the Site Architecture,” in the glorious and great Agni Purāṇa.
Now, the ninety-fourth chapter.
The Procedure for the Laying of the Foundation Stone

94.s:
īśvara uvāca
īśādiṣu carakyādyāḥ(5) pūrvavat pūjayedvahiḥ /
āhutitritayaṃ dadyāt pratidevamanukramāt //
94.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
ईशादिषु चरक्याद्याः(5) पूर्ववत् पूजयेद्वहिः /
आहुतित्रितयं दद्यात् प्रतिदेवमनुक्रमात् //
94.m: The Lord said: / Outside, in the directions beginning with the northeast, one should worship Carakī and others as before; / one should offer three oblations in sequence for each deity.

94.s:
datvā bhūtabaliṃ lagne śilānyāsamanukramāt /
madhyasūtre(6) nyasecchaktiṃ kumbhañcānantamuttamaṃ(7) //
94.d:
दत्वा भूतबलिं लग्ने शिलान्यासमनुक्रमात् /
मध्यसूत्रे(6) न्यसेच्छक्तिं कुम्भञ्चानन्तमुत्तमं(7) //
94.m: Having offered an oblation to the spirits at the astrological moment, for the sequential laying of the stones, / on the central cord-line one should place the Śakti and the excellent jar Ananta.

94.s:
nakārārūḍhamūlena kumbhe 'smin dhārayecchilāṃ /
kumbhānaṣṭau sabhadrādīn dikṣu pūrvādiṣu kramāt //
94.d:
नकारारूढमूलेन कुम्भे ऽस्मिन् धारयेच्छिलां /
कुम्भानष्टौ सभद्रादीन् दिक्षु पूर्वादिषु क्रमात् //
94.m: With the root-mantra resting on the syllable Na, one should hold the stone upon this jar; / [and one should place] eight jars, Subhadra and the others, in the directions beginning with the east in order.

94.s:
lokapālāṇubhirnyasya(8) śvabhreṣu(6) nyastaśaktiṣu /
:n
1 khātārambhe samaṃ pṛṣṭhe iti ṅa.. / khāto bāloḥ samaḥ
pṛṣṭhe iti cha..
2 niveśeneti kha.. , cha.. ca
3 paraṃ hastapramānata iti cha..
4 sarvada iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca / sarvaśa iti ga.. , ca
5 īśādyādiṣu brahmādyā iti ga..
6 madhye śvabhra iti gha..
7 kumbhañcānantamantikamiti gha.. , cha.. ca / kumbhañcānantamantimamiti
ṅa..
8 lokapālātmabhirnyasyediti kha.. , cha.. ca / lokapālāṇubhirnyasyediti
ṅa..
9 sūtreṣviti ka.. / kumbheṣviti ga..
:p 300
śilāsteṣvatha(1) nandādyāḥ krameṇa(2) viniyojayet //
94.d:
लोकपालाणुभिर्न्यस्य(8) श्वभ्रेषु(6) न्यस्तशक्तिषु /
:न्
1 खातारम्भे समं पृष्ठे इति ङ.. / खातो बालोः समः
पृष्ठे इति छ..
2 निवेशेनेति ख.. , छ.. च
3 परं हस्तप्रमानत इति छ..
4 सर्वद इति ख.. , घ.. , छ.. च / सर्वश इति ग.. , च
5 ईशाद्यादिषु ब्रह्माद्या इति ग..
6 मध्ये श्वभ्र इति घ..
7 कुम्भञ्चानन्तमन्तिकमिति घ.. , छ.. च / कुम्भञ्चानन्तमन्तिममिति
ङ..
8 लोकपालात्मभिर्न्यस्येदिति ख.. , छ.. च / लोकपालाणुभिर्न्यस्येदिति
ङ..
9 सूत्रेष्विति क.. / कुम्भेष्विति ग..
:प् 300
शिलास्तेष्वथ(1) नन्दाद्याः क्रमेण(2) विनियोजयेत् //
94.m:
Having deposited them with the mantras of the World Protectors in the pits where Śaktis have been deposited,
[Notes]
1 ṅa reads khātārambhe samaṃ pṛṣṭhe; cha reads khāto bāloḥ samaḥ pṛṣṭhe.
2 kha and cha read niveśena.
3 cha reads paraṃ hastapramānataḥ.
4 kha, gha, and cha read sarvada; ga and ca read sarvaśaḥ.
5 ga reads īśādyādiṣu brahmādyāḥ.
6 gha reads madhye śvabhre.
7 gha and cha read kumbhañcānantamantikam; ṅa reads kumbhañcānantamantimam.
8 kha and cha read lokapālātmabhirnyasyet; ṅa reads lokapālāṇubhirnyasyet.
9 ka reads sūtreṣu; ga reads kumbheṣu. / [Page 300]
one should then place the stones Nandā and others into them in order,

94.s:
śambarair mūrtināthānāṃ(3) yathā syurbhittimadhyataḥ /
tāsu dharmādikānaṣṭau(4) koṇāt koṇaṃ vibhāgaśaḥ(5) //
94.d:
शम्बरैर् मूर्तिनाथानां(3) यथा स्युर्भित्तिमध्यतः /
तासु धर्मादिकानष्टौ(4) कोणात् कोणं विभागशः(5) //
94.m: so that they lie in the middle of the wall by the measures of the lords of the idols; / on them [one should place] the eight deities beginning with Dharma, portion by portion from corner to corner.

94.s:
subhadrādiṣu nandādyāś catasro 'gnyādikoṇagāḥ /
ajitādyāś ca pūrvādijayādiṣvatha(6) vinyaset //
94.d:
सुभद्रादिषु नन्दाद्याश् चतस्रो ऽग्न्यादिकोणगाः /
अजिताद्याश् च पूर्वादिजयादिष्वथ(6) विन्यसेत् //
94.m: On the [jars] beginning with Subhadra, the four stones Nandā and the rest [are deposited] in the corners beginning with the southeast; / and one should then place Ajitā and others in the directions beginning with the east, on the [jars] Jayā and others.

94.s:
brahmāṇaṃ copari masya(7) vyāpakaṃ ca maheśvaraṃ /
cintayedeṣu cādhānaṃ vyomaprasādamadhyagaṃ //
94.d:
ब्रह्माणं चोपरि मस्य(7) व्यापकं च महेश्वरं /
चिन्तयेदेषु चाधानं व्योमप्रसादमध्यगं //
94.m: And above it, one should meditate upon Brahmā and the all-pervading Maheśvara; / and one should contemplate their establishment situated in the center of the celestial temple.

94.s:
balindattvā japedastraṃ vighnadoṣanivāraṇaṃ(8) /
śilāpañcakapakṣe 'pi manāguddiśyate yathā //
94.d:
बलिन्दत्त्वा जपेदस्त्रं विघ्नदोषनिवारणं(8) /
शिलापञ्चकपक्षे ऽपि मनागुद्दिश्यते यथा //
94.m: Having given an oblation, one should recite the Astra mantra that removes obstacles and defects; / even in the tradition of five stones, [the rule] is briefly indicated as follows:

94.s:
madhye pūrṇaśilānyāsaḥ(9) subhadrakalaśe 'rdhataḥ /
padmādiṣu ca nandādyāḥ koṇeṣvagnyādiṣu kramāt //
94.d:
मध्ये पूर्णशिलान्यासः(9) सुभद्रकलशे ऽर्धतः /
पद्मादिषु च नन्दाद्याः कोणेष्वग्न्यादिषु क्रमात् //
94.m: In the center is the placement of the Pūrṇā stone, by half on the Subhadra jar; / and on the Padmā and other [jars], Nandā and the others [are placed] in the corners beginning with the southeast in order.

94.s:
madhyabhāve(10) catasro 'pi mātṛvadbhāvasammatāḥ /
oṃ pūrṇe tvaṃ mahāviśve(11) sarvasandohalakṣaṇe //
94.d:
मध्यभावे(10) चतस्रो ऽपि मातृवद्भावसम्मताः /
ओं पूर्णे त्वं महाविश्वे(11) सर्वसन्दोहलक्षणे //
94.m: In the absence of a center, even the four [stones] are accepted as having the nature of mothers: / “Oṃ, O Pūrṇā! You are the great universe, characterized by all abundance;

94.s:
sarvasampūrṇamevātra kuruṣvāṅgirasaḥ sute /
oṃ nande tvaṃ nandinī puṃsāṃ tvāmatra sthāpayāmyahaṃ //
94.d:
सर्वसम्पूर्णमेवात्र कुरुष्वाङ्गिरसः सुते /
ओं नन्दे त्वं नन्दिनी पुंसां त्वामत्र स्थापयाम्यहं //
94.m: make everything entirely full here, O daughter of Aṅgiras! / Oṃ, O Nandā! You are the rejoicer of people; I establish you here.

94.s:
prāsāde tiṣṭha santṛptā yāvaccandrārkatārakaṃ /
āyuḥ kāmaṃ śriyannande dehi vāsiṣṭha dehināṃ(12) //
:n
1 śilādyāstatheti ka..
2 kramaśa iti gha..
3 śambarair mūrtinādhānāmiti kha. cha.. ca / śambarair
mūrtimādhānamiti ṅa..
4 tān sudharmādikānaṣṭau iti kha..
5 vibhāgata iti gha..
6 pūrvādijayādiṣu ceti ga..
7 brahmāṇaṃ copavinyasyeti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ca
8 vighnadoṣanivārakamiti ga..
9 pūrvaśilānyāsa iti gha..
12 dehi māmiti kha.. , cha.. ca / dehi na iti gha..
:p 301
94.d:
प्रासादे तिष्ठ सन्तृप्ता यावच्चन्द्रार्कतारकं /
आयुः कामं श्रियन्नन्दे देहि वासिष्ठ देहिनां(12) //
:न्
1 शिलाद्यास्तथेति क..
2 क्रमश इति घ..
3 शम्बरैर् मूर्तिनाधानामिति ख. छ.. च / शम्बरैर्
मूर्तिमाधानमिति ङ..
4 तान् सुधर्मादिकानष्टौ इति ख..
5 विभागत इति घ..
6 पूर्वादिजयादिषु चेति ग..
7 ब्रह्माणं चोपविन्यस्येति ख.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. , च
8 विघ्नदोषनिवारकमिति ग..
9 पूर्वशिलान्यास इति घ..
12 देहि मामिति ख.. , छ.. च / देहि न इति घ..
:प् 301
94.m:
Remain well satisfied in the temple as long as the moon, sun, and stars [endure]; / grant lifespan, desire, and prosperity to embodied beings, O Nandā, [daughter] of Vasiṣṭha!”
[Notes]
1. "śilādyās tathā" in manuscript ka.
2. "kramaśaḥ" in manuscript gha.
3. "śambarair mūrtinādhānam" in manuscripts kha, cha, and ca; "śambarair mūrtim ādhānam" in manuscript ṅa.
4. "tān sudharmādikān aṣṭau" in manuscript kha.
5. "vibhāgataḥ" in manuscript gha.
6. "pūrvādijayādiṣu ca" in manuscript ga.
7. "brahmāṇaṃ copavinyasya" in manuscripts kha, gha, ṅa, cha, and ca.
8. "vighnadoṣanivārakam" in manuscript ga.
9. "pūrvaśilānyāsaḥ" in manuscript gha.
12. "dehi mām" in manuscripts kha and cha; "dehi naḥ" in manuscript gha.

94.s:
asmin rakṣā sadā(1) kāryā prāsāde yatnatastvayā /
oṃ bhadre tvaṃ sarvadā bhadraṃ lokānāṃ kuru kāśyapi //
94.d:
अस्मिन् रक्षा सदा(1) कार्या प्रासादे यत्नतस्त्वया /
ओं भद्रे त्वं सर्वदा भद्रं लोकानां कुरु काश्यपि //
94.m: Protection must always be maintained by you with effort in this temple. / Om, auspicious one, daughter of Kaśyapa, always bring welfare to the worlds!

94.s:
āyurdā kāmadā devi(2) śrīpradā ca sadā bhava /
oṃ jaye 'tra sarvadā devi śrīdā.ayurdā ca sadā bhava(3) //
94.d:
आयुर्दा कामदा देवि(2) श्रीप्रदा च सदा भव /
ओं जये ऽत्र सर्वदा देवि श्रीदा.अयुर्दा च सदा भव(3) //
94.m: O goddess, granter of longevity and desires, always bestow prosperity. / Om, victorious one, goddess here always grant prosperity and longevity!

94.s:
oṃ jaye 'tra sarvadā(4) devi tiṣṭha tvaṃ sthāpitā maya(5) /
nityañjayāya bhūtyai ca svāminī bhava bhārgavi //
94.d:
ओं जये ऽत्र सर्वदा(4) देवि तिष्ठ त्वं स्थापिता मय(5) /
नित्यञ्जयाय भूत्यै च स्वामिनी भव भार्गवि //
94.m: Om, victorious one, o goddess, remain here always, established by me! / O daughter of Bhṛgu, be the mistress for constant victory and prosperity!

94.s:
oṃ rikte 'tiriktadoṣaghne(6) siddhimuktiprade śubhaṃ /
sarvadā sarvadeśasthe tiṣṭhāsmin viśvarūpiṇi(7) //
94.d:
ओं रिक्ते ऽतिरिक्तदोषघ्ने(6) सिद्धिमुक्तिप्रदे शुभं /
सर्वदा सर्वदेशस्थे तिष्ठास्मिन् विश्वरूपिणि(7) //
94.m: Om, Riktā, destroyer of excessive defects, granter of success and liberation, auspicious one, / residing always in every region, remain in this [temple], you whose form is the universe!

94.s:
gaganāyatanandhyātvā tatra tattvatrayaṃ(8) nyaset /
prāyaścittantato hutvā vidhinā visṛjenmakhaṃ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye śilānyāsakathanaṃ nāma
caturṇavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha pañcanavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
pratiṣṭhā sāmagrīvidhānaṃ
94.d:
गगनायतनन्ध्यात्वा तत्र तत्त्वत्रयं(8) न्यसेत् /
प्रायश्चित्तन्ततो हुत्वा विधिना विसृजेन्मखं //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये शिलान्यासकथनं नाम
चतुर्णवतितमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ पञ्चनवतितमो ऽध्यायः
प्रतिष्ठा सामग्रीविधानं
94.m:
Having meditated on the sky-shrine, one should deposit the triad of principles there. / Then, having offered the expiation into the fire, one should discharge the sacrifice according to the rule.
Thus ends the ninety-fourth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Laying of the Foundation Stone," in the primary Mahāpurāṇa, the Āgneya.
Now, the ninety-fifth chapter.
The Rules for the Materials of Consecration.

95.s:
īśvara uvāca
vakṣye liṅgapratiṣṭhāṃ ca prāsāde bhuktimuktidāṃ /
tāś caret sarvadā muktau bhuktau devadine sati //
95.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
वक्ष्ये लिङ्गप्रतिष्ठां च प्रासादे भुक्तिमुक्तिदां /
ताश् चरेत् सर्वदा मुक्तौ भुक्तौ देवदिने सति //
95.m: The Lord said: / I shall explain the consecration of the liṅga in the temple, which grants worldly enjoyment and liberation. / One should perform it at all times for liberation, and during a day of the gods for worldly enjoyment.

95.s:
vinā caitreṇa māghādau pratiṣṭhā māsapañcake /
:n
1 mudā iti kha.. cha.. ca
2 kāmade devīti gha..
3 jayetretyardhaślokaḥ cha.. pustake nāsti
4 oṃ jaya enaṃ sadeti kha.. cha.. ca
5 mama iti ṅa..
6 raktātiraktadoṣaghna iti cha.. / raktātriraktadoṣaghne iti kha..
7 santiṣṭhāsminnīśarūpiṇīti gha.. / śarparūpiṇīti ja..
8 tattve tattvatrayamiti gha..
9 sarvadā muktau devādeve grahe satīti gha.. / sarvadā muktyai bhuktyai
daivadine satīti ṅa..
:p 302
guruśukrodaye kāryā prathame karaṇetraye //
95.d:
विना चैत्रेण माघादौ प्रतिष्ठा मासपञ्चके /
:न्
1 मुदा इति ख.. छ.. च
2 कामदे देवीति घ..
3 जयेत्रेत्यर्धश्लोकः छ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
4 ओं जय एनं सदेति ख.. छ.. च
5 मम इति ङ..
6 रक्तातिरक्तदोषघ्न इति छ.. / रक्तात्रिरक्तदोषघ्ने इति ख..
7 सन्तिष्ठास्मिन्नीशरूपिणीति घ.. / शर्परूपिणीति ज..
8 तत्त्वे तत्त्वत्रयमिति घ..
9 सर्वदा मुक्तौ देवादेवे ग्रहे सतीति घ.. / सर्वदा मुक्त्यै भुक्त्यै
दैवदिने सतीति ङ..
:प् 302
गुरुशुक्रोदये कार्या प्रथमे करणेत्रये //
95.m:
Excepting Caitra, consecration [is done] in the five months beginning with Māgha,
[Apparatus notes]
1. "mudā" in manuscripts kha, cha, and ca.
2. "kāmade devi" in manuscript gha.
3. The half-verse "jayetre..." is absent in manuscript cha.
4. "oṃ jaya enaṃ sadā" in manuscripts kha, cha, and ca.
5. "mama" in manuscript ṅa.
6. "raktātiraktadoṣaghne" in manuscript cha; "raktātriraktadoṣaghne" in manuscript kha.
7. "santiṣṭhāsminnīśarūpiṇī" in manuscript gha; "śarparūpiṇī" in manuscript ja.
8. "tattve tattvatrayam" in manuscript gha.
9. "sarvadā muktau devādeve grahe sati" in manuscript gha; "sarvadā muktyai bhuktyai daivadine sati" in manuscript ṅa.
when Jupiter and Venus rise, in the first three astrological divisions.

95.s:
śuklapakṣe viśeṣeṇa kṛṣṇe vā pañcamandinaṃ(1) /
caturthīṃ navamīṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ varjayitvā caturdaśīṃ //
95.d:
शुक्लपक्षे विशेषेण कृष्णे वा पञ्चमन्दिनं(1) /
चतुर्थीं नवमीं षष्ठीं वर्जयित्वा चतुर्दशीं //
95.m: Especially in the bright fortnight, or in the dark [fortnight] up to the fifth lunar day, / avoiding the fourth, ninth, sixth, and fourteenth [lunar days].

95.s:
śobhanāstithayaḥ śaṣāḥ krūravāravivarjitāḥ /
śatabhiṣā dhaniṣṭhārdrā anurodhottaratrayaṃ(2) //
95.d:
शोभनास्तिथयः शषाः क्रूरवारविवर्जिताः /
शतभिषा धनिष्ठार्द्रा अनुरोधोत्तरत्रयं(2) //
95.m: The remaining lunar days are auspicious, excluding cruel weekdays. / Śatabhiṣaj, Dhaniṣṭhā, Ārdrā, Anurādhā, and the three Uttarās,

95.s:
rohiṇī śravaṇaśceti(3) sthirārambhe mahodayāḥ /
lagnañca kumbhasiṃhālitulāstrīvṛṣadhanvināṃ //
95.d:
रोहिणी श्रवणश्चेति(3) स्थिरारम्भे महोदयाः /
लग्नञ्च कुम्भसिंहालितुलास्त्रीवृषधन्विनां //
95.m: Rohiṇī and Śravaṇa bring great fortune for a stable undertaking; / and the ascendant among Aquarius, Leo, Scorpio, Libra, Virgo, Taurus, and Sagittarius.

95.s:
śasto jīvo navarkṣeṣu saptasthāneṣu sarvadā /
budhaḥ ṣaḍaṣṭadiksaptaturyeṣu vinartuṃ(4) śitaḥ //
95.d:
शस्तो जीवो नवर्क्षेषु सप्तस्थानेषु सर्वदा /
बुधः षडष्टदिक्सप्ततुर्येषु विनर्तुं(4) शितः //
95.m: Jupiter is always auspicious in the nine lunar mansions and in the seventh house. / Mercury is sharp in the sixth, eighth, tenth, seventh, and fourth, without a season.

95.s:
saptartutridaśādisthaḥ(5) śaśāṅkobaladaḥ sadā(6) /
ravirdaśatriṣaṭsaṃstho rāhustridaśaṣaḍgataḥ //
95.d:
सप्तर्तुत्रिदशादिस्थः(5) शशाङ्कोबलदः सदा(6) /
रविर्दशत्रिषट्संस्थो राहुस्त्रिदशषड्गतः //
95.m: Stationed in the seventh, sixth, or thirteenth and following, the moon always gives strength. / The sun is situated in the tenth, third, or sixth, and Rāhu in the third, tenth, or sixth.

95.s:
ṣaṭtristhānagatāḥ śastā mandāṅgārārkaketavaḥ /
śubhrāḥ krūraś ca pāpāś ca sarva ekādaśasthitāḥ //
95.d:
षट्त्रिस्थानगताः शस्ता मन्दाङ्गारार्ककेतवः /
शुभ्राः क्रूरश् च पापाश् च सर्व एकादशस्थिताः //
95.m: Saturn, Mars, the sun, and Ketu are auspicious when situated in the sixth and third places. / Benefics, malefics, and cruels are all [auspicious] situated in the eleventh.

95.s:
eṣāṃ dṛṣṭirmunau pūrṇā(7) tvārdhikī grahabhūtayoḥ /
pādikī rāmadiksthāne caturaṣṭau(8) pādavarjitā //
95.d:
एषां दृष्टिर्मुनौ पूर्णा(7) त्वार्धिकी ग्रहभूतयोः /
पादिकी रामदिक्स्थाने चतुरष्टौ(8) पादवर्जिता //
95.m: Their aspect is full on the seventh, half on the ninth and fifth, / a quarter on the third and tenth places, and diminished by a quarter on the fourth and eighth.

95.s:
pādānyūnacaturnāḍī bhogaḥ syānmīnameṣayoḥ /
vṛṣakumbhau ca bhuñjāte catasraḥ pādavarjitāḥ //
95.d:
पादान्यूनचतुर्नाडी भोगः स्यान्मीनमेषयोः /
वृषकुम्भौ च भुञ्जाते चतस्रः पादवर्जिताः //
95.m: The duration of Pisces and Aries is four nāḍīs diminished by a quarter; / and Taurus and Aquarius endure for four [nāḍīs] diminished by a quarter.

95.s:
makaro mithunaṃ pañca cāpāliharikarkaṭāḥ /
pādīnāḥ ṣaṭ tulākanye ghaṭikāḥ sārdhapañca ca //
:n
1 kṛṣṇepyāpañcamaṃ dinamiti kha.. , cha.. ca /
kṛṣṇepyāpañcamāddināditi gha..
2 anurādhottarātrayamiti ca..
3 śravaṇaś caite iti ca..
4 budhaḥ ṣaḍṛtuturyeṣu diksaptāha vineti cha.. / budhaḥ
ṣaḍdvyaṣṭaturṣeṣu diksaptaṣaḍ vineti kha..
5 saptāyatridaśādistha iti kha.. cha.. ca
6 budhaḥ ṣaḍaṣṭadigityādiḥ, baladaḥ sadā ity antaḥ
pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti
7 evaṃ dṛṣṭivale pūrṇāditi cha.. / evaṃ dṛṣṭivale pūrṇeti
kha..
8 vasvaṣṭau iti kha.., cha.. ca
:p 303
95.d:
मकरो मिथुनं पञ्च चापालिहरिकर्कटाः /
पादीनाः षट् तुलाकन्ये घटिकाः सार्धपञ्च च //
:न्
1 कृष्णेप्यापञ्चमं दिनमिति ख.. , छ.. च /
कृष्णेप्यापञ्चमाद्दिनादिति घ..
2 अनुराधोत्तरात्रयमिति च..
3 श्रवणश् चैते इति च..
4 बुधः षडृतुतुर्येषु दिक्सप्ताह विनेति छ.. / बुधः
षड्द्व्यष्टतुर्षेषु दिक्सप्तषड् विनेति ख..
5 सप्तायत्रिदशादिस्थ इति ख.. छ.. च
6 बुधः षडष्टदिगित्यादिः, बलदः सदा इत्य् अन्तः
पाठो ग.. पुस्तके नास्ति
7 एवं दृष्टिवले पूर्णादिति छ.. / एवं दृष्टिवले पूर्णेति
ख..
8 वस्वष्टौ इति ख.., छ.. च
:प् 303
95.m:
Capricorn and Gemini are five; Sagittarius, Scorpio, Leo, and Cancer / are six diminished by a quarter; Libra and Virgo are five and a half ghaṭikās.
[Apparatus notes]
1. "kṛṣṇe 'py āpañcamaṃ dinam" in manuscripts kha and cha;
"kṛṣṇe 'py āpañcamād dināt" in manuscript gha.
2. "anurādhottarātrayam" in manuscript ca.
3. "śravaṇaś caite" in manuscript ca.
4. "budhaḥ ṣaḍṛtuturyeṣu diksaptāha vinā" in manuscript cha; "budhaḥ ṣaḍdvyaṣṭaturṣeṣu diksaptaṣaḍ vinā" in manuscript kha.
5. "saptāyatridaśādisthaḥ" in manuscripts kha, cha, and ca.
6. The reading from "budhaḥ ṣaḍaṣṭadig" up to "baladaḥ sadā" is missing in manuscript ga.
7. "evaṃ dṛṣṭivale pūrṇāt" in manuscript cha; "evaṃ dṛṣṭivale pūrṇā" in manuscript kha.
8. "vasvaṣṭau" in manuscripts kha and cha.

95.s:
keśarī vṛṣabhaḥ kumbhaḥ sthirāḥ syuḥ siddhidāyakāḥ /
carā dhanustulāmeṣā dviḥsvabhāvāstṛtīyakāḥ(1) //
95.d:
केशरी वृषभः कुम्भः स्थिराः स्युः सिद्धिदायकाः /
चरा धनुस्तुलामेषा द्विःस्वभावास्तृतीयकाः(1) //
95.m: Leo, Taurus, and Aquarius are fixed [signs] that bestow success; / movable are Sagittarius, Libra, and Aries; the dual-natured are the third class.

95.s:
śubhaḥ(2) śubhagrahair dṛṣṭaḥ śasto lagnaḥśubhāśritaḥ(3) /
guruśukrabudhe yukto lagno dadyādbalāyudhī(4) //
95.d:
शुभः(2) शुभग्रहैर् दृष्टः शस्तो लग्नःशुभाश्रितः(3) /
गुरुशुक्रबुधे युक्तो लग्नो दद्याद्बलायुधी(4) //
95.m: An auspicious ascendant aspected by benefic planets, or occupied by benefics, is favored. / An ascendant conjoined with Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury bestows strength and weapons,

95.s:
rājyaṃ śauryaṃ(5) balaṃ putrān yaśodharmādikaṃ bahu /
prathamaḥ saptamasturyo daśamaḥ kendra ucyate //
95.d:
राज्यं शौर्यं(5) बलं पुत्रान् यशोधर्मादिकं बहु /
प्रथमः सप्तमस्तुर्यो दशमः केन्द्र उच्यते //
95.m: kingship, valor, strength, sons, fame, righteousness, and much else. / The first, seventh, fourth, and tenth [houses] are called cardinal.

95.s:
guruśukrabudhāstatra sarvasiddhiprasādakāḥ /
tryekādaśacaturthasthā(6) lagnāt pāpagrahāḥ śubhāḥ //
95.d:
गुरुशुक्रबुधास्तत्र सर्वसिद्धिप्रसादकाः /
त्र्येकादशचतुर्थस्था(6) लग्नात् पापग्रहाः शुभाः //
95.m: Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury there bestow all success. / Malefic planets are auspicious in the third, eleventh, and fourth from the ascendant.

95.s:
atopyanīcakarmāthaṃ(7) yojyāstithyādayo budhaiḥ /
dhāmnaḥ pañcaguṇāṃ bhūmiṃ tyaktvā vā dhānasammitāṃ(8) //
95.d:
अतोप्यनीचकर्माथं(7) योज्यास्तिथ्यादयो बुधैः /
धाम्नः पञ्चगुणां भूमिं त्यक्त्वा वा धानसम्मितां(8) //
95.m: Therefore, the lunar days and other factors should be employed by the wise for non-ignoble undertakings. / Leaving aside land five times the temple, or equal to the temple,

95.s:
hastād dvādaśasopānāt(9) kuryānmaṇḍamagrataḥ /
caturasraṃ caturdvāraṃ snānārthantu(10) tadardhataḥ //
95.d:
हस्ताद् द्वादशसोपानात्(9) कुर्यान्मण्डमग्रतः /
चतुरस्रं चतुर्द्वारं स्नानार्थन्तु(10) तदर्धतः //
95.m: one should construct a pavilion in front, [measuring] from a cubit up to twelve steps, / square with four entrances, or half that for the purpose of bathing,

95.s:
ekāsyaṃ caturāsyaṃ vā raudryāṃ prācyuttarethavā(11) /
hāstiko daśahasto vai maṇḍaporkakaro 'thavā //
95.d:
एकास्यं चतुरास्यं वा रौद्र्यां प्राच्युत्तरेथवा(11) /
हास्तिको दशहस्तो वै मण्डपोर्ककरो ऽथवा //
95.m: with one entrance or with four entrances, in the northeast, the east, or the north; / the pavilion may be one cubit, ten cubits, or twelve cubits.

95.s:
dvihastottarayā vṛddhyā(12) śeṣaṃ syānmaṇḍapāṣṭakaṃ /
:n
1 karkaṭo makaro dvisthaḥ pravrajyākāryanāśakāḥ /
guruśakrabudhāstatra sarvasiddhipradāyakā iti ga. gha.. pustake 'dhikaḥ
pāṭhaḥ
2 sthira iti ga..
3 śubhānvita iti kha.. , cha.. ca
4 dhanāyuṣīti ga..
5 rājyaṃ saukhyamiti kha..
6 dvyekādaśacaturthasthā iti cha.. / tryekādaśetyardhaśloko ga.. pustake
nāsti
7 atonyeniṣṭhakarmārthamiti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca
8 tyaktvā vā cāpasammitāmiti kha.. / tyaktvā vā rāmasammitāmiti
cha..
9 hastādvā daśasopānāditi kha.. / hastān vā daśa sopānāditi kha..
10 snānārhaṃ ceti ṅa..
11 prācyutare tatheti ṅa..
12 dvihastottarayāvṛttyā iti gha..
:p 304
vedī catuṣkarā madhye koṇastambhena saṃyutā(1) //
95.d:
द्विहस्तोत्तरया वृद्ध्या(12) शेषं स्यान्मण्डपाष्टकं /
:न्
1 कर्कटो मकरो द्विस्थः प्रव्रज्याकार्यनाशकाः /
गुरुशक्रबुधास्तत्र सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायका इति ग. घ.. पुस्तके ऽधिकः
पाठः
2 स्थिर इति ग..
3 शुभान्वित इति ख.. , छ.. च
4 धनायुषीति ग..
5 राज्यं सौख्यमिति ख..
6 द्व्येकादशचतुर्थस्था इति छ.. / त्र्येकादशेत्यर्धश्लोको ग.. पुस्तके
नास्ति
7 अतोन्येनिष्ठकर्मार्थमिति ख.. , घ.. , छ.. च
8 त्यक्त्वा वा चापसम्मितामिति ख.. / त्यक्त्वा वा रामसम्मितामिति
छ..
9 हस्ताद्वा दशसोपानादिति ख.. / हस्तान् वा दश सोपानादिति ख..
10 स्नानार्हं चेति ङ..
11 प्राच्युतरे तथेति ङ..
12 द्विहस्तोत्तरयावृत्त्या इति घ..
:प् 304
वेदी चतुष्करा मध्ये कोणस्तम्भेन संयुता(1) //
95.m:
With an increase of two cubits each, the remaining eight pavilions should be made.
[Notes]:
1. "Cancer and Capricorn situated in the second [house] destroy ascetism and endeavors;
Jupiter, Indra [Venus], and Mercury situated there bestow all perfections" is an additional reading in manuscripts ga and gha.
2. "sthira" in manuscript ga.
3. "śubhānvitaḥ" in manuscripts kha and cha.
4. "dhanāyuṣī" in manuscript ga.
5. "rājyaṃ saukhyam" in manuscript kha.
6. "dvyekādaśacaturthasthāḥ" in manuscript cha. / The half-verse "tryekādaśa…" is not present in manuscript ga.
7. "ato 'nye 'niṣṭhakarmārtham" in manuscripts kha, gha, and cha.
8. "tyaktvā vā cāpasammitām" in manuscript kha; / "tyaktvā vā rāmasammitām" in manuscript cha.
9. "hastādvā daśasopānāt" in manuscript kha; / "hastān vā daśa sopānāt" in manuscript kha.
10. "snānārhañca" in manuscript ṅa.
11. "prācyuttare tathā" in manuscript ṅa.
12. "dvihastottarayā vṛttyā" in manuscript gha.
[Page 304]
In the center there should be an altar of four cubits, furnished with corner pillars.

95.s:
vedīpādāntaraṃ tyaktvā(2) kuṇḍāni nava pañca vā /
ekaṃ vā śivakāṣṭhāyāṃ(3) prācyāṃ vā tadguroḥ paraṃ //
95.d:
वेदीपादान्तरं त्यक्त्वा(2) कुण्डानि नव पञ्च वा /
एकं वा शिवकाष्ठायां(3) प्राच्यां वा तद्गुरोः परं //
95.m: Leaving a distance equal to a leg of the altar, there should be nine or five fire-pits, / or one in the direction of Śiva [the northeast] or in the east, which is for the guru.

95.s:
muṣṭimātraṃ śatārdhe syācchate cāratrimātrakaṃ(4) /
hastaṃ sahasrahome syānniyute tu dvihāstikaṃ(5) //
95.d:
मुष्टिमात्रं शतार्धे स्याच्छते चारत्रिमात्रकं(4) /
हस्तं सहस्रहोमे स्यान्नियुते तु द्विहास्तिकं(5) //
95.m: For fifty [oblations] it should measure a fist; for a hundred, an aratni [cubit without fingers]; / for a thousand fire oblations, one cubit; and for a hundred thousand, two cubits.

95.s:
lakṣe catuṣkāraṃ kuṇḍaṃ koṭihome 'ṣṭahastakaṃ /
bhagābhamagnau(6) khaṇḍendu dakṣe tryasrañca nairṛte //
95.d:
लक्षे चतुष्कारं कुण्डं कोटिहोमे ऽष्टहस्तकं /
भगाभमग्नौ(6) खण्डेन्दु दक्षे त्र्यस्रञ्च नैरृते //
95.m: For a hundred thousand, the fire-pit should be four cubits; for ten million fire oblations, eight cubits. / Resembling a vulva in the southeast; a crescent moon in the south; and triangular in the southwest;

95.s:
ṣaḍasraṃ vāyave padmaṃ(7) saumye cāṣṭāsrakaṃ śive /
tiryakpātaśivaṃ khātamūrdhvaṃ(8) mekhalayā saha //
95.d:
षडस्रं वायवे पद्मं(7) सौम्ये चाष्टास्रकं शिवे /
तिर्यक्पातशिवं खातमूर्ध्वं(8) मेखलया सह //
95.m: hexagonal in the northwest; a lotus in the north; and octagonal in the northeast. / The depth should be equal to its crosswise fall, together with the upper rim.

95.s:
tadvahirmekhalāstisro vedavahniyamāṅgulaiḥ(9) /
aṅgulaiḥ ṣaḍbhirekā vā kuṇḍākārāstu mekhalāḥ //
95.d:
तद्वहिर्मेखलास्तिस्रो वेदवह्नियमाङ्गुलैः(9) /
अङ्गुलैः षड्भिरेका वा कुण्डाकारास्तु मेखलाः //
95.m: Outside that there should be three rims of four, three, and two digits; / or one rim of six digits; the rims should have the shape of the fire-pit.

95.s:
tāsāmupari yoniḥ syānmadhye 'śvatthadalākṛtiḥ /
ucchrāyeṇāṅgulaṃ tasmādvistāreṇāṅgulāṣṭakaṃ(10) //
95.d:
तासामुपरि योनिः स्यान्मध्ये ऽश्वत्थदलाकृतिः /
उच्छ्रायेणाङ्गुलं तस्माद्विस्तारेणाङ्गुलाष्टकं(10) //
95.m: Above them should be the vulva-spout, in the shape of a peepal leaf in the middle; / one digit in height, and eight digits in width from it;

95.s:
dairghyaṃ kuṇḍārdhamānena kuṇḍakaṇṭhasamo 'dharaḥ /
pūrvāgniyāmyakuṇḍānāṃ yoniḥ syāduttarānanā //
95.d:
दैर्घ्यं कुण्डार्धमानेन कुण्डकण्ठसमो ऽधरः /
पूर्वाग्नियाम्यकुण्डानां योनिः स्यादुत्तरानना //
95.m: its length measuring half the fire-pit, its lower part level with the neck of the fire-pit. / For the fire-pits in the east, southeast, and south, the vulva-spout should face north;

95.s:
pūrvānanā tu śeṣāṇāmaiśānye 'nyatarā tayoḥ /
:n
1 koṇastambheṣu saṃyuteti ka.. , ga.. , gha.. ca / koṇastambheṣu sanmateti
ṅa.. / koṇastambhenusaṃyuteti kha.. , cha.. ca
2 vedī pādāntaraṃ tyakteti gha.. , ṅa.. , ca
3 śivakāṣṭādau iti ga..
4 śatārdhasya śate vahnimātrakamiti cha.. / śatārdhasya śate
vāratrimātrakamiti gha.. / śatārdhasya śate vā vahnimātrakamiti
ṅa..
5 dvihastakamiti kha..
6 khadgābhamagnau iti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca
7 padme iti kha.. , gha.. ca
8 tiryak pātasamamūrdhvamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. ca
9 vedavahniyavāṅgulair iti gha..
10 tasya vistareṇāṅgulāṣṭakamiti gha..
:p 305
kuṇḍānāṃ yaś caturviṃśo bhāgaḥ soṅgula ity ataḥ //
95.d:
पूर्वानना तु शेषाणामैशान्ये ऽन्यतरा तयोः /
:न्
1 कोणस्तम्भेषु संयुतेति क.. , ग.. , घ.. च / कोणस्तम्भेषु सन्मतेति
ङ.. / कोणस्तम्भेनुसंयुतेति ख.. , छ.. च
2 वेदी पादान्तरं त्यक्तेति घ.. , ङ.. , च
3 शिवकाष्टादौ इति ग..
4 शतार्धस्य शते वह्निमात्रकमिति छ.. / शतार्धस्य शते
वारत्रिमात्रकमिति घ.. / शतार्धस्य शते वा वह्निमात्रकमिति
ङ..
5 द्विहस्तकमिति ख..
6 खद्गाभमग्नौ इति ख.. , ग.. , ङ.. , छ.. च
7 पद्मे इति ख.. , घ.. च
8 तिर्यक् पातसममूर्ध्वमिति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. च
9 वेदवह्नियवाङ्गुलैर् इति घ..
10 तस्य विस्तरेणाङ्गुलाष्टकमिति घ..
:प् 305
कुण्डानां यश् चतुर्विंशो भागः सोङ्गुल इत्य् अतः //
95.m:
for the remaining [fire-pits] it should face east; in the northeast, it may be either of the two.
[Notes]:
1. "koṇastambheṣu saṃyutā" in manuscripts ka, ga, and gha; / "koṇastambheṣu sanmatā" in manuscript ṅa; / "koṇastambhenusaṃyutā" in manuscripts kha and cha.
2. "vedī pādāntaraṃ tyaktā" in manuscripts gha and ṅa.
3. "śivakāṣṭhādau" in manuscript ga.
4. "śatārdhasya śate vahnimātrakam" in manuscript cha; / "śatārdhasya śate vāratrimātrakam" in manuscript gha; / "śatārdhasya śate vā vahnimātrakam" in manuscript ṅa.
5. "dvihastakam" in manuscript kha.
6. "khaḍgābhamagnau" in manuscripts kha, ga, ṅa, and cha.
7. "padme" in manuscripts kha and gha.
8. "tiryagpātasamamūrdhvam" in manuscripts kha, ga, and gha.
9. "vedavahniyavāṅgulaiḥ" in manuscript gha.
10. "tasya vistāreṇāṅgulāṣṭakam" in manuscript gha.
[Page 305]
The twenty-fourth part of the fire-pits is called a digit for this purpose.

95.s:
plakṣodumvarakāśvatthavaṭajāstoraṇāḥ kramāt /
śāntibhūtibalārogyapūrvādyā nāmataḥ kramāt //
95.d:
प्लक्षोदुम्वरकाश्वत्थवटजास्तोरणाः क्रमात् /
शान्तिभूतिबलारोग्यपूर्वाद्या नामतः क्रमात् //
95.m: The archways are made of plakṣa, udumbara, aśvattha, and vaṭa in sequence, / named respectively according to their presiding deities from the east: Tranquility, Prosperity, Strength, and Health.

95.s:
pañcaṣaṭsaptahastāni hastakhātasthitāni ca /
tadardhavistarāṇi syuryutānyāmradalādibhiḥ //
95.d:
पञ्चषट्सप्तहस्तानि हस्तखातस्थितानि च /
तदर्धविस्तराणि स्युर्युतान्याम्रदलादिभिः //
95.m: They should be five, six, and seven cubits [in height], set in pits of one cubit, / half that in width, and adorned with mango leaves and the like.

95.s:
indrāyudhopamā raktā kṛṣṇā dhūmrā śaśiprabhā /
śuklābhā(1) hemavarṇā ca patākā sphāṭikopamā //
95.d:
इन्द्रायुधोपमा रक्ता कृष्णा धूम्रा शशिप्रभा /
शुक्लाभा(1) हेमवर्णा च पताका स्फाटिकोपमा //
95.m: Resembling a rainbow, red, black, smoky, moon-bright, / white-shining, gold-colored, and crystal-like flags

95.s:
pūrvāditobjaje(2) raktā nīlānantasya(3) nairṛte /
pañcahastāstadardhāś ca dhvajā dīrghāś ca vistarāḥ //
95.d:
पूर्वादितोब्जजे(2) रक्ता नीलानन्तस्य(3) नैरृते /
पञ्चहस्तास्तदर्धाश् च ध्वजा दीर्घाश् च विस्तराः //
95.m: should be [set] from the east onwards, red for the lotus-born [Brahmā] above, and dark blue for Ananta in the southwest. / The flags are five cubits in length and half that in width.

95.s:
hastapradeśitā daṇḍā dhvajānāṃ pañcahastakāḥ /
valmīkāddantidantāgrāttathā(4) vṛṣabhaśṛṅgataḥ //
95.d:
हस्तप्रदेशिता दण्डा ध्वजानां पञ्चहस्तकाः /
वल्मीकाद्दन्तिदन्ताग्रात्तथा(4) वृषभशृङ्गतः //
95.m: The staffs of the flags should be five cubits, prescribed in cubits. / From an anthill, the tip of an elephant's tusk, and the horn of a bull,

95.s:
padmaṣaṇḍādvarāhāñca goṣṭhādapi catuṣpathāt /
mṛttikā dvādaśa grāhyā vaikuṇṭheṣṭau pinākini //
95.d:
पद्मषण्डाद्वराहाञ्च गोष्ठादपि चतुष्पथात् /
मृत्तिका द्वादश ग्राह्या वैकुण्ठेष्टौ पिनाकिनि //
95.m: from a lotus bed, a boar's [dwelling], a cowpen, and a crossroads— / twelve soils are to be taken for Vaikuṇṭha, eight for the wielder of Pināka [Śiva].

95.s:
nyagrodhodumvarāśvatthacūtajamvutvagudbhavaṃ /
kaṣāyapañcakaṃ grāhyamārtavañca phalāṣṭakaṃ //
95.d:
न्यग्रोधोदुम्वराश्वत्थचूतजम्वुत्वगुद्भवं /
कषायपञ्चकं ग्राह्यमार्तवञ्च फलाष्टकं //
95.m: Produced from the bark of nyagrodha, udumbara, aśvattha, mango, and rose-apple, / a group of five astringent barks is to be taken, and eight seasonal fruits.

95.s:
tīrthāmbhāṃsi sugandhīni(5) tathā sarvauṣadhījalaṃ /
śastaṃ puṣpaphalaṃ vakṣye ratnagośṛṅgavāri(6) ca //
95.d:
तीर्थाम्भांसि सुगन्धीनि(5) तथा सर्वौषधीजलं /
शस्तं पुष्पफलं वक्ष्ये रत्नगोशृङ्गवारि(6) च //
95.m: Fragrant waters from sacred fords, water with all herbs, / auspicious flowers and fruits, and water from jewels and cow horns I shall describe.

95.s:
snānāyāpāharet(7) pañca pañcagavyāmṛtaṃ tathā /
piṣṭanirmitavastrādidravyaṃ nirmañjanāya(8) ca //
:n
1 śukrābheti kha..
2 pūrvādino dhvaje iti ga..
3 nīlānante 'theti ga..
4 valmīkāddhastidantāgrāttayeti cha..
5 tīrthatoyasugandhīni iti ṅa..
6 varge gośṛṅgavāri ceti cha..
7 snānāyopaharediti kha.. , cha.. , gha.. ca
8 piṣṭanirmitarudrādidravyaṃ nirmañjanāyeti ga.. /
piṣṭanirmitavajrādikaṃ nirmathanāyeti ja..
:p 306
95.d:
स्नानायापाहरेत्(7) पञ्च पञ्चगव्यामृतं तथा /
पिष्टनिर्मितवस्त्रादिद्रव्यं निर्मञ्जनाय(8) च //
:न्
1 शुक्राभेति ख..
2 पूर्वादिनो ध्वजे इति ग..
3 नीलानन्ते ऽथेति ग..
4 वल्मीकाद्धस्तिदन्ताग्रात्तयेति छ..
5 तीर्थतोयसुगन्धीनि इति ङ..
6 वर्गे गोशृङ्गवारि चेति छ..
7 स्नानायोपहरेदिति ख.. , छ.. , घ.. च
8 पिष्टनिर्मितरुद्रादिद्रव्यं निर्मञ्जनायेति ग.. /
पिष्टनिर्मितवज्रादिकं निर्मथनायेति ज..
:प् 306
95.m:
One should bring five [waters] for bathing, as well as the nectar of the five cow-products, / and substances such as cloth made of paste for waving [lamps and offerings].
[Notes]:
1. "śukrābhā" in manuscript kha.
2. "pūrvādino dhvaje" in manuscript ga.
3. "nīlānante 'tha" in manuscript ga.
5. "valmīkāddhastidantāgrāttayā" in manuscript cha.
5. "tīrthatoyasugandhīni" in manuscript ṅa.
6. "varge gośṛṅgavāri ca" in manuscript cha.
7. "snānāyopaharet" in manuscripts kha, cha, and gha.
8. "piṣṭanirmitarudrādidravyaṃ nirmañjanāya" in manuscript ga;
9. "piṣṭanirmitavajrādikaṃ nirmathanāya" in manuscript ja.
[Page 306]

95.s:
sahasraśuṣiraṃ kumbhaṃ maṇḍalāya ca rocanā(1) /
śatamoṣadhimūlānāṃ vijayā lakṣmaṇā balā //
95.d:
सहस्रशुषिरं कुम्भं मण्डलाय च रोचना(1) /
शतमोषधिमूलानां विजया लक्ष्मणा बला //
95.m: A pot perforated with a thousand holes, yellow pigment for the maṇḍala, / a hundred herbal roots: vijayā, lakṣmaṇā, balā,

95.s:
guḍūcyatibalā pāṭhā sahadevā śatāvarī /
ṛddhiḥ(2) suvarcasā(3) vṛddhiḥ snāne proktā pṛthak pṛthak //
95.d:
गुडूच्यतिबला पाठा सहदेवा शतावरी /
ऋद्धिः(2) सुवर्चसा(3) वृद्धिः स्नाने प्रोक्ता पृथक् पृथक् //
95.m: guḍūcī, atibalā, pāṭhā, sahadevā, śatāvarī, / ṛddhi, suvarcasā, and vṛddhi are individually prescribed for the bath.

95.s:
rakṣāyai tiladarbhaugho(4) bhasmasnānantu kevalaṃ /
yavagodhūmavilvānāṃ(5) cūrṇāni ca vicakṣaṇaḥ //
95.d:
रक्षायै तिलदर्भौघो(4) भस्मस्नानन्तु केवलं /
यवगोधूमविल्वानां(5) चूर्णानि च विचक्षणः //
95.m: For protection, an abundance of sesame and darbha grass; pure ash for bathing; / and the wise one [should procure] powders of barley, wheat, and vilva,

95.s:
vilepanaṃ(6) sakarpūraṃ snānārthaṃ kumbhagaṇḍakān(7) /
khaṭvāñca tūlikāyugmaṃ sopadhānaṃ savastrakaṃ //
95.d:
विलेपनं(6) सकर्पूरं स्नानार्थं कुम्भगण्डकान्(7) /
खट्वाञ्च तूलिकायुग्मं सोपधानं सवस्त्रकं //
95.m: ointment mixed with camphor, small waterpots for the bath, / a cot, a pair of mattresses, with pillows and bedcovers.

95.s:
kuryādvittānusāreṇa śayane lakṣyakalpane(8) /
ghṛtakṣaudrayutaṃ pātraṃ kuryāt svarṇaśalākikāṃ //
95.d:
कुर्याद्वित्तानुसारेण शयने लक्ष्यकल्पने(8) /
घृतक्षौद्रयुतं पात्रं कुर्यात् स्वर्णशलाकिकां //
95.m: According to one's wealth, one should arrange a visible bedstead; / and one should prepare a golden probe along with a vessel containing ghee and honey.

95.s:
vardhanīṃ śivakumbhañca lokapālaghaṭānapi /
ekaṃ nidrākṛte kumbhaṃ śāntyarthaṃ kuṇḍasaṅkhyayā(9) //
95.d:
वर्धनीं शिवकुम्भञ्च लोकपालघटानपि /
एकं निद्राकृते कुम्भं शान्त्यर्थं कुण्डसङ्ख्यया(9) //
95.m: [One should prepare] the vardhanī vessel and the Śiva-pitcher, as well as the pitchers of the world-guardians, / one pitcher for the sleep [rite], and pitchers according to the number of fire-pits for the rite of pacification;

95.s:
dvārapālādidharmādipraśāntādighaṭānapi /
vastulakṣmīgaṇeśānāṃ kalaśānaparānapi //
95.d:
द्वारपालादिधर्मादिप्रशान्तादिघटानपि /
वस्तुलक्ष्मीगणेशानां कलशानपरानपि //
95.m: and pitchers for the gatekeepers, Dharma and the rest, Praśānta and others, / and also other jars for Vāstu, Lakṣmī, and Gaṇeśa;

95.s:
dhānyapuñjakṛtādhārān savastrān(10) sragvibhūṣitān /
:n
1 maṅgalāya ca rocaneti ga.. / maṅgalāya ca rocanamiti ja..
2 siddhiriti gha..
3 suvarcaleti ja..
4 tilagarbhādyamiti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca / tiladarbhājyamiti ja..
5 yavagodhūmacūrṇānāmiti gha.. / pañcagodhūmavilvānāmiti cha..
6 lepanañceti ja..
7 kumbhamaṇḍakāniti kha.. / kumbhagaḍḍukāniti gha.. /
kumbhaguṇḍukāniti ṅa..
kumbhasaṇḍakāniti cha.. / kumbhakhaṇḍakāniti ja..
8 prāyeṇa lakṣyakalpane iti ga.. / śayane lakṣyakaṃ pare iti ja..
9 kuṇḍasanmitamiti ja..
10 sarvāṃśceti gha.. , ja.. ca
:p 307
sahiraṇyān samālabdhān gandhapānīyapūritān //
95.d:
धान्यपुञ्जकृताधारान् सवस्त्रान्(10) स्रग्विभूषितान् /
:न्
1 मङ्गलाय च रोचनेति ग.. / मङ्गलाय च रोचनमिति ज..
2 सिद्धिरिति घ..
3 सुवर्चलेति ज..
4 तिलगर्भाद्यमिति ख.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. च / तिलदर्भाज्यमिति ज..
5 यवगोधूमचूर्णानामिति घ.. / पञ्चगोधूमविल्वानामिति छ..
6 लेपनञ्चेति ज..
7 कुम्भमण्डकानिति ख.. / कुम्भगड्डुकानिति घ.. /
कुम्भगुण्डुकानिति ङ..
कुम्भसण्डकानिति छ.. / कुम्भखण्डकानिति ज..
8 प्रायेण लक्ष्यकल्पने इति ग.. / शयने लक्ष्यकं परे इति ज..
9 कुण्डसन्मितमिति ज..
10 सर्वांश्चेति घ.. , ज.. च
:प् 307
सहिरण्यान् समालब्धान् गन्धपानीयपूरितान् //
95.m:
having heaps of grain for their pedestals, draped in cloth, adorned with flower garlands,
[Gap in text]
1. 'maṅgalāya ca rocanā' in ga; 'maṅgalāya ca rocanam' in ja.
2. 'siddhiḥ' in gha.
3. 'suvarcalā' in ja.
4. 'tilagarbhādyam' in kha, gha, ṅa, and cha; 'tiladarbhājyam' in ja.
5. 'yavagodhūmacūrṇānām' in gha; 'pañcagodhūmavilvānām' in cha.
6. 'lepanañ ca' in ja.
7. 'kumbhamaṇḍakān' in kha; 'kumbhagaḍḍukān' in gha;
'kumbhaguṇḍukān' in ṅa;
'kumbhasaṇḍakān' in cha; 'kumbhakhaṇḍakān' in ja.
8. 'prāyeṇa lakṣyakalpane' in ga; 'śayane lakṣyakaṃ pare' in ja.
9. 'kuṇḍasanmitam' in ja.
10. 'sarvāṃś ca' in gha and ja. [p. 307]
containing gold, smeared [with unguents], and filled with scented water;

95.s:
pūrṇapātraphalādhārān(1) pallavādyān(2) salakṣaṇān /
vastrair ācchādayet kumbhānāharedgaurasarṣapān //
95.d:
पूर्णपात्रफलाधारान्(1) पल्लवाद्यान्(2) सलक्षणान् /
वस्त्रैर् आच्छादयेत् कुम्भानाहरेद्गौरसर्षपान् //
95.m: supported by full vessels and fruits, having sprout-shoots and [auspicious] signs. / One should cover the pitchers with cloths and bring white mustard seeds,

95.s:
vikirārthantathā lājān jñānakhaḍgañca pūrvavat /
sāpidhānāṃ carusthālīṃ darvīṃ ca tāmranirmitāṃ(3) //
95.d:
विकिरार्थन्तथा लाजान् ज्ञानखड्गञ्च पूर्ववत् /
सापिधानां चरुस्थालीं दर्वीं च ताम्रनिर्मितां(3) //
95.m: as well as parched grains for scattering, and the sword of knowledge as before; / a cooking pot for caru with a lid, and a ladle made of copper;

95.s:
ghṛtakṣaudrānvitaṃ pātraṃ pādābhyaṅgakṛte tathā /
viṣṭarāṃstriśatādarbhadalair bāhupramāṇakān(4) //
95.d:
घृतक्षौद्रान्वितं पात्रं पादाभ्यङ्गकृते तथा /
विष्टरांस्त्रिशतादर्भदलैर् बाहुप्रमाणकान्(4) //
95.m: a vessel containing ghee and honey, likewise for anointing the feet; / grass seats made with three hundred darbha grass blades, an arm's length in measure;

95.s:
caturaś caturastadvat pālāśān paridhīnapi /
tilapātraṃ haviḥpātramardhapātraṃ pavitrakaṃ //
95.d:
चतुरश् चतुरस्तद्वत् पालाशान् परिधीनपि /
तिलपात्रं हविःपात्रमर्धपात्रं पवित्रकं //
95.m: four palāśa boundary sticks each, likewise four in number; / a sesame vessel, a vessel for sacrificial oblation, a half-vessel, and a purifying ring;

95.s:
phalaviṃśāṣṭamānāni ghaṭo dhūpapradānakaṃ(5) /
śrukśruvau piṭakaṃ pīṭhaṃ vyajanaṃ śuṣkamindhanaṃ //
95.d:
फलविंशाष्टमानानि घटो धूपप्रदानकं(5) /
श्रुक्श्रुवौ पिटकं पीठं व्यजनं शुष्कमिन्धनं //
95.m: twenty-eight fruits, an earthen pitcher, an incense burner, / a śruc ladle and śruva spoon, a basket, a stool, a fan, dry firewood,

95.s:
puṣpaṃ patraṃ gugglañca ghṛtair daupāṃś ca dhūpakaṃ /
akṣatāni trisūtrīñca gavyamājyaṃ yavāṃstilān //
95.d:
पुष्पं पत्रं गुग्ग्लञ्च घृतैर् दौपांश् च धूपकं /
अक्षतानि त्रिसूत्रीञ्च गव्यमाज्यं यवांस्तिलान् //
95.m: flowers, leaves, bdellium resin, lamps with ghee, incense, / unhusked grains, triple cord, cow's ghee, barley, sesame seeds,

95.s:
kuśāḥ śāntyai trimadhuraṃ samidho daśaparvikāḥ /
bāhumātraśruvaṃ hastam(6) arkādigrahaśāntaye //
95.d:
कुशाः शान्त्यै त्रिमधुरं समिधो दशपर्विकाः /
बाहुमात्रश्रुवं हस्तम्(6) अर्कादिग्रहशान्तये //
95.m: kuśa grass for the pacification, the three sweets, kindling sticks with ten nodes, / a śruva spoon one cubit in length for the pacification of the Sun and other planets;

95.s:
samidho 'rkapalāśotthāḥ khādirāmārgapippalāḥ(7) /
udumvaraśamīdūrvākuśotthāḥ śatamaṣṭa ca //
95.d:
समिधो ऽर्कपलाशोत्थाः खादिरामार्गपिप्पलाः(7) /
उदुम्वरशमीदूर्वाकुशोत्थाः शतमष्ट च //
95.m: one hundred and eight kindling sticks originating from arka, palāśa, / khadira, apāmārga, pippala, / udumbara, śamī, dūrvā, and kuśa.

95.s:
tadabhāve yavatilā gṛhopakaraṇaṃ tathā /
sthālīdarvīpidhānādi devādibhyo 'ṃśukadvayaṃ //
95.d:
तदभावे यवतिला गृहोपकरणं तथा /
स्थालीदर्वीपिधानादि देवादिभ्यो ऽंशुकद्वयं //
95.m: In their absence, barley and sesame; likewise household utensils, / a cooking pot, a ladle, a lid, and the like; two garments for the deities and others;

95.s:
mudrāmukuṭavāsāṃsi hārakuṇḍalakaṅkaṇān /
:n
1 pūrvapātraphalādhārāniti cha..
2 pallavāgrāniti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca
3 kurvīta tāmranirmitāmiti kha..
4 dalair bāhumātrapramāṇata iti ga..
5 ghaṇṭādhūpapradānakamiti gha.. , cha.. ca
6 bāhumātrāṃ srucaṃ hastānāmiti cha..
7 khādirāpāṅgapippalā iti kha.. , cha.. , ca / khādirāpāmārkapippalā iti
gha..
:p 308
kuryādācāryapūjārthaṃ(1) vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet //
95.d:
मुद्रामुकुटवासांसि हारकुण्डलकङ्कणान् /
:न्
1 पूर्वपात्रफलाधारानिति छ..
2 पल्लवाग्रानिति ख.. , घ.. , ज.. च
3 कुर्वीत ताम्रनिर्मितामिति ख..
4 दलैर् बाहुमात्रप्रमाणत इति ग..
5 घण्टाधूपप्रदानकमिति घ.. , छ.. च
6 बाहुमात्रां स्रुचं हस्तानामिति छ..
7 खादिरापाङ्गपिप्पला इति ख.. , छ.. , च / खादिरापामार्कपिप्पला इति
घ..
:प् 308
कुर्यादाचार्यपूजार्थं(1) वित्तशाठ्यं विवर्जयेत् //
95.m:
rings, crowns, garments, necklaces, earrings, and bracelets,
[Gap in text]
1. 'pūrvapātraphalādhārān' in cha.
2. 'pallavāgrān' in kha, gha, and ja.
3. 'kurvīta tāmranirmitām' in kha.
4. 'dalair bāhumātrapramāṇataḥ' in ga.
5. 'ghaṇṭādhūpapradānakam' in gha and cha.
6. 'bāhumātrāṃ srucaṃ hastānām' in cha.
7. 'khādirāpāṅgapippalāḥ' in kha and cha; 'khādirāpāmārkapippalāḥ' in gha. [p. 308]
one should provide for the worship of the preceptor; one should avoid stinginess with wealth.

95.s:
tatpādapādahīnā ca mūrtibhṛdastrajāpināṃ(2) /
pūjā syājjāpibhistulyā(3) vipradaivajñaśilpināṃ //
95.d:
तत्पादपादहीना च मूर्तिभृदस्त्रजापिनां(2) /
पूजा स्याज्जापिभिस्तुल्या(3) विप्रदैवज्ञशिल्पिनां //
95.m: And the worship of the image-bearers and the weapon-reciters should be diminished by one-fourth each; / the worship of Brahmins, astrologers, and artisans should equal that of the reciters.

95.s:
vajrārkaśāntau(4) nīlātinīlamuktāphalāni ca(5) /
puṣpapadmādirāgañca vaidūryaṃ ratnamaṣṭamaṃ(6) //
95.d:
वज्रार्कशान्तौ(4) नीलातिनीलमुक्ताफलानि च(5) /
पुष्पपद्मादिरागञ्च वैदूर्यं रत्नमष्टमं(6) //
95.m: For the pacification of the diamond and sun: sapphire, lapis lazuli, pearls, / topaz, ruby, and cat's-eye as the eighth jewel;

95.s:
uṣīramādhavakrāntāraktacandanakāguruṃ /
śrīkhaṇḍaṃ sārikaṅkuṣṭhaṃ(7) śaṅkṣinī hyoṣadhīguṇaḥ(8) //
95.d:
उषीरमाधवक्रान्तारक्तचन्दनकागुरुं /
श्रीखण्डं सारिकङ्कुष्ठं(7) शङ्क्षिनी ह्योषधीगुणः(8) //
95.m: uṣīra, mādhavakrāntā, red sandalwood, agallochum, / white sandalwood, sārikā, kuṣṭha, and śaṅkhinī: this is the group of herbs;

95.s:
hematāmramayaṃ raktaṃ rājatañca(9) sakāṃsyakaṃ /
śīsakañceti lohāni haritālaṃ manaḥśilā //
95.d:
हेमताम्रमयं रक्तं राजतञ्च(9) सकांस्यकं /
शीसकञ्चेति लोहानि हरितालं मनःशिला //
95.m: gold, copper, red [copper], silver, bronze, / and lead: these are the metals; yellow orpiment, realgar,

95.s:
gairikaṃ hemamākṣīkaṃ pārado(10) vahnigairikaṃ /
gandhakābhrakamityaṣṭau(11) dhātavo brīhayas tathā //
95.d:
गैरिकं हेममाक्षीकं पारदो(10) वह्निगैरिकं /
गन्धकाभ्रकमित्यष्टौ(11) धातवो ब्रीहयस् तथा //
95.m: red chalk, iron pyrites, mercury, fire-gairika, / sulphur, and mica: these are the eight minerals; likewise the grains:

95.s:
godhūmān satilānmāṣānmudgānapyāharedyavān /
nīvārān śyāmakānevaṃ brīhayo 'pyaṣṭa kīrtitāḥ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe pratiṣṭhāsāmagrī nāma pañcanavatitamo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 kuryādācāryapūjādyamiti gha..
2 mūrtibhṛcchastrajāpināmiti gha..
3 pūjāsyāt pitṛbhistulyeti gha.. , ja.. ca
4 vastrārkakāntau iti ṅa.. , cha.. , ca
5 nīlābhaṃ nīlamuktāphalāni ceti kha.. / nīlādinīlamuktāphalāni
ceti ga.. / nīlābhaṃ nīlaṃ muktāphalāni veti ja..
6 ratnamaṣṭakamiti gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca
7 sārikā kuṣṭhamiti kha.. , cha.. , ca / sāvikaṃ kuṣṭhamiti ja..
8 śaṅkhinītyoṣadhīgaṇa iti ṅa.. , ja.. , ca
9 hematāmramayo raṅgarājajañceti kha..
10 pārade iti kha.. , cha.. ca
11 gandhakatrikamityaṣṭau iti gha..
:p 309
:ś atha ṣaṇṇavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
adhivāsanavidhiḥ
95.d:
गोधूमान् सतिलान्माषान्मुद्गानप्याहरेद्यवान् /
नीवारान् श्यामकानेवं ब्रीहयो ऽप्यष्ट कीर्तिताः //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे प्रतिष्ठासामग्री नाम पञ्चनवतितमो
ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 कुर्यादाचार्यपूजाद्यमिति घ..
2 मूर्तिभृच्छस्त्रजापिनामिति घ..
3 पूजास्यात् पितृभिस्तुल्येति घ.. , ज.. च
4 वस्त्रार्ककान्तौ इति ङ.. , छ.. , च
5 नीलाभं नीलमुक्ताफलानि चेति ख.. / नीलादिनीलमुक्ताफलानि
चेति ग.. / नीलाभं नीलं मुक्ताफलानि वेति ज..
6 रत्नमष्टकमिति घ.. , ङ.. , ज.. च
7 सारिका कुष्ठमिति ख.. , छ.. , च / साविकं कुष्ठमिति ज..
8 शङ्खिनीत्योषधीगण इति ङ.. , ज.. , च
9 हेमताम्रमयो रङ्गराजजञ्चेति ख..
10 पारदे इति ख.. , छ.. च
11 गन्धकत्रिकमित्यष्टौ इति घ..
:प् 309
:श् अथ षण्णवतितमो ऽध्यायः
अधिवासनविधिः
95.m:
one should gather wheat, sesame, black gram, mung bean, barley, / nīvāra, and śyāmāka; thus eight grains are proclaimed.
Thus ends the ninety-fifth chapter, entitled 'Materials for Consecration', in the glorious Agni Purāṇa.
[Gap in text]
1. 'kuryādācāryapūjādyam' in gha.
2. 'mūrtibhṛcchastrajāpinām' in gha.
3. 'pūjāsyāt pitṛbhistulyā' in gha and ja.
4. 'vastrārkakāntau' in ṅa and cha.
5. 'nīlābhaṃ nīlamuktāphalāni ca' in kha; 'nīlādinīlamuktāphalāni ca' in ga; 'nīlābhaṃ nīlaṃ muktāphalāni vā' in ja.
6. 'ratnamaṣṭakam' in gha, ṅa, and ja.
7. 'sārikā kuṣṭham' in kha and cha; 'sāvikaṃ kuṣṭham' in ja.
8. 'śaṅkhinītyoṣadhīgaṇaḥ' in ṅa and ja.
9. 'hematāmramayo raṅgarājajañca' in kha.
10. 'pārade' in kha and cha.
11. 'gandhakatrikamityaṣṭau' in gha. [p. 309]
Now, ninety-sixth chapter.
The Rule for Preliminary Consecration.

96.s:
īśvara uvāca
snātvā nityadvayaṃ kṛtvā(1) praṇavārghakaro guruḥ(2) /
sahāyair mūrtipair vipraiḥ(3) saha gacchenmakhālayaṃ //
96.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
स्नात्वा नित्यद्वयं कृत्वा(1) प्रणवार्घकरो गुरुः(2) /
सहायैर् मूर्तिपैर् विप्रैः(3) सह गच्छेन्मखालयं //
96.m: The Lord said: / Having bathed and performed the two daily rites, holding the water offering with the praṇava in hand, the Guru / should go to the hall of sacrifice together with his Brahmin assistants, the attendants of the icons.

96.s:
kṣāntyāditoraṇāṃstatra pūrvavat pūjayet kramāt /
pradakṣiṇakramādeṣāṃ śākhāyāṃ dvārapālakān //
96.d:
क्षान्त्यादितोरणांस्तत्र पूर्ववत् पूजयेत् क्रमात् /
प्रदक्षिणक्रमादेषां शाखायां द्वारपालकान् //
96.m: There he should worship the archways of Kṣānti and the others in order, as before, / and on their doorposts, the gatekeepers in clockwise order.

96.s:
prāci nandimahākālau yāmye bhṛṅgivināyakau(4) /
vāruṇe vṛṣabhaskandau devīcaṇḍau tatottare(5) //
96.d:
प्राचि नन्दिमहाकालौ याम्ये भृङ्गिविनायकौ(4) /
वारुणे वृषभस्कन्दौ देवीचण्डौ ततोत्तरे(5) //
96.m: Nandin and Mahākāla in the east, Bhṛṅgin and Vināyaka in the south, / Vṛṣabha and Skanda in the west, and the Goddess and Caṇḍa in the north.

96.s:
tacchākhāmūladeśasthau praśāntaśiśirau ghaṭau /
parjanyāśokanāmānau bhūtaṃ sañjīvanāmṛtau(6) //
96.d:
तच्छाखामूलदेशस्थौ प्रशान्तशिशिरौ घटौ /
पर्जन्याशोकनामानौ भूतं सञ्जीवनामृतौ(6) //
96.m: Standing at the base of their doorposts are the two jars Praśānta and Śiśira, / Parjanya and Aśoka by name, Bhūta and Sañjīvanāmṛta,

96.s:
dhanadaśrīpradau(7) dvau dvau pūjayedanupūrvaśaḥ(8) /
svanāmabhiś caturthyantaiḥ praṇavādinamontagaiḥ //
96.d:
धनदश्रीप्रदौ(7) द्वौ द्वौ पूजयेदनुपूर्वशः(8) /
स्वनामभिश् चतुर्थ्यन्तैः प्रणवादिनमोन्तगैः //
96.m: and Dhanada and Śrīprada; one should worship each pair in succession, / with their own names ending in the dative case, beginning with Praṇava (Oṃ) and ending in namaḥ.

96.s:
lokagrahavasudvāḥsthasravantīnāṃ(6) dvayaṃ dvayaṃ /
:n
1 nityakriyāṃ kṛtveti ṅ.
2 praṇavārghyakaro muniriti ga.. / punararghyakaro muniriti ṅa..
3 sahāyair ṛtvigvipraiśceti kha.. , gha.. ca / sahāyair bhūpativiprair iti
ja..
4 bhṛṅgavināyakāviti cha..
5 vṛṣottare iti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca
6 bhūtasañjīvanāsutau iti cha.. / bhūtasañjīvanāmṛtau iti kha.. , ja..
ca
7 dhanadadvipadau iti kha.. / dhanadau dvipadau iti gha.. / dhanadaścāpadau iti
ja..
8 pūjayedatha pūrvaśa iti ga..
9 lokagrahavasudvāḥsthahastādīnāmiti ga..
:p 310
bhānutrayaṃ yugaṃ vedo lakṣmīrgaṇapatis tathā(1) //
96.d:
लोकग्रहवसुद्वाःस्थस्रवन्तीनां(6) द्वयं द्वयं /
:न्
1 नित्यक्रियां कृत्वेति ङ्.
2 प्रणवार्घ्यकरो मुनिरिति ग.. / पुनरर्घ्यकरो मुनिरिति ङ..
3 सहायैर् ऋत्विग्विप्रैश्चेति ख.. , घ.. च / सहायैर् भूपतिविप्रैर् इति
ज..
4 भृङ्गविनायकाविति छ..
5 वृषोत्तरे इति ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. च
6 भूतसञ्जीवनासुतौ इति छ.. / भूतसञ्जीवनामृतौ इति ख.. , ज..
च
7 धनदद्विपदौ इति ख.. / धनदौ द्विपदौ इति घ.. / धनदश्चापदौ इति
ज..
8 पूजयेदथ पूर्वश इति ग..
9 लोकग्रहवसुद्वाःस्थहस्तादीनामिति ग..
:प् 310
भानुत्रयं युगं वेदो लक्ष्मीर्गणपतिस् तथा(1) //
96.m:
A pair of deities presiding over the worlds, planets, Vasus, doorkeepers, and rivers:
[Footnote 1: "nityakriyāṃ kṛtvā" in ṅ.]
[Footnote 2: "praṇavārghyakaro muniḥ" in ga.; "punararghyakaro muniḥ" in ṅa.]
[Footnote 3: "sahāyair ṛtvigvipraiśca" in kha. and gha.; "sahāyair bhūpativipraiḥ" in ja.]
[Footnote 4: "bhṛṅgavināyakau" in cha.]
[Footnote 5: "vṛṣottare" in ga., gha., and ṅa.]
[Footnote 6: "bhūtasañjīvanāsutau" in cha.; "bhūtasañjīvanāmṛtau" in kha. and ja.]
[Footnote 7: "dhanadadvipadau" in kha.; "dhanadau dvipadau" in gha.; "dhanadaścāpadau" in ja.]
[Footnote 8: "pūjayedatha pūrvaśaḥ" in ga.]
[Footnote 9: "lokagrahavasudvāḥsthahastādīnām" in ga. / p. 310]
three suns, a Yuga, the Veda, and likewise Lakṣmī and Gaṇapati.

96.s:
iti devāmakhāgāre(2) tiṣṭhanti pratitoraṇaṃ /
vighnasaṅghāpanodāya kratoḥ saṃrakṣaṇāya ca //
96.d:
इति देवामखागारे(2) तिष्ठन्ति प्रतितोरणं /
विघ्नसङ्घापनोदाय क्रतोः संरक्षणाय च //
96.m: Thus these deities stand at each gateway in the sacrificial hall, / to remove the multitude of obstacles and to protect the sacrifice.

96.s:
vajraṃ śaktiṃ tathā daṇḍaṃ(3) khaḍgaṃ(3) pāśaṃ dhvajaṃgadāṃ /
triśūlaṃ cakramambhojampatākāsvarcayet(4) kramāt //
oṃ hrūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ hrūṃ phaṭ dvāḥsthaśaktaye
hrūṃ phaṭ namaḥ(5) ity ādimantraiḥ
96.d:
वज्रं शक्तिं तथा दण्डं(3) खड्गं(3) पाशं ध्वजंगदां /
त्रिशूलं चक्रमम्भोजम्पताकास्वर्चयेत्(4) क्रमात् //
ओं ह्रूं फट् नमः / ओं ह्रूं फट् द्वाःस्थशक्तये
ह्रूं फट् नमः(5) इत्य् आदिमन्त्रैः
96.m:
One should worship in succession the thunderbolt, spear, staff, sword, noose, banner, mace, / trident, discus, and lotus on the flags,
with mantras beginning with: "Oṃ hrūṃ phaṭ namaḥ; oṃ hrūṃ phaṭ, homage to the door-guarding power, hrūṃ phaṭ namaḥ."

96.s:
kumudaḥ kumudākṣaś ca puṇḍarīkotha vāmanaḥ /
śaṅkukarṇaḥ sarvanetraḥ sumukhaḥ(6) supratiṣṭhitaḥ //
96.d:
कुमुदः कुमुदाक्षश् च पुण्डरीकोथ वामनः /
शङ्कुकर्णः सर्वनेत्रः सुमुखः(6) सुप्रतिष्ठितः //
96.m: Kumuda, Kumudākṣa, Puṇḍarīka, then Vāmana, / Śaṅkukarṇa, Sarvanetra, Sumukha, and Supratiṣṭhita:

96.s:
dhvajāṣṭadevatāḥ(7) pūjyāḥ pūrvādau(8) bhūtakoṭibhiḥ /
oṃ kauṃ kumudāya nama ity ādimantraiḥ //
96.d:
ध्वजाष्टदेवताः(7) पूज्याः पूर्वादौ(8) भूतकोटिभिः /
ओं कौं कुमुदाय नम इत्य् आदिमन्त्रैः //
96.m: the deities of the eight banners are to be worshipped beginning in the east with crores of spirits, / with mantras beginning with: "Oṃ kauṃ, homage to Kumuda."

96.s:
hetukaṃ tripuraghnañca śaktyākhyaṃ(9) yamajihvakaṃ(10) /
kālaṃ karālinaṃ ṣaṣṭhamekāṅghrimbhīmamaṣṭakaṃ //
96.d:
हेतुकं त्रिपुरघ्नञ्च शक्त्याख्यं(9) यमजिह्वकं(10) /
कालं करालिनं षष्ठमेकाङ्घ्रिम्भीममष्टकं //
96.m: Hetuka, Tripuraghna, the one called Śakti, Yamajihvaka, / Kāla, the sixth Karālin, Ekāṅghri, and the eighth Bhīma:

96.s:
tathaiva pūjayed dikṣu kṣetrapālānanukramāt /
:n
1 bhānutrayaṃ yugaṃ vedo lakṣmīkulapatistatheti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca /
bhānutrayayugaṃ vedo vedo lakṣmīpatistatheti ja..
2 devāmarāgare iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca
3 tathā kuṇḍamiti kha.. , cha.. ca / tathā caṇḍamiti ja..
4 patākāmarcayediti ga.. / patākāsu yajediti ṅa..
5 huṃ phaṭ namaḥ, oṃ huṃ phaṭ dvāḥsthaśaktaye huṃ phaṭ
nama iti kha.. / oṃ krūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ krūṃ phaṭ
dvāḥsthaśaktaye krūṃ phaṭ nama iti cha./ oṃ huṃ phaṭ vakrāya
huṃ phaṭ nama iti ga.. / oṃ huṃ phaṭ vajrāya huṃ phaṭ nama iti
ṅa..
6 pramukha iti ja..
7 dhvajāś ca devatā iti ga..
8 pūjādau iti ṅa.. , ja.. ca
9 buddhākhyamiti ga.. / buddhyākhyamiti ja..
10 ajajihvakamiti ja..
:p 311
balibhiḥ kusumair dhūpaiḥ santuṣṭān paribhāvayet(1) //
96.d:
तथैव पूजयेद् दिक्षु क्षेत्रपालाननुक्रमात् /
:न्
1 भानुत्रयं युगं वेदो लक्ष्मीकुलपतिस्तथेति ख.. , ग.. , छ.. च /
भानुत्रययुगं वेदो वेदो लक्ष्मीपतिस्तथेति ज..
2 देवामरागरे इति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. च
3 तथा कुण्डमिति ख.. , छ.. च / तथा चण्डमिति ज..
4 पताकामर्चयेदिति ग.. / पताकासु यजेदिति ङ..
5 हुं फट् नमः, ओं हुं फट् द्वाःस्थशक्तये हुं फट्
नम इति ख.. / ओं क्रूं फट् नमः / ओं क्रूं फट्
द्वाःस्थशक्तये क्रूं फट् नम इति छ./ ओं हुं फट् वक्राय
हुं फट् नम इति ग.. / ओं हुं फट् वज्राय हुं फट् नम इति
ङ..
6 प्रमुख इति ज..
7 ध्वजाश् च देवता इति ग..
8 पूजादौ इति ङ.. , ज.. च
9 बुद्धाख्यमिति ग.. / बुद्ध्याख्यमिति ज..
10 अजजिह्वकमिति ज..
:प् 311
बलिभिः कुसुमैर् धूपैः सन्तुष्टान् परिभावयेत्(1) //
96.m:
just so one should worship the guardians of the field in the directions in order;
[Footnotes]
[Footnote 1: "bhānutrayaṃ yugaṃ vedo lakṣmīkulapatistathā" in kha., ga., and cha.;]
"bhānutrayayugaṃ vedo vedo lakṣmīpatistathā" in ja.]
[Footnote 2: "devāmarāgare" in kha., ga., gha., ṅa., and cha.]
[Footnote 3: "tathā kuṇḍam" in kha. and cha.; "tathā caṇḍam" in ja.]
[Footnote 4: "patākāmarcayet" in ga.; "patākāsu yajet" in ṅa.]
[Footnote 5: "huṃ phaṭ namaḥ, oṃ huṃ phaṭ dvāḥsthaśaktaye huṃ phaṭ namaḥ" in kha.; "oṃ krūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ krūṃ phaṭ dvāḥsthaśaktaye krūṃ phaṭ namaḥ" in cha.; "oṃ huṃ phaṭ vakrāya huṃ phaṭ namaḥ" in ga.; "oṃ huṃ phaṭ vajrāya huṃ phaṭ namaḥ" in ṅa.]
[Footnote 6: "pramukhaḥ" in ja.]
[Footnote 7: "dhvajāś ca devatāḥ" in ga.]
[Footnote 8: "pūjādau" in ṅa. and ja.]
[Footnote 9: "buddhākhyam" in ga.; "buddhyākhyam" in ja.]
[Footnote 10: "ajajihvakam" in ja. / p. 311]
one should contemplate them gratified with offerings, flowers, and incenses.

96.s:
kambalāstṛteṣu varṇeṣu vaṃśasthūṇāsvanukramāt(2) /
pañca kṣityāditattvāni sadyojātādibhiryajet //
96.d:
कम्बलास्तृतेषु वर्णेषु वंशस्थूणास्वनुक्रमात्(2) /
पञ्च क्षित्यादितत्त्वानि सद्योजातादिभिर्यजेत् //
96.m: On the syllables inscribed upon the blanket spread out, and on the bamboo pillars in order, / one should worship the five principles, beginning with Earth, with [the mantras of] Sadyojāta and the others.

96.s:
sadāśivapadavyāpi maṇḍapaṃ(3) dhāma śāṅkaraṃ /
patākāśaktisaṃyuktaṃ(4) tattvadṛṣṭyāvalokayet(5) //
96.d:
सदाशिवपदव्यापि मण्डपं(3) धाम शाङ्करं /
पताकाशक्तिसंयुक्तं(4) तत्त्वदृष्ट्यावलोकयेत्(5) //
96.m: One should look upon the pavilion, the Śaiva abode pervaded by the state of Sadāśiva, / endowed with the power of the banners, with the vision of reality.

96.s:
divyāntarikṣabhūmiṣṭhavighnānutsārya pūrvavat /
praviśet paścimadvārā śeṣadvārāṇi darśayet(6) //
96.d:
दिव्यान्तरिक्षभूमिष्ठविघ्नानुत्सार्य पूर्ववत् /
प्रविशेत् पश्चिमद्वारा शेषद्वाराणि दर्शयेत्(6) //
96.m: Having expelled celestial, atmospheric, and terrestrial obstacles as before, / one should enter through the western door and survey the remaining doors.

96.s:
pradakṣiṇakramādgatvā niviṣṭovedidakṣiṇe /
uttarābhimukhaḥ kuryād bhūtaśuddhiṃ yathā purā //
96.d:
प्रदक्षिणक्रमाद्गत्वा निविष्टोवेदिदक्षिणे /
उत्तराभिमुखः कुर्याद् भूतशुद्धिं यथा पुरा //
96.m: Going in clockwise circumambulation and sitting to the south of the altar, / facing north, one should perform the purification of the elements as before.

96.s:
antaryāgaṃ viśeṣārghyaṃ mantradravyādiśodhanaṃ /
kurvīta ātmanaḥ(7) pūjāṃ pañcagavyādi pūrvavat //
96.d:
अन्तर्यागं विशेषार्घ्यं मन्त्रद्रव्यादिशोधनं /
कुर्वीत आत्मनः(7) पूजां पञ्चगव्यादि पूर्ववत् //
96.m: One should perform the internal sacrifice, the special water offering, the purification of mantras and articles, / the worship of oneself, the five products of the cow, and so forth, as before.

96.s:
sādhāraṅkalasantasmin vinyasettadanantaraṃ /
viśeṣācchivatattvāya tattvatrayamanukramāt //
96.d:
साधारङ्कलसन्तस्मिन् विन्यसेत्तदनन्तरं /
विशेषाच्छिवतत्त्वाय तत्त्वत्रयमनुक्रमात् //
96.m: Then, one should deposit upon that supported jar / the three principles in succession, specifically for the Śiva principle:

96.s:
lalāṭaskandhapādāntaṃ śivavidyātmakaṃ paraṃ /
rudranārāyaṇabrahmadaivataṃ nijasañcaraiḥ(8) //
:n
1 pravibhāvayediti kha.. , cha.. ca
2 kākṣītṛṇeṣu vargeṣu vaṃśe sthūlānanukramāt iti kha.. /
kāṣṭhātṛṇeṣu varṇeṣu vaṃśe sthūlānanukramāt iti cha.. /
kākṣītṛṇeṣu vaṃśeṣu sthūṇāsvanyeṣvanukramāt iti gha.. /
kakṣāṃ dṛśembarāṃśe ca tṛṇānanyeṣvānukramāditi ja.. /
kanyātṛṇeṣu ratneṣu vaṃśesthūṇānanukramāditi ṅa..
3 maṇḍalamiti ṅa..
4 pinākaśaktisaṃyuktāmiti gha..
5 tattu dṛṣṭyāvalokayediti kha.. , cha.. ca
6 śeṣadvārāṇi caṅkramediti kha.. , cha.. ca / śeṣadvārāṇi
pūjayediti cha..
7 svātmana iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
8 nijasaṃvarair iti ga.. , ṅa.. ca / nijasañcayair iti gha..
:p 312
oṃ haṃ hāṃ(1)
96.d:
ललाटस्कन्धपादान्तं शिवविद्यात्मकं परं /
रुद्रनारायणब्रह्मदैवतं निजसञ्चरैः(8) //
:न्
1 प्रविभावयेदिति ख.. , छ.. च
2 काक्षीतृणेषु वर्गेषु वंशे स्थूलाननुक्रमात् इति ख.. /
काष्ठातृणेषु वर्णेषु वंशे स्थूलाननुक्रमात् इति छ.. /
काक्षीतृणेषु वंशेषु स्थूणास्वन्येष्वनुक्रमात् इति घ.. /
कक्षां दृशेम्बरांशे च तृणानन्येष्वानुक्रमादिति ज.. /
कन्यातृणेषु रत्नेषु वंशेस्थूणाननुक्रमादिति ङ..
3 मण्डलमिति ङ..
4 पिनाकशक्तिसंयुक्तामिति घ..
5 तत्तु दृष्ट्यावलोकयेदिति ख.. , छ.. च
6 शेषद्वाराणि चङ्क्रमेदिति ख.. , छ.. च / शेषद्वाराणि
पूजयेदिति छ..
7 स्वात्मन इति ख.. , घ.. , छ.. , ज.. च
8 निजसंवरैर् इति ग.. , ङ.. च / निजसञ्चयैर् इति घ..
:प् 312
ओं हं हां(1)
96.m:
ending at the forehead, shoulders, and feet, consisting of Śiva, Vidyā, and Ātman, the supreme, / whose presiding deities are Rudra, Nārāyaṇa, and Brahmā, with their proper movements.
[Footnotes]
[Footnote 1: "pravibhāvayet" in kha. and cha.]
[Footnote 2: "kākṣītṛṇeṣu vargeṣu vaṃśe sthūlānanukramāt" in kha.;]
"kāṣṭhātṛṇeṣu varṇeṣu vaṃśe sthūlānanukramāt" in cha.;]
"kākṣītṛṇeṣu vaṃśeṣu sthūṇāsvanyeṣvanukramāt" in gha.;]
"kakṣāṃ dṛśembarāṃśe ca tṛṇānanyeṣvānukramāt" in ja.;]
"kanyātṛṇeṣu ratneṣu vaṃśesthūṇānanukramāt" in ṅa.]
[Footnote 3: "maṇḍalam" in ṅa.]
[Footnote 4: "pinākaśaktisaṃyuktām" in gha.]
[Footnote 5: "tattu dṛṣṭyāvalokayet" in kha. and cha.]
[Footnote 6: "śeṣadvārāṇi caṅkramet" in kha. and cha.; "śeṣadvārāṇi pūjayet" in cha.]
[Footnote 7: "svātmanaḥ" in kha., gha., cha., and ja.]
[Footnote 8: "nijasaṃvaraiḥ" in ga. and ṅa.; "nijasañcayaiḥ" in gha. / p. 312]
"Oṃ haṃ hāṃ."

96.s:
mūrtīstadīśvarāṃstatra pūrvavadviniveśayet /
tadvyāpakaṃ śivaṃ sāṅgaṃ śivahastañca mūrdhani //
96.d:
मूर्तीस्तदीश्वरांस्तत्र पूर्ववद्विनिवेशयेत् /
तद्व्यापकं शिवं साङ्गं शिवहस्तञ्च मूर्धनि //
96.m: One should establish their forms and their lords there as before, / and the all-pervading Śiva along with his limbs, and the Śiva-hand upon the head.

96.s:
brahmarandhrapraviṣṭena tejasā vāhyasāntaraṃ(2) /
tamaḥpaṭalamādhūya pradyotitadigantaraṃ(3) //
96.d:
ब्रह्मरन्ध्रप्रविष्टेन तेजसा वाह्यसान्तरं(2) /
तमःपटलमाधूय प्रद्योतितदिगन्तरं(3) //
96.m: With the splendor entering through the aperture of Brahmā, which illuminates the directions, / having shaken off the veil of darkness, both outer and inner,

96.s:
ātmānaṃ mūrtipaiḥ sārdhaṃ sragvastrakusumādibhiḥ(4) /
bhūṣayitvā śivosmīti dhyātvā boghāsimuddharet //
96.d:
आत्मानं मूर्तिपैः सार्धं स्रग्वस्त्रकुसुमादिभिः(4) /
भूषयित्वा शिवोस्मीति ध्यात्वा बोघासिमुद्धरेत् //
96.m: and having adorned oneself together with the icon-keepers with garlands, garments, flowers, and the like, / meditating "I am Śiva," one should raise the sword of enjoyment.

96.s:
catuṣpadāntasaṃskāraiḥ(5) saṃskuryānmakhamaṇḍapaṃ /
vikṣipya vikirādīni kuśakūrcopasaṃharet(6) //
96.d:
चतुष्पदान्तसंस्कारैः(5) संस्कुर्यान्मखमण्डपं /
विक्षिप्य विकिरादीनि कुशकूर्चोपसंहरेत्(6) //
96.m: One should consecrate the sacrificial pavilion with the rites concluding with the four steps; / having scattered the scattered grain and other offerings, one should sweep them up with a kuśa broom.

96.s:
āsanīkṛtya vardhanyāṃ vāstvādīn pūrvavadyajet /
śivakumbhāstravardhanyau pūjayecca sthirāsane(7) //
96.d:
आसनीकृत्य वर्धन्यां वास्त्वादीन् पूर्ववद्यजेत् /
शिवकुम्भास्त्रवर्धन्यौ पूजयेच्च स्थिरासने(7) //
96.m: Having made a seat in the Vardhanī pitcher, one should worship the site deities and others as before, / and on a firm seat one should worship the Śiva jar and the weapon pitcher.

96.s:
svadikṣu kalaśārūḍhāṃllokapālānanukramāt /
vāhāyudhādisaṃyuktān pūjayedvidhinā yathā //
96.d:
स्वदिक्षु कलशारूढांल्लोकपालाननुक्रमात् /
वाहायुधादिसंयुक्तान् पूजयेद्विधिना यथा //
96.m: In their respective directions, mounted on the water-jars in proper sequence, / one should worship the guardians of the directions equipped with their mounts, weapons and attributes according to rule:

96.s:
airāvatagajārūḍhaṃ svarṇavarṇaṃ(8) kirīṭinaṃ /
sahasranayanaṃ śakraṃ vajrapāṇiṃ vibhāvayet //
96.d:
ऐरावतगजारूढं स्वर्णवर्णं(8) किरीटिनं /
सहस्रनयनं शक्रं वज्रपाणिं विभावयेत् //
96.m: One should visualize Śakra mounted on the elephant Airāvata, golden-complexioned, diademed, / thousand-eyed, with the thunderbolt in his hand.

96.s:
saptārciṣaṃ ca vibhrāṇamakṣamālāṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ /
jvālāmālākulaṃ raktaṃ(9) śaktihastamajāsanaṃ //
:n
1 uṃ hāṃ hāṃ iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca / oṃ īṃ āṃ iti
gha.. , ja.. ca
2 tejasā vāhyamantaramiti kha.. / tejasā vāhyābhyantaramiti cha.. / tejasā
vāhyamāntaramiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca
3 praviṣṭonudigantaramiti gha.. , ja.. ca
4 sragvastramukuṭādibhiriti gha.. , ja.. ca
5 catuṣpathārṇasaṃskārair iti cha..
6 kuśadūrvopasaṃharediti ga..
7 śivakumbhāstravardhanyāṃ pūjayedasthirāsane iti gha.. , ja.. ca
8 varṇavastramiti ga.. / svarṇavastramiti kha.. , ja.. , ca
9 kālaṃ mālākulaṃ raktamiti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca / kālaṃ
mālākulaṃ, vyaktamiti ga.. / jvālāmālākulaṃ saktamiti gha..
:p 313
96.d:
सप्तार्चिषं च विभ्राणमक्षमालां कमण्डलुं /
ज्वालामालाकुलं रक्तं(9) शक्तिहस्तमजासनं //
:न्
1 उं हां हां इति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. च / ओं ईं आं इति
घ.. , ज.. च
2 तेजसा वाह्यमन्तरमिति ख.. / तेजसा वाह्याभ्यन्तरमिति छ.. / तेजसा
वाह्यमान्तरमिति ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. च
3 प्रविष्टोनुदिगन्तरमिति घ.. , ज.. च
4 स्रग्वस्त्रमुकुटादिभिरिति घ.. , ज.. च
5 चतुष्पथार्णसंस्कारैर् इति छ..
6 कुशदूर्वोपसंहरेदिति ग..
7 शिवकुम्भास्त्रवर्धन्यां पूजयेदस्थिरासने इति घ.. , ज.. च
8 वर्णवस्त्रमिति ग.. / स्वर्णवस्त्रमिति ख.. , ज.. , च
9 कालं मालाकुलं रक्तमिति ख.. , ग.. , ङ.. , छ.. च / कालं
मालाकुलं, व्यक्तमिति ग.. / ज्वालामालाकुलं सक्तमिति घ..
:प् 313
96.m:
And [Agni] seven-rayed, bearing a rosary and a water-pot, / enveloped in a garland of flames, red, holding a spear in hand, seated on a goat.
:n
1 'uṃ hāṃ hāṃ' in kha, ga, gha, ṅa, and cha; 'oṃ īṃ āṃ' in gha and ja.
2 'tejasā vāhyamantaram' in kha; 'tejasā vāhyābhyantaram' in cha; 'tejasā vāhyamāntaram' in ga, gha, and ṅa.
3 'praviṣṭonudigantaram' in gha and ja.
4 'sragvastramukuṭādibhiḥ' in gha and ja.
5 'catuṣpathārṇasaṃskāraiḥ' in cha.
6 'kuśadūrvopasaṃharet' in ga.
7 'śivakumbhāstravardhanyāṃ pūjayedasthirāsane' in gha and ja.
8 'varṇavastram' in ga; 'svarṇavastram' in kha, ja, and ca.
9 'kālaṃ mālākulaṃ raktam' in kha, ga, ṅa, and cha; 'kālaṃ mālākulaṃ vyaktam' in ga; 'jvālāmālākulaṃ saktam' in gha. / :p 313

96.s:
mahiṣasthaṃ daṇḍahastaṃ yamaṃ kālānalaṃ smaret /
raktanetraṃ svarārūḍhaṃ(1) khaḍgahastañca nairṛtaṃ //
96.d:
महिषस्थं दण्डहस्तं यमं कालानलं स्मरेत् /
रक्तनेत्रं स्वरारूढं(1) खड्गहस्तञ्च नैरृतं //
96.m: One should contemplate Yama seated on a buffalo, holding a staff, [like] the cosmic fire of dissolution; / and Nairṛta mounted on a dog, red-eyed, with a sword in his hand.

96.s:
varuṇaṃ makare śvetaṃ nāgapāśadharaṃ smaret /
vāyuṃ ca hariṇe nīlaṃ kuveraṃ meghasaṃsthitaṃ(2) //
96.d:
वरुणं मकरे श्वेतं नागपाशधरं स्मरेत् /
वायुं च हरिणे नीलं कुवेरं मेघसंस्थितं(2) //
96.m: One should contemplate Varuṇa white upon a makara, holding a serpent-noose; / Vāyu blue upon a deer, and Kuvera positioned upon a cloud;

96.s:
triśūlinaṃ vṛṣe ceśaṃ kūrmenantantu cakriṇaṃ /
brāhmāṇaṃ haṃsagaṃ dhyāyeccaturvaktraṃ caturbhujaṃ //
96.d:
त्रिशूलिनं वृषे चेशं कूर्मेनन्तन्तु चक्रिणं /
ब्राह्माणं हंसगं ध्यायेच्चतुर्वक्त्रं चतुर्भुजं //
96.m: and Īśa with a trident on a bull; Ananta with the discus upon the tortoise; / and one should meditate on Brahmā mounted on a swan, four-faced and four-armed.

96.s:
stambhamūleṣu kumbheṣu vedyāṃ dharmādikān(3) yajet /
dikṣu kumbheṣvanantādīn pūjayantyapi kecana //
96.d:
स्तम्भमूलेषु कुम्भेषु वेद्यां धर्मादिकान्(3) यजेत् /
दिक्षु कुम्भेष्वनन्तादीन् पूजयन्त्यपि केचन //
96.m: At the bases of the pillars, on the water-jars, and on the altar, one should worship Dharma and the others; / some also worship Ananta and others on the water-jars in the cardinal directions.

96.s:
śivājñāṃ śrāvayet kumbhaṃ bhrāmayedātmapṛṣṭhagaṃ(4) /
pūrvavat sthāpayedādau kumbhaṃ tadanu vardhanīṃ //
96.d:
शिवाज्ञां श्रावयेत् कुम्भं भ्रामयेदात्मपृष्ठगं(4) /
पूर्ववत् स्थापयेदादौ कुम्भं तदनु वर्धनीं //
96.m: One should proclaim Śiva's command, circumambulate the water-jar keeping it behind oneself, / and deposit first the water-jar as before, and after that the ritual pitcher.

96.s:
śivaṃ sthirāsanaṃ(5) kumbhe śastrārthañca(6) dhruvāsanaṃ /
pūjayitvā yathāpūrvaṃ spṛśedudbhavamudrayā //
96.d:
शिवं स्थिरासनं(5) कुम्भे शस्त्रार्थञ्च(6) ध्रुवासनं /
पूजयित्वा यथापूर्वं स्पृशेदुद्भवमुद्रया //
96.m: Having worshipped Śiva upon a firm seat in the water-jar, and for the sake of the weapon upon a permanent seat, / as previously, one should touch [it] with the manifestation gesture.

96.s:
nijayāgaṃ(7) jagannātha rakṣa bhaktānukampayā /
ebhiḥ saṃśrāvya rakṣārthaṃ kumbhe khaḍgaṃ niveśayet(8) //
96.d:
निजयागं(7) जगन्नाथ रक्ष भक्तानुकम्पया /
एभिः संश्राव्य रक्षार्थं कुम्भे खड्गं निवेशयेत्(8) //
96.m: "O Lord of the Universe, protect your own sacrifice out of compassion for your devotees!" / Having proclaimed [this] with these [words] for the sake of protection, one should place a sword upon the water-jar.

96.s:
dīkṣāsthāpanayoḥ kumbhe sthaṇḍile maṇḍale 'thavā /
maṇḍalebhyarcya deveśaṃ vrajedvai kuṇḍasannidhau //
96.d:
दीक्षास्थापनयोः कुम्भे स्थण्डिले मण्डले ऽथवा /
मण्डलेभ्यर्च्य देवेशं व्रजेद्वै कुण्डसन्निधौ //
96.m: In the case of initiation and installation, in a water-jar, on a mound of earth, or in a maṇḍala, / having worshipped the Lord of Gods in the maṇḍala, one should proceed to the vicinity of the fire-pit.

96.s:
kuṇḍanābhiṃ puraskṛtya niniṣṭhā mūrtidhāriṇaḥ /
gurorādeśataḥ kuryur nijakuṇḍeṣu(9) saṃskṛtiṃ //
:n
1 śavārūḍhamiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca
2 mānuṣasthitamiti gha..
3 karmādikāniti ja..
