4 bhrāmayedanupūjya tamiti ja.. / bhrāmayedanupṛṣṭhagamiti gha..
5 sthirāsane iti kha.. , gha.. ca
6 śastrāṇuñceti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca
7 imaṃ yāgamiti ṅa..
8 śaṅkhannivedayediti ga.. / khaḍgannivedayediti gha.. , ṅa.. ca
9 kuryur nijakumbheṣviti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
:p 314
96.d:
कुण्डनाभिं पुरस्कृत्य निनिष्ठा मूर्तिधारिणः /
गुरोरादेशतः कुर्युर् निजकुण्डेषु(9) संस्कृतिं //
:न्
1 शवारूढमिति ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , ज.. च
2 मानुषस्थितमिति घ..
3 कर्मादिकानिति ज..
4 भ्रामयेदनुपूज्य तमिति ज.. / भ्रामयेदनुपृष्ठगमिति घ..
5 स्थिरासने इति ख.. , घ.. च
6 शस्त्राणुञ्चेति ख.. , ग.. , छ.. च
7 इमं यागमिति ङ..
8 शङ्खन्निवेदयेदिति ग.. / खड्गन्निवेदयेदिति घ.. , ङ.. च
9 कुर्युर् निजकुम्भेष्विति ख.. , घ.. , छ.. , ज.. च
:प् 314
96.m:
Focusing upon the navel of the fire-pit, steady, the assistants bearing the forms of the deities / should perform the consecration in their own fire-pits at the command of the guru.
:n
1 'śavārūḍham' in ga, gha, ṅa, and ja.
2 'mānuṣasthitam' in gha.
3 'karmādikān' in ja.
4 'bhrāmayedanupūjya tam' in ja; 'bhrāmayedanupṛṣṭhagam' in gha.
5 'sthirāsane' in kha and gha.
6 'śastrāṇuñca' in kha, ga, and cha.
7 'imaṃ yāgam' in ṅa.
8 'śaṅkhannivedayet' in ga; 'khaḍgannivedayet' in gha and ṅa.
9 'kuryur nijakumbheṣu' in kha, gha, cha, and ja. / :p 314

96.s:
japeyurjāpinaḥ saṅkhyaṃ(1) mantramanye tu saṃhitāṃ(2) /
paṭheyurbrāhmaṇāḥ śāntiṃ svaśākhāvedapāragāḥ //
96.d:
जपेयुर्जापिनः सङ्ख्यं(1) मन्त्रमन्ये तु संहितां(2) /
पठेयुर्ब्राह्मणाः शान्तिं स्वशाखावेदपारगाः //
96.m: The reciters should recite the prescribed number of mantras, while others [recite] the saṃhitā; / the brāhmaṇas who have mastered the Vedas of their own Vedic branches should chant the propitiatory verses.

96.s:
śrīsūktaṃ pāvamānīś ca(3) maitrakañca vṛṣākapiṃ /
ṛgvedī sarvadigbhāge sarvametat samuccaret(4) //
96.d:
श्रीसूक्तं पावमानीश् च(3) मैत्रकञ्च वृषाकपिं /
ऋग्वेदी सर्वदिग्भागे सर्वमेतत् समुच्चरेत्(4) //
96.m: The Ṛgvedic priest should chant in all quarters all these: / the Śrīsūkta, the Pāvamānī hymns, the Maitraka hymn, and the Vṛṣākapi hymn.

96.s:
devavratantu bhāruṇḍaṃ(5) jyeṣṭhasāma rathantaraṃ /
puruṣaṃ gītimetāni sāmavedī tu dakṣiṇe //
96.d:
देवव्रतन्तु भारुण्डं(5) ज्येष्ठसाम रथन्तरं /
पुरुषं गीतिमेतानि सामवेदी तु दक्षिणे //
96.m: The Sāmavedic priest in the south, however, [should sing] these: / the Devavrata, the Bhāruṇḍa, the Jyeṣṭhasāma, the Rathantara, the Puruṣa, and the chant.

96.s:
rudraṃ puruṣasūktañca ślokādhyāyaṃ viśeṣataḥ /
brāhmaṇañca yajurvedī paścimāyāṃ samuccaret(6) //
96.d:
रुद्रं पुरुषसूक्तञ्च श्लोकाध्यायं विशेषतः /
ब्राह्मणञ्च यजुर्वेदी पश्चिमायां समुच्चरेत्(6) //
96.m: The Yajurvedic priest should recite in the west: / the Rudra, the Puruṣasūkta, especially the Ślokādhyāya, and the Brāhmaṇa.

96.s:
nīlarudraṃ tathātharvī sūkṣmāsūkṣmantathaiva ca /
uttare 'tharvaśīrṣañca(7) tatparastu samuddharet //
96.d:
नीलरुद्रं तथाथर्वी सूक्ष्मासूक्ष्मन्तथैव च /
उत्तरे ऽथर्वशीर्षञ्च(7) तत्परस्तु समुद्धरेत् //
96.m: And likewise the Atharvavedic priest in the north, intent on that, / should chant the Nīlarudra, as well as the subtle and gross [hymns], and the Atharvaśīrṣa.

96.s:
ācāryaścāgnimutpādya pratikuṇḍaṃ pradāpayet(8) /
vahneḥ pūrvādikān bhāgān(9) pūrvakuṇḍāditaḥ(10) kramāt //
96.d:
आचार्यश्चाग्निमुत्पाद्य प्रतिकुण्डं प्रदापयेत्(8) /
वह्नेः पूर्वादिकान् भागान्(9) पूर्वकुण्डादितः(10) क्रमात् //
96.m: And the master, having produced the fire, should distribute it to each fire-pit, / into the portions of fire from the east onwards, in order starting from the eastern fire-pit.

96.s:
dhūpadīpacarūṇāñca dadītāgniṃ samuddharet(11) /
pūrvavacchivamabhyarcya śivāgnau mantratarpaṇaṃ //
96.d:
धूपदीपचरूणाञ्च ददीताग्निं समुद्धरेत्(11) /
पूर्ववच्छिवमभ्यर्च्य शिवाग्नौ मन्त्रतर्पणं //
96.m: He should offer incense, lamps, and sacrificial boiled rice, and raise up the fire. / Having worshipped Śiva as before, [performing] satisfaction of mantras in the Śiva-fire,

96.s:
deśakālādisampattau(12) dur nimittapraśāntaye /
:n
1 jāpinosaṅkhyamiti ka.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca
2 astramanye tu saṃsthitamiti ga.. / astramanye tu saṃhitāmiti ṅa..
3 pāvamānīntu iti ja..
4 sarvametat samuddharediti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca / sarvamastraṃ
samuddharediti ṅa..
5 bhāvajñamiti cha.. / śrīkuṇḍamiti ṅa..
6 samuddharediti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca
7 uttaretharvasūktañceti ga..
8 pradīpayediti gha..
9 pūrvādidigbhāgāditi ja.. / pūrvādikādbhāgāditi gha..
10 sarvakuṇḍādita iti kha.. , cha.. , ca
11 ācāryaścāgnimutpādyetyādiḥ dadītāgniṃ samuddharedityantaḥ
pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti
12 deśakālādisaṅkhyāptau iti gha..
:p 315
homaṅkṛtvā tu mantrajñaḥ pūrṇāṃ dattvā śubhāvahāṃ //
96.d:
देशकालादिसम्पत्तौ(12) दुर् निमित्तप्रशान्तये /
:न्
1 जापिनोसङ्ख्यमिति क.. , ङ.. , छ.. च
2 अस्त्रमन्ये तु संस्थितमिति ग.. / अस्त्रमन्ये तु संहितामिति ङ..
3 पावमानीन्तु इति ज..
4 सर्वमेतत् समुद्धरेदिति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , छ.. , ज.. च / सर्वमस्त्रं
समुद्धरेदिति ङ..
5 भावज्ञमिति छ.. / श्रीकुण्डमिति ङ..
6 समुद्धरेदिति ख.. , घ.. , ङ.. , ज.. च
7 उत्तरेथर्वसूक्तञ्चेति ग..
8 प्रदीपयेदिति घ..
9 पूर्वादिदिग्भागादिति ज.. / पूर्वादिकाद्भागादिति घ..
10 सर्वकुण्डादित इति ख.. , छ.. , च
11 आचार्यश्चाग्निमुत्पाद्येत्यादिः ददीताग्निं समुद्धरेदित्यन्तः
पाठो ग.. पुस्तके नास्ति
12 देशकालादिसङ्ख्याप्तौ इति घ..
:प् 315
होमङ्कृत्वा तु मन्त्रज्ञः पूर्णां दत्त्वा शुभावहां //
96.m:
upon the attainment of proper place, time, and circumstances, for the pacification of inauspicious portents,
:n
1 'jāpinosaṅkhyam' in ka, ṅa, and cha.
2 'astramanye tu saṃsthitam' in ga; 'astramanye tu saṃhitām' in ṅa.
3 'pāvamānīntu' in ja.
4 'sarvametat samuddharet' in kha, ga, gha, cha, and ja; 'sarvamastraṃ samuddharet' in ṅa.
5 'bhāvajñam' in cha; 'śrīkuṇḍam' in ṅa.
6 'samuddhared' in kha, gha, ṅa, and ja.
7 'uttaretharvasūktañceti' in ga.
8 'pradīpayet' in gha.
9 'pūrvādidigbhāgāt' in ja; 'pūrvādikādbhāgāt' in gha.
10 'sarvakuṇḍāditaḥ' in kha and cha.
11 The reading beginning with 'ācāryaścāgnimutpādya' and ending with 'dadītāgniṃ samuddharet' is not present in manuscript ga.
12 'deśakālādisaṅkhyāptau' in gha. / :p 315
having performed the fire oblation, the knower of mantras, offering the auspicious full oblation,

96.s:
pūrvavaccarukaṃ kṛtvā pratikuṇḍaṃ nivedayet(1) /
yajamānālaṅkṛtāstu vrajeyuḥ snānamaṇḍapaṃ //
96.d:
पूर्ववच्चरुकं कृत्वा प्रतिकुण्डं निवेदयेत्(1) /
यजमानालङ्कृतास्तु व्रजेयुः स्नानमण्डपं //
96.m: having prepared the sacrificial rice as before, should present it to each fire-pit. / Adorned, the patrons should proceed to the bathing pavilion.

96.s:
bhadrapīṭhe nidhāyeśaṃ(2) tāḍayitvāvaguṇṭhayet /
snāpayet(3) pūjayitvā tu mṛdā kāṣāyavāriṇā //
96.d:
भद्रपीठे निधायेशं(2) ताडयित्वावगुण्ठयेत् /
स्नापयेत्(3) पूजयित्वा तु मृदा काषायवारिणा //
96.m: Having placed the Lord upon an auspicious seat, having struck and veiled [him], / and having worshipped him, one should bathe [him] with clay and with astringent water,

96.s:
gomūtrair gomayenāpi vāriṇā cāntarāntarā /
bhasmanā gandhatoyena phaḍantāstreṇa vāriṇā //
96.d:
गोमूत्रैर् गोमयेनापि वारिणा चान्तरान्तरा /
भस्मना गन्धतोयेन फडन्तास्त्रेण वारिणा //
96.m: with cow-urine and also cow-dung, and with water at intervals, / with ash, scented water, and water accompanied by the weapon mantra ending in 'phaṭ'.

96.s:
deśiko mūrtipaiḥ sārdhaṃ kṛtvā kāraṇaśodhanaṃ(4) /
dharmajaptena sañchāṭya(5) pītavarṇena vāsasā //
96.d:
देशिको मूर्तिपैः सार्धं कृत्वा कारणशोधनं(4) /
धर्मजप्तेन सञ्छाट्य(5) पीतवर्णेन वाससा //
96.m: The spiritual master, having performed the purification of elements together with the guardians of the icons, / covering [the deity] with a yellow garment consecrated with the dharma mantra,

96.s:
sampūjya sitapuṣpaiś ca(6) nayeduttaravedikāṃ /
tatra dattāsanāyāñca śayyāyāṃ sanniveśya ca(7) //
96.d:
सम्पूज्य सितपुष्पैश् च(6) नयेदुत्तरवेदिकां /
तत्र दत्तासनायाञ्च शय्यायां सन्निवेश्य च(7) //
96.m: and having worshipped with white flowers, should lead [him] to the northern altar; / and having installed [him] there on a couch provided with a seat,

96.s:
kuṅkumāliptasūtreṇa vibhajya gururālikhet /
śalākayā suvarṇasya akṣiṇī śastrakarmaṇā(8) //
96.d:
कुङ्कुमालिप्तसूत्रेण विभज्य गुरुरालिखेत् /
शलाकया सुवर्णस्य अक्षिणी शस्त्रकर्मणा(8) //
96.m: measuring with a cord smeared with saffron, the guru should draw / the two eyes with a golden probe by surgical operation.

96.s:
añjayellakṣmakṛt paścācchāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā /
kṛtakarmā ca śastreṇa lakṣmī śilpī samutkṣipet(9) //
96.d:
अञ्जयेल्लक्ष्मकृत् पश्चाच्छास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा /
कृतकर्मा च शस्त्रेण लक्ष्मी शिल्पी समुत्क्षिपेत्(9) //
96.m: The maker of the marks should then apply collyrium according to the procedure prescribed in scripture. / And when the work has been done with the tool, the artisan should remove the [effigy of] Lakṣmī.

96.s:
tryaṃśādardhotha(10) pādārdhādardhāyā /
ardhayothavā(11)
:n
1 niveśayediti kha.. ,gha.. ca
2 bhadrapīṭhe nidhāyainamiti kha.. , cha.. , ca / tatra pīṭhe vidhāyeśamiti
ṅa.. / bhadrapīṭhe vidhāyeśamiti gha..
3 snapayediti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. ca
4 kṛcā cākāraśodhanāmiti gha.. , ja.. ca
5 dharmajaptena saṃsthāpyeti ga.. / dharmajalena sañchādyeti ṅa..
6 sampūjya sitavastraiśceti ga.. / sampūjyasitapuṣpaistu iti gha..
7 sanniveśayediti cha..
8 śāstrakarmaṇeti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. , ja.. ca / śāstravarmaṇeti gha.. /
śāstrakarmaṇi iti ḍa..
9 samutkiret iti gha.. , ja.. ca
10 tryaṃśādapyatheti gha.. / tryaṃśādadhotheti ja..
11 ardhato 'piveti ga.. / ardhato varamiti ja..
:p 316
sarvakāmaprasiddhyarthaṃ śubhaṃ lakṣmāvatāraṇaṃ(1) //
96.d:
त्र्यंशादर्धोथ(10) पादार्धादर्धाया /
अर्धयोथवा(11)
:न्
1 निवेशयेदिति ख.. ,घ.. च
2 भद्रपीठे निधायैनमिति ख.. , छ.. , च / तत्र पीठे विधायेशमिति
ङ.. / भद्रपीठे विधायेशमिति घ..
3 स्नपयेदिति ख.. , ग.. , ङ.. च
4 कृचा चाकारशोधनामिति घ.. , ज.. च
5 धर्मजप्तेन संस्थाप्येति ग.. / धर्मजलेन सञ्छाद्येति ङ..
6 सम्पूज्य सितवस्त्रैश्चेति ग.. / सम्पूज्यसितपुष्पैस्तु इति घ..
7 सन्निवेशयेदिति छ..
8 शास्त्रकर्मणेति ख.. , ग.. , छ.. , ज.. च / शास्त्रवर्मणेति घ.. /
शास्त्रकर्मणि इति ड..
9 समुत्किरेत् इति घ.. , ज.. च
10 त्र्यंशादप्यथेति घ.. / त्र्यंशादधोथेति ज..
11 अर्धतो ऽपिवेति ग.. / अर्धतो वरमिति ज..
:प् 316
सर्वकामप्रसिद्ध्यर्थं शुभं लक्ष्मावतारणं(1) //
96.m:
From a third part, or half, or half of a quarter, or half,
or half [a barleycorn];
[Gap in text]
1. "niveśayed" in kha. and gha.
2. "bhadrapīṭhe nidhāyainam" in kha., cha., and ca; "tatra pīṭhe vidhāyeśam" in ṅa.; "bhadrapīṭhe vidhāyeśam" in gha.
3. "snapayed" in kha., ga., and ṅa.
4. "kṛcā cākāraśodhanām" in gha. and ja.
5. "dharmajaptena saṃsthāpya" in ga.; "dharmajalena sañchādya" in ṅa.
6. "sampūjya sitavastraiś ca" in ga.; "sampūjyasitapuṣpaistu" in gha.
7. "sanniveśayed" in cha.
8. "śāstrakarmaṇā" in kha., ga., cha., and ja.; "śāstravarmaṇā" in gha.;
"śāstrakarmaṇi" in ḍa.
9. "samutkiret" in gha. and ja.
10. "tryaṃśādapyatha" in gha.; "tryaṃśādadhadha" in ja.
11. "ardhato 'pi vā" in ga.; "ardhato varam" in ja. / [p. 316]
for the fulfillment of all desires, the drawing down of the marks is auspicious.

96.s:
liṅgadīrghavikārāṃśe tribhaktaṃ bhāgavarṇanāt(2) /
vistāro lakṣma dehasya bhavelliṅgasya(3) sarvataḥ //
96.d:
लिङ्गदीर्घविकारांशे त्रिभक्तं भागवर्णनात्(2) /
विस्तारो लक्ष्म देहस्य भवेल्लिङ्गस्य(3) सर्वतः //
96.m: In the altered part of the length of the liṅga, divided into three according to the distribution of parts, / the width of the mark should extend over the liṅga's body on all sides.

96.s:
yavasya navabhaktasya bhāgair aṣṭābhirāvṛtā(6) /
hastike(5) lakṣmarekhā ca gāmbhīryād vistarādapi(7) //
96.d:
यवस्य नवभक्तस्य भागैर् अष्टाभिरावृता(6) /
हस्तिके(5) लक्ष्मरेखा च गाम्भीर्याद् विस्तरादपि(7) //
96.m: Covered by eight parts of a barleycorn divided into nine, / the line of the mark on a one-cubit [liṅga] should be [so measured] in depth and in width.

96.s:
evamaṣṭāṃśavṛddhyā tu liṅge sārdhakarādike /
bhavedaṣṭayavā(8) pṛthvī gambhīrātra ca hāstike //
96.d:
एवमष्टांशवृद्ध्या तु लिङ्गे सार्धकरादिके /
भवेदष्टयवा(8) पृथ्वी गम्भीरात्र च हास्तिके //
96.m: Thus, by an increase of one-eighth on a liṅga of one cubit and a half and upward, / the width is eight barleycorns, and deep here on a liṅga of one cubit.

96.s:
evamaṣṭāṃśa vṛddhyā tu liṅge sārdhakarādike /
bhavedaṣṭayavā pṛthvī gambhīrānnavahāstike(6) //
96.d:
एवमष्टांश वृद्ध्या तु लिङ्गे सार्धकरादिके /
भवेदष्टयवा पृथ्वी गम्भीरान्नवहास्तिके(6) //
96.m: Thus, by an increase of one-eighth on a liṅga of one cubit and a half and upward, / the width is eight barleycorns, and deep on a liṅga of nine cubits.

96.s:
śāmbhaveṣu(10) ca liṅgeṣu pādavṛddheṣu sarvataḥ(11) /
lakṣma dehasya viṣkambho bhavedvai yavavardhanāt //
96.d:
शाम्भवेषु(10) च लिङ्गेषु पादवृद्धेषु सर्वतः(11) /
लक्ष्म देहस्य विष्कम्भो भवेद्वै यववर्धनात् //
96.m: And on liṅgas belonging to Śambhu, increased on all sides by a quarter, / the width of the mark's body indeed increases by a barleycorn.

96.s:
gambhīratvaṣṭayuvābhyāṃ rekhāpi tryaṃśavṛddhitaḥ(12) /
sarveṣu ca bhavet sūkṣmāṃ liṅgamastakamastakaṃ //
:n
1 lakṣmāvatārakamiti gha..
2 tribhukte bhāvavarṇanāditi ka.. / tribhukte bhāgavarjanāditi gha.. / tribhakte
bhāgavarjanāditi ja.. / tribhukte bhāgavartanāditi ṅa.. / vibhakte
bhāvavarṇanāditi cha..
3 bhavelliṅgeṣu sarvata iti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa. cha.. ca
4 navabhaktasya bhāgair aṣṭābhirāhateti kha.. , cha.. ca / bhavabhaktasya
bhāgair aṣṭābhirāhateti ja.. / navabhaktasya bhāgair
aṣṭābhirādṛteti gha..
5 hāstikaṃ iti ga.. , gha.. , ca
6 gambhīrā navahāstike iti gha..
7 liṅge vṛddhikarādike iti kha.. / liṅgeṣu dvikarādiṣu iti ga.. / liṅge
vṛddhikarādiṣu iti kha.. , gha.. ca
8 bhavedaṣṭakareti gha..
9 gambhīrā navahāstike iti ga.. / gambhīrā navahastake iti ja..
10 sottareṣu iti ja..
96.d:
गम्भीरत्वष्टयुवाभ्यां रेखापि त्र्यंशवृद्धितः(12) /
सर्वेषु च भवेत् सूक्ष्मां लिङ्गमस्तकमस्तकं //
:न्
1 लक्ष्मावतारकमिति घ..
2 त्रिभुक्ते भाववर्णनादिति क.. / त्रिभुक्ते भागवर्जनादिति घ.. / त्रिभक्ते
भागवर्जनादिति ज.. / त्रिभुक्ते भागवर्तनादिति ङ.. / विभक्ते
भाववर्णनादिति छ..
3 भवेल्लिङ्गेषु सर्वत इति ख.. , ग.. , ङ. छ.. च
4 नवभक्तस्य भागैर् अष्टाभिराहतेति ख.. , छ.. च / भवभक्तस्य
भागैर् अष्टाभिराहतेति ज.. / नवभक्तस्य भागैर्
अष्टाभिरादृतेति घ..
5 हास्तिकं इति ग.. , घ.. , च
6 गम्भीरा नवहास्तिके इति घ..
7 लिङ्गे वृद्धिकरादिके इति ख.. / लिङ्गेषु द्विकरादिषु इति ग.. / लिङ्गे
वृद्धिकरादिषु इति ख.. , घ.. च
8 भवेदष्टकरेति घ..
9 गम्भीरा नवहास्तिके इति ग.. / गम्भीरा नवहस्तके इति ज..
10 सोत्तरेषु इति ज..
96.m:
The depth is eight barleycorns; the line too, through an increase of a third, / should be fine on all [liṅgas], from the top of the liṅga's head.
[Gap in text]
1. "lakṣmāvatārakam" in gha.
2. "tribhukte bhāvavarṇanāt" in ka.; "tribhukte bhāgavarjanāt" in gha.; "tribhakte bhāgavarjanāt" in ja.; "tribhukte bhāgavartanāt" in ṅa.; "vibhakte bhāvavarṇanāt" in cha.
3. "bhavelliṅgeṣu sarvataḥ" in kha., ga., ṅa., and cha.
4. "navabhaktasya bhāgair aṣṭābhirāhatā" in kha. and cha.; "bhavabhaktasya bhāgair aṣṭābhirāhatā" in ja.; "navabhaktasya bhāgair aṣṭābhirādṛtā" in gha.
5. "hāstikaṃ" in ga. and gha.
6. "gambhīrā navahāstike" in gha.
7. "liṅge vṛddhikarādike" in kha.; "liṅgeṣu dvikarādiṣu" in ga.; "liṅge vṛddhikarādiṣu" in kha. and gha.
8. "bhavedaṣṭakarā" in gha.
9. "gambhīrā navahāstike" in ga.; "gambhīrā navahastake" in ja.
10. "sottareṣu" in ja.

96.s:
11 yavasya navabhaktasyetyādiḥ / pādavṛddheṣu sarvata ity antaḥ
pāṭho ṅa.. pustake nāsti
12 dvyaṃśavṛṃhiteti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca / tryaṃśavṛṃhiteti ṅa.. /
dvyaṃśavṛddhita iti ja..
:p 317
96.d:
11 यवस्य नवभक्तस्येत्यादिः / पादवृद्धेषु सर्वत इत्य् अन्तः
पाठो ङ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
12 द्व्यंशवृंहितेति ख.. , घ.. , छ.. च / त्र्यंशवृंहितेति ङ.. /
द्व्यंशवृद्धित इति ज..
:प् 317

96.s:
lakṣmakṣetreṣṭadhābhakte mūrdhnibhāgadvaye śubhe(1) /
ṣaḍbhāgaparivartanamuktvā bhāgadvayantvadhaḥ(2) //
96.d:
लक्ष्मक्षेत्रेष्टधाभक्ते मूर्ध्निभागद्वये शुभे(1) /
षड्भागपरिवर्तनमुक्त्वा भागद्वयन्त्वधः(2) //
96.m: When the field of the mark is divided into eight parts, on the two auspicious upper parts, / leaving the rotation of six parts, but on the two parts below,

96.s:
rekhātrayeṇa sambaddhaṃ(3) kārayet pṛṣṭadeśagaṃ /
ratnaje lakṣaṇoddhāro yavau hemasamudbhave //
96.d:
रेखात्रयेण सम्बद्धं(3) कारयेत् पृष्टदेशगं /
रत्नजे लक्षणोद्धारो यवौ हेमसमुद्भवे //
96.m: one should cause [the lines] connected as three lines to run along the back area. / On a gemstone [liṅga], the engraving of the marks [is the thickness of a barleycorn], and two barleycorns on a golden one.

96.s:
svarūpaṃ lakṣaṇanteṣāṃ prabhā ratneṣu nirmalā /
nayanonmīlanaṃ vaktre(4) sānnidhyāya ca lakṣma tat //
96.d:
स्वरूपं लक्षणन्तेषां प्रभा रत्नेषु निर्मला /
नयनोन्मीलनं वक्त्रे(4) सान्निध्याय च लक्ष्म तत् //
96.m: Their characteristic mark is their inherent nature: spotless radiance in gemstones; / the opening of the eyes on a face [liṅga] and that mark are for [the deity's] presence.

96.s:
lakṣmaṇoddhārarekhāñca ghṛtena madhunā tathā /
mṛtyuñjayena(5) sampūjya śilpidoṣanivṛttaye //
96.d:
लक्ष्मणोद्धाररेखाञ्च घृतेन मधुना तथा /
मृत्युञ्जयेन(5) सम्पूज्य शिल्पिदोषनिवृत्तये //
96.m: And having worshipped the line for the incision of the marks with ghee and honey / using the Mṛtyuñjaya mantra, to ward off the defects of the artisan,

96.s:
arcayecca(6) tato liṅgaṃ snāpayitvā mṛdādibhiḥ /
śilpinantoṣayitvā tu dadyādgāṃ gurave tataḥ //
96.d:
अर्चयेच्च(6) ततो लिङ्गं स्नापयित्वा मृदादिभिः /
शिल्पिनन्तोषयित्वा तु दद्याद्गां गुरवे ततः //
96.m: one should then worship the liṅga, having bathed it with clay and other substances. / Then, having gratified the artisan, he should give a cow to the guru.

96.s:
liṅgaṃ dhūpādibhiḥ prācyaṃ gāyeyurbhartṛgāstrayaḥ /
savyena cāpasavyena sūtreṇātha kuśena vā //
96.d:
लिङ्गं धूपादिभिः प्राच्यं गायेयुर्भर्तृगास्त्रयः /
सव्येन चापसव्येन सूत्रेणाथ कुशेन वा //
96.m: With incense and the like, facing east, three [women] devoted to their husbands should sing before the liṅga; / clockwise and counter-clockwise, with a cord or with kuśa grass,

96.s:
smṛtvā ca rocanaṃ datvā kuryānnirmañjanādikaṃ(7) /
guḍalavaṇadhānyākadānena visṛjecca tāḥ //
96.d:
स्मृत्वा च रोचनं दत्वा कुर्यान्निर्मञ्जनादिकं(7) /
गुडलवणधान्याकदानेन विसृजेच्च ताः //
96.m: and remembering [the deity], having applied yellow pigment (gorocanā), one should perform the waving of lamps and other rites; / and he should dismiss those [women] with gifts of molasses, salt, and coriander.

96.s:
gurumūrtidharaiḥ(8) sārdhaṃ hṛdā vā praṇavena vā /
mṛtsnāgomayagomūtrabhasmabhiḥ(9) salilāntaraṃ //
96.d:
गुरुमूर्तिधरैः(8) सार्धं हृदा वा प्रणवेन वा /
मृत्स्नागोमयगोमूत्रभस्मभिः(9) सलिलान्तरं //
96.m: Together with the guru and the officiants (mūrtidharas), reciting the heart mantra or the Praṇava, / [he should bathe it] with clay, cow dung, cow urine, and ashes, alternating with water;

96.s:
snāpayet pañcagavyena pañcāmṛtapuraḥsaraṃ(10) /
:n
1 mūrtibhāgadvaye cyute iti ja.. / mūrtibhagadvaye yute iti ja..
2 muktvā bhāgadvayaṃ budha iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ḍa.. , cha.. ca
3 sasiddhamiti ga.. , ja.. ca
4 vyakte iti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. ca
5 mṛtyuñjayañceti ga..
6 arcayettu iti ga.. , ja.. ca
7 puṣpāvarodhanaṃ datvā kuryānnirmanthanādikamiti ja.. /
spṛṣṭvā ca rocanāṃ datvā kuryānnirmañjanādikamiti ṅa..
8 gurumūrtiryavair iti kha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca
9 tato mṛṇmayagomūtrabhasmabhiriti ga..
10 snāpayedityardhaśloko cha.. pustake nāsti
:p 318
virūkṣaṇaṃ kaṣāyaiś ca sarvauṣadhijalena vā //
96.d:
स्नापयेत् पञ्चगव्येन पञ्चामृतपुरःसरं(10) /
:न्
1 मूर्तिभागद्वये च्युते इति ज.. / मूर्तिभगद्वये युते इति ज..
2 मुक्त्वा भागद्वयं बुध इति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ड.. , छ.. च
3 ससिद्धमिति ग.. , ज.. च
4 व्यक्ते इति ग.. , घ.. , ज.. च
5 मृत्युञ्जयञ्चेति ग..
6 अर्चयेत्तु इति ग.. , ज.. च
7 पुष्पावरोधनं दत्वा कुर्यान्निर्मन्थनादिकमिति ज.. /
स्पृष्ट्वा च रोचनां दत्वा कुर्यान्निर्मञ्जनादिकमिति ङ..
8 गुरुमूर्तिर्यवैर् इति ख.. , ङ.. , ज.. च
9 ततो मृण्मयगोमूत्रभस्मभिरिति ग..
10 स्नापयेदित्यर्धश्लोको छ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
:प् 318
विरूक्षणं कषायैश् च सर्वौषधिजलेन वा //
96.m:
he should bathe it with the five products of the cow (pañcagavya), preceded by the five nectars (pañcāmṛta),
[Gap in text]
1. "mūrtibhāgadvaye cyute" in ja.; "mūrtibhagadvaye yute" in ja.
2. "muktvā bhāgadvayaṃ budhaḥ" in kha., ga., gha., ḍa., and cha.
3. "sasiddham" in ga. and ja.
4. "vyakte" in ga., gha., and ja.
5. "mṛtyuñjayañ ca" in ga.
6. "arcayettu" in ga. and ja.
7. "puṣpāvarodhanaṃ datvā kuryānnirmanthanādikam" in ja.;
"spṛṣṭvā ca rocanāṃ datvā kuryānnirmañjanādikam" in ṅa.
8. "gurumūrtiryavair" in kha., ṅa., and ja.
9. "tato mṛṇmayagomūtrabhasmabhir" in ga.
10. The half-verse "snāpayed…" is absent in manuscript cha. / [p. 318]
and perform an astringent cleansing with decoctions, or with all-herb water,

96.s:
śubhrapuṣpaphalasvarṇaratnaśṛṅgayavodakaiḥ(1) /
tathā dhārāsahasreṇa divyauṣadhijalena ca(2) //
96.d:
शुभ्रपुष्पफलस्वर्णरत्नशृङ्गयवोदकैः(1) /
तथा धारासहस्रेण दिव्यौषधिजलेन च(2) //
96.m: and with water containing white flowers, fruits, gold, jewels, horn, and barley, / as well as through a thousand-streamed [vessel] with celestial medicinal water.

96.s:
tīrthodakena gāṅgena candanena ca vāriṇā /
kṣīrārṇavādibhiḥ(3) kumbhaiḥ śivakumbhajalena ca(4) //
96.d:
तीर्थोदकेन गाङ्गेन चन्दनेन च वारिणा /
क्षीरार्णवादिभिः(3) कुम्भैः शिवकुम्भजलेन च(4) //
96.m: [He should bathe the deity] with water from sacred fords, with Gaṅgā water, and with sandalwood water, / with pitchers [representing] the Milk Ocean and the others, and with the water of the Śiva pitcher,

96.s:
virūkṣaṇaṃ vilepañca(5) sugandhaiś candanādibhiḥ /
sampūjya brahmabhiḥ(6) puṣpair varmaṇā raktacīvaraiḥ(7) //
96.d:
विरूक्षणं विलेपञ्च(5) सुगन्धैश् चन्दनादिभिः /
सम्पूज्य ब्रह्मभिः(6) पुष्पैर् वर्मणा रक्तचीवरैः(7) //
96.m: [and perform] drying and unguent with fragrant substances such as sandalwood and the like. / Having worshipped with the brahma mantras, with flowers, and with red robes [accompanied] by the armor mantra,

96.s:
raktarūpeṇa(8) nīrājya rakṣātilakapūrvakaṃ /
ghṛtauṣadhair jaladugdhaiś ca kuśādyair arghyasūcitaiḥ //
96.d:
रक्तरूपेण(8) नीराज्य रक्षातिलकपूर्वकं /
घृतौषधैर् जलदुग्धैश् च कुशाद्यैर् अर्घ्यसूचितैः //
96.m: having waved lights with the Aghora mantra, preceded by the protective forehead mark, / with ghee, herbs, water, milk, and kuśa grass and the like indicated for the water offering,

96.s:
dravyaiḥ stutyādibhistuṣṭamarcayet(9) puruṣāṇunā(10) /
samācamya(11) hṛdā devaṃ brūyādutthīyatāṃ prabho //
96.d:
द्रव्यैः स्तुत्यादिभिस्तुष्टमर्चयेत्(9) पुरुषाणुना(10) /
समाचम्य(11) हृदा देवं ब्रूयादुत्थीयतां प्रभो //
96.m: he should worship [the deity] pleased by substances, praises, and so on, with the Tatpuruṣa mantra. / Having sipped water, he should say to the deity with the heart mantra: "Arise, O Lord!"

96.s:
devaṃ brahmarathenaiva kṣipraṃ dravyāṇi tannayet(12) /
maṇḍape paścimadvāre śayyāyāṃ viniveśayet //
96.d:
देवं ब्रह्मरथेनैव क्षिप्रं द्रव्याणि तन्नयेत्(12) /
मण्डपे पश्चिमद्वारे शय्यायां विनिवेशयेत् //
96.m: He should quickly carry the deity and the substances in the chariot of Brahmā. / In the pavilion, at the western door, he should place him upon the couch.

96.s:
śaktyādiśaktiparyante(12) vinyasedāsane śubhe /
:n
1 oḍrapuṣpaphalasvarṇaśṛṅgagavodakair iti ga..
2 divyauṣadhijalena vā iti ga..
3 kṣārārṇavādibhiriti ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
4 saraḥ kumbhajalena tu iti ja..
5 vikarṣaṇaṃ vilepañceti gha.. , ja.. ca
6 bahubhiriti ja..
7 brahmaṇā raktacandanair iti ga.. / brahmaṇā raktajīvakair iti ṅa..
8 bahurūpeṇa iti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. ca
9 stutyādibhistutyamarghayediti kha.. , cha.. ca
10 puruṣātmaneti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha.. ca
11 samācaryeti ga..
13 śaktyādimūrtiparyante iti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca
:p 319
paścime piṇḍikāntasya nyasedbrahmaśalāntadā(1) //
96.d:
शक्त्यादिशक्तिपर्यन्ते(12) विन्यसेदासने शुभे /
:न्
1 ओड्रपुष्पफलस्वर्णशृङ्गगवोदकैर् इति ग..
2 दिव्यौषधिजलेन वा इति ग..
3 क्षारार्णवादिभिरिति ङ.. , छ.. , ज.. च
4 सरः कुम्भजलेन तु इति ज..
5 विकर्षणं विलेपञ्चेति घ.. , ज.. च
6 बहुभिरिति ज..
7 ब्रह्मणा रक्तचन्दनैर् इति ग.. / ब्रह्मणा रक्तजीवकैर् इति ङ..
8 बहुरूपेण इति ग.. , घ.. , ज.. च
9 स्तुत्यादिभिस्तुत्यमर्घयेदिति ख.. , छ.. च
10 पुरुषात्मनेति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , छ.. च
11 समाचर्येति ग..
13 शक्त्यादिमूर्तिपर्यन्ते इति ख.. , घ.. , ज.. च
:प् 319
पश्चिमे पिण्डिकान्तस्य न्यसेद्ब्रह्मशलान्तदा(1) //
96.m:
He should deposit him upon an auspicious seat extending from Śakti to Śakti.
[Notes]
1 ga reads "oḍrapuṣpaphalasvarṇaśṛṅgagavodakaiḥ".
2 ga reads "divyauṣadhijalena vā".
3 ṅa, cha, and ja read "kṣārārṇavādibhiḥ".
4 ja reads "saraḥ kumbhajalena tu".
5 gha and ja read "vikarṣaṇaṃ vilepañca".
6 ja reads "bahubhiḥ".
7 ga reads "brahmaṇā raktacandanaiḥ"; ṅa reads "brahmaṇā raktajīvakaiḥ".
8 ga, gha, and ja read "bahurūpeṇa".
9 kha and cha read "stutyādibhistutyamarghayet".
10 kha, ga, gha, and cha read "puruṣātmanā".
11 ga reads "samācārya".
13 kha, gha, and ja read "śaktyādimūrtiparyante". / p. 319
To the west of the pedestal, the giver should deposit up to the brahma-stone.

96.s:
śastramastra(2) śatālabdhanidrākumbhadhruvāsanaṃ(3) /
prakalpya śivakoṇe ca datvārghyaṃ hṛdayena tu //
96.d:
शस्त्रमस्त्र(2) शतालब्धनिद्राकुम्भध्रुवासनं(3) /
प्रकल्प्य शिवकोणे च दत्वार्घ्यं हृदयेन तु //
96.m: Having arranged the weapon mantra, the stable seat of the sleep-pitcher obtained through hundreds [of rites], / in the northeast corner, and having offered water offering with the heart mantra,

96.s:
utthāpyoktāsane liṅgaṃ śirasā pūrvamastakaṃ /
samāropya nyasettasmin(4) sṛṣṭyā dharmādivandanaṃ(5) //
96.d:
उत्थाप्योक्तासने लिङ्गं शिरसा पूर्वमस्तकं /
समारोप्य न्यसेत्तस्मिन्(4) सृष्ट्या धर्मादिवन्दनं(5) //
96.m: having raised the liṅga upon the stated seat, with the head [facing] east, / having mounted it, he should deposit upon it, in the order of creation, the homage to Dharma and the rest.

96.s:
dadyāddhūpañca sampūjya tathā vāsāṃsi varmaṇā /
gṛhopakṛtinaivedyaṃ hṛdā dadyāt svaśaktitaḥ(6) //
96.d:
दद्याद्धूपञ्च सम्पूज्य तथा वासांसि वर्मणा /
गृहोपकृतिनैवेद्यं हृदा दद्यात् स्वशक्तितः(6) //
96.m: Having worshipped, he should offer incense, and likewise garments with the armor mantra. / He should offer domestic utensils and food oblation with the heart mantra according to his capacity.

96.s:
ghṛtakṣaudrayutaṃ pātramabhyaṅgāya padāntike /
deśikaś ca sthitastatra ṣaṭtriṃśattattvasañcayaṃ(7) //
96.d:
घृतक्षौद्रयुतं पात्रमभ्यङ्गाय पदान्तिके /
देशिकश् च स्थितस्तत्र षट्त्रिंशत्तत्त्वसञ्चयं(7) //
96.m: A vessel containing ghee and honey [should be placed] near the feet for anointing. / And the preceptor, standing there, [should deposit] the collection of thirty-six principles

96.s:
śaktyādibhūmiparyantaṃ svatattvādhipasaṃyutaṃ /
vinyasya puṣpamālābhistrikhaṇḍaṃ(8) parikalpayet //
96.d:
शक्त्यादिभूमिपर्यन्तं स्वतत्त्वाधिपसंयुतं /
विन्यस्य पुष्पमालाभिस्त्रिखण्डं(8) परिकल्पयेत् //
96.m: extending from Śakti to Earth, together with the presiding deities of their respective principles. / Having deposited [them], he should fashion the three divisions with flower garlands:

96.s:
māyāpadeśaśaktyantanturyāśāṣṭāṃśavartulaṃ(9) /
tatrātmatattvavidyākhyaṃ(10) śivaṃ sṛṣṭikramaṇa tu(11) //
96.d:
मायापदेशशक्त्यन्तन्तुर्याशाष्टांशवर्तुलं(9) /
तत्रात्मतत्त्वविद्याख्यं(10) शिवं सृष्टिक्रमण तु(11) //
96.m: the four-sided, eight-sided, and round [parts], up to the region of Māyā and the Śakti. / There, in the order of creation, [he should deposit] the Soul-principle, the Knowledge[-principle], and Śiva,

96.s:
ekaśaḥ pratibhāgeṣu brahmaviṣṇuharādhipān /
vinyasya mūrtimūrtīśān pūrvādikramato yathā //
96.d:
एकशः प्रतिभागेषु ब्रह्मविष्णुहराधिपान् /
विन्यस्य मूर्तिमूर्तीशान् पूर्वादिक्रमतो यथा //
96.m: individually upon each section, presiding as Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Hara. / Having deposited the forms and the lords of the forms in order, beginning with the east, as follows:

96.s:
kṣmāvahniryajamānārkajalavāyuniśākarān /
:n
1 brahmaśilāntatheti kha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
2 śastramantreti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca
3 nidrākumbha dhruvāsanamiti ja..
4 vyasedasminniti ja..
5 sṛṣṭyā dharmādibandhanamiti kha.. /
sṛṣṭyādirarghyādibandhanamiti cha..
6 gṛhopakṛtītyardhaśloko ga.. pustake nāsti
7 ṣaḍliṅgatanusañcayamiti ja.. / ṣaḍviṃśatattvasañcayamiti gha..
8 triśṛṅgamiti ga..
9 māyāśādaśaśaktyantatūryā grāhyā pravartanamiti ja.. /
māyāpadeśeti ardhaśloko gha.. pustake nāsti
10 tatrānutattvavidhyākhyamiti ja..
11 sṛṣṭikrameṇa ceti ga..
:p 320
ākāśamūrtirūpāṃstān nyasettadadhināyakān //
96.d:
क्ष्मावह्निर्यजमानार्कजलवायुनिशाकरान् /
:न्
1 ब्रह्मशिलान्तथेति ख.. , ङ.. , छ.. , ज.. च
2 शस्त्रमन्त्रेति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. च
3 निद्राकुम्भ ध्रुवासनमिति ज..
4 व्यसेदस्मिन्निति ज..
5 सृष्ट्या धर्मादिबन्धनमिति ख.. /
सृष्ट्यादिरर्घ्यादिबन्धनमिति छ..
6 गृहोपकृतीत्यर्धश्लोको ग.. पुस्तके नास्ति
7 षड्लिङ्गतनुसञ्चयमिति ज.. / षड्विंशतत्त्वसञ्चयमिति घ..
8 त्रिशृङ्गमिति ग..
9 मायाशादशशक्त्यन्ततूर्या ग्राह्या प्रवर्तनमिति ज.. /
मायापदेशेति अर्धश्लोको घ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
10 तत्रानुतत्त्वविध्याख्यमिति ज..
11 सृष्टिक्रमेण चेति ग..
:प् 320
आकाशमूर्तिरूपांस्तान् न्यसेत्तदधिनायकान् //
96.m:
Earth, Fire, the Sacrificer, Sun, Water, Wind, Moon,
[Notes]
1 kha, ṅa, cha, and ja read "brahmaśilāntathā".
2 kha, ga, gha, ṅa, and cha read "śastramantra-".
3 ja reads "nidrākumbha dhruvāsanam".
4 ja reads "vyasedasmin".
5 kha reads "sṛṣṭyā dharmādibandhanam".
cha reads "sṛṣṭyādirarghyādibandhanam".
6 The half-verse beginning "gṛhopakṛti-" is missing in manuscript ga.
7 ja reads "ṣaḍliṅgatanusañcayam"; gha reads "ṣaḍviṃśatattvasañcayam".
8 ga reads "triśṛṅgam".
9 ja reads "māyāśādaśaśaktyantatūryā grāhyā pravartanam".
The half-verse beginning "māyāpadeśa-" is missing in manuscript gha.
10 ja reads "tatrānutattvavidhyākhyam".
11 ga reads "sṛṣṭikrameṇa ca". / p. 320
and Space—he should deposit these manifestations and their presiding masters:

96.s:
sarvaṃ paśupatiṃ(1) cograṃ rudraṃ bhavamakheśvaraṃ(2) /
mahādevañca bhīmañca mantrāstadvācakā ime //
96.d:
सर्वं पशुपतिं(1) चोग्रं रुद्रं भवमखेश्वरं(2) /
महादेवञ्च भीमञ्च मन्त्रास्तद्वाचका इमे //
96.m: Sarva, Paśupati, Ugra, Rudra, Bhava, Īśvara of the sacrifice, / Mahādeva, and Bhīma. These are the mantras designating them:

96.s:
lavaśaṣacayasāś ca hakāraś ca trimātrikaḥ /
praṇavo hṛdayārṇurvā mūlamantro 'thavā kvacit //
96.d:
लवशषचयसाश् च हकारश् च त्रिमात्रिकः /
प्रणवो हृदयार्णुर्वा मूलमन्त्रो ऽथवा क्वचित् //
96.m: the syllables la, va, śa, ṣa, ca, ya, sa, and the three-mora ha, / [preceded by] the Praṇava, or the heart mantra, or in some cases the root mantra.

96.s:
pañcakuṇḍātmake yāge(3) mūrtīḥ pañcāthavā nyaset /
pṛthivījalatejāṃsi vāyumākāśameva ca //
96.d:
पञ्चकुण्डात्मके यागे(3) मूर्तीः पञ्चाथवा न्यसेत् /
पृथिवीजलतेजांसि वायुमाकाशमेव च //
96.m: Or, in a sacrifice consisting of five fire-pits, he should deposit the five forms: / earth, water, fire, wind, and space;

96.s:
kramāttadadhipān pañca(4) brahmāṇaṃ dharaṇodharaṃ /
rudramīśaṃ sadākhyañca sṛṣṭinyāyena mantravit(5) //
96.d:
क्रमात्तदधिपान् पञ्च(4) ब्रह्माणं धरणोधरं /
रुद्रमीशं सदाख्यञ्च सृष्टिन्यायेन मन्त्रवित्(5) //
96.m: in order, the five rulers thereof: Brahmā, the Supporter of Earth, / Rudra, Īśa, and Sadākhya, according to the rule of creation, the knower of mantras [should deposit].

96.s:
mumukṣorvā nivṛttādyāḥ(6) ajātādyāstadīśvarāḥ(7) /
tritattvaṃ vātha(8) sarvatra nyasedvyāptyātmakāraṇaṃ(9) //
96.d:
मुमुक्षोर्वा निवृत्ताद्याः(6) अजाताद्यास्तदीश्वराः(7) /
त्रितत्त्वं वाथ(8) सर्वत्र न्यसेद्व्याप्त्यात्मकारणं(9) //
96.m: Or, for one desirous of liberation, the [kalās] beginning with Nivṛtti, their lords beginning with Ajāta, / or everywhere he should deposit the three principles, the causes possessing all-pervading nature.

96.s:
śuddhe cātmani vidyeśā aśuddhe lokanāyakāḥ /
draṣṭavyā mūrtipāś caiva bhoginī mantranāyakāḥ //
96.d:
शुद्धे चात्मनि विद्येशा अशुद्धे लोकनायकाः /
द्रष्टव्या मूर्तिपाश् चैव भोगिनी मन्त्रनायकाः //
96.m: In the pure self [reside] the Lords of Knowledge; in the impure, the World-protectors; / they are to be regarded as guardians of the form, and the mistress as the lords of mantras.

96.s:
pañcaviṃśattathaivāṣṭapañcatrīṇi yathākramaṃ /
eṣāntattvaṃ tadīśānāmindrādīnāṃ tato(10) yathā //
oṃ hāṃ śaktitattvāya nama ity ādi(11) / oṃ hāṃ
śaktitattvādhipāya(12) nama ity ādi / oṃ hāṃ kṣmāmūrtaye
namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ kṣmāmūrtyadhīśāya(13)
:n
1 garbhe paśupatimiti ja..
2 bhavamatheśvaramiti ga.. ,cha.. , ja.. ca
3 pañcadaṇḍātmake mārge iti ja.. / pañcadaṇḍātmake yāge iti
ṅa..
4 tadadhipālañceti kha..
5 sṛṣṭinyāsena mantraviditi kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca / sṛṣṭinyāsena
pūrvaviditi ja..
6 mumuñcorvinivṛttādyā iti kha..
7 ajātyādyāstadīśvarā iti kha..
8 tritattvaṃ cātheti gha.. , ja.. ca
9 vyāpyātmakāraṇamiti kha.. / vyāptyā svakāraṇamiti gha.. , ṅa..
ca
10 indrādīśāntata iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca
11 nama itīti gha.. , ja.. ca
12 śabdatattvādhipataye iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca
96.d:
पञ्चविंशत्तथैवाष्टपञ्चत्रीणि यथाक्रमं /
एषान्तत्त्वं तदीशानामिन्द्रादीनां ततो(10) यथा //
ओं हां शक्तितत्त्वाय नम इत्य् आदि(11) / ओं हां
शक्तितत्त्वाधिपाय(12) नम इत्य् आदि / ओं हां क्ष्मामूर्तये
नमः / ओं हां क्ष्मामूर्त्यधीशाय(13)
:न्
1 गर्भे पशुपतिमिति ज..
2 भवमथेश्वरमिति ग.. ,छ.. , ज.. च
3 पञ्चदण्डात्मके मार्गे इति ज.. / पञ्चदण्डात्मके यागे इति
ङ..
4 तदधिपालञ्चेति ख..
5 सृष्टिन्यासेन मन्त्रविदिति ख.. , घ.. , ङ.. च / सृष्टिन्यासेन
पूर्वविदिति ज..
6 मुमुञ्चोर्विनिवृत्ताद्या इति ख..
7 अजात्याद्यास्तदीश्वरा इति ख..
8 त्रितत्त्वं चाथेति घ.. , ज.. च
9 व्याप्यात्मकारणमिति ख.. / व्याप्त्या स्वकारणमिति घ.. , ङ..
च
10 इन्द्रादीशान्तत इति ख.. , घ.. , छ.. च
11 नम इतीति घ.. , ज.. च
12 शब्दतत्त्वाधिपतये इति ख.. , घ.. , छ.. च
96.m:
Twenty-five, and eight, five, and three in order: / such is the principle of these, their rulers, and of Indra and the others thereafter, as follows:
"Oṃ hāṃ, obeisance to the Śakti principle," and so forth; "Oṃ hāṃ, / obeisance to the presiding lord of the Śakti principle," and so forth; "Oṃ hāṃ, to the Earth form,
obeisance"; "Oṃ hāṃ, to the sovereign lord of the Earth form,
[Notes]
1 ja reads "garbhe paśupatim".
2 ga, cha, and ja read "bhavamatheśvaram". / 3 ja reads "pañcadaṇḍātmake mārge"; ṅa reads "pañcadaṇḍātmake yāge".
4 kha reads "tadadhipālañca".
5 kha, gha, and ṅa read "sṛṣṭinyāsena mantravit"; ja reads "sṛṣṭinyāsena pūrvavit". / 6 kha reads "mumuñcorvinivṛttādyāḥ".
7 kha reads "ajātyādyāstadīśvarāḥ".
8 gha and ja read "tritattvaṃ cātha".
[Variant reading:] "vyāpyātmakāraṇam" in manuscript kha; "vyāptyā svakāraṇam" in manuscript gha and ṅa.
[Variant reading:] "indrādīśāntataḥ" in manuscript kha, gha, and cha.
[Variant reading:] "nama iti" in manuscript gha and ja.
[Variant reading:] "śabdatattvādhipataye" in manuscript kha, gha, and cha.

96.s:
13 śūkṣmamūrtaye iti gha..
:p 321
śivāya nama ity ādi / oṃ hāṃ pṛthivīmūrtaye namaḥ / oṃ
hāṃ mūrtyadhipāya(1) brahmaṇe nama ity ādi / oṃ hāṃ
śivatattvādhipāya(2) rudrāya nama ity ādi
96.d:
13 शूक्ष्ममूर्तये इति घ..
:प् 321
शिवाय नम इत्य् आदि / ओं हां पृथिवीमूर्तये नमः / ओं
हां मूर्त्यधिपाय(1) ब्रह्मणे नम इत्य् आदि / ओं हां
शिवतत्त्वाधिपाय(2) रुद्राय नम इत्य् आदि
96.m:
[Variant reading:] "śūkṣmamūrtaye" in manuscript gha.
[Page 321]
“Obeisance to Śiva” and so forth; “Oṃ hāṃ, obeisance to the icon of the earth”; “Oṃ hāṃ, obeisance to Brahmā, the lord of icons” and so forth; “Oṃ hāṃ, obeisance to Rudra, the lord of the principle of Śiva” and so forth.

96.s:
nābhikandātsamuccārya ghaṇṭānādavisarpaṇaṃ(3) /
brahmādikāraṇatyāgād dvādaśāntasamāśritaṃ //
96.d:
नाभिकन्दात्समुच्चार्य घण्टानादविसर्पणं(3) /
ब्रह्मादिकारणत्यागाद् द्वादशान्तसमाश्रितं //
96.m: Raising from the bulb of the navel the vibration echoing like a bell, / which, through transcending the causes beginning with Brahmā, has resorted to the twelve-finger aperture;

96.s:
mantrañca manasā bhinnaṃ prāptānandarasopamaṃ /
dvādaśāntātsamānīya niṣkalaṃ(4) vyāpakaṃ śivaṃ //
96.d:
मन्त्रञ्च मनसा भिन्नं प्राप्तानन्दरसोपमं /
द्वादशान्तात्समानीय निष्कलं(4) व्यापकं शिवं //
96.m: and bringing down from the twelve-finger aperture the mantra distinguished by the mind, / resembling the rasa of attained bliss, [namely] partless, all-pervading Śiva,

96.s:
aṣṭatriṃśatkalopetaṃ sahasrakiraṇojjvalaṃ /
sarvaśaktimayaṃ sāṅgaṃ dhyātvā liṅge(5) niveśayet //
96.d:
अष्टत्रिंशत्कलोपेतं सहस्रकिरणोज्ज्वलं /
सर्वशक्तिमयं साङ्गं ध्यात्वा लिङ्गे(5) निवेशयेत् //
96.m: endowed with the thirty-eight kalās, radiant with a thousand rays, / consisting of all powers, complete with his limbs—having meditated [on Him thus], one should deposit [Him] into the liṅga.

96.s:
jīvanyāso bhavedevaṃ liṅge sarvārthasādhakaḥ /
piṇḍikādiṣu tu nyāsaḥ(6) procyate sāmprataṃ yathā //
96.d:
जीवन्यासो भवेदेवं लिङ्गे सर्वार्थसाधकः /
पिण्डिकादिषु तु न्यासः(6) प्रोच्यते साम्प्रतं यथा //
96.m: Thus the ritual deposition of life into the liṅga, accomplishing all aims, is accomplished. / Now the ritual deposition upon the pedestal and so forth is described as follows:

96.s:
piṇḍikāñca kṛtasnānāṃ(7) viliptāñcandanādibhiḥ /
sadvastraiś ca samācchādya(8) randhre ca bhagalakṣaṇe //
96.d:
पिण्डिकाञ्च कृतस्नानां(7) विलिप्ताञ्चन्दनादिभिः /
सद्वस्त्रैश् च समाच्छाद्य(8) रन्ध्रे च भगलक्षणे //
96.m: The pedestal, having been bathed, smeared with sandal and other [pastes], / covered with fine garments, and in its cavity having the mark of the vulva,

96.s:
pañcaratnādisaṃyuktāṃ(9) liṅgasyottarataḥ sthitāṃ /
liṅgavatkṛtavinyāsāṃ(10) vidhivatsamprapūjayet //
96.d:
पञ्चरत्नादिसंयुक्तां(9) लिङ्गस्योत्तरतः स्थितां /
लिङ्गवत्कृतविन्यासां(10) विधिवत्सम्प्रपूजयेत् //
96.m: furnished with the five jewels and other [items], situated to the north of the liṅga, / having its ritual deposition performed just like the liṅga, one should properly worship according to rule.

96.s:
kṛtasnānādikāntatra liṅgamūle śilāṃ(11) nyaset /
kṛtasnānādisaṃskāraṃ śaktyantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tathā //
:n
1 pṛthivīmūrtyadhipataye iti kha.. / pṛthivīmūrtyadhipāyeti ja.. , gha..
ca
2 śivatattvāyeti ja..
3 ghaṇṭānādavisarpiṇamiti gha.. , ja.. ca
4 niṣphalamiti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca
5 liṅgamiti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. ca
6 vinyāsa iti ga..

8 sahasraiḥ sāhamāsādyeti ja..

10 liṅgavatkṛtavinyāsamiti kha.. , cha.. ca
11 kṛtasnānādikāmiti tadvalliṅgamūle śilāmiti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca /
kṛtasnānādikaṃ tadvalliṅgamūle śivāmiti ja..
:p 322
96.d:
कृतस्नानादिकान्तत्र लिङ्गमूले शिलां(11) न्यसेत् /
कृतस्नानादिसंस्कारं शक्त्यन्तं वृषभं तथा //
:न्
1 पृथिवीमूर्त्यधिपतये इति ख.. / पृथिवीमूर्त्यधिपायेति ज.. , घ..
च
2 शिवतत्त्वायेति ज..
3 घण्टानादविसर्पिणमिति घ.. , ज.. च
4 निष्फलमिति ख.. , घ.. , ङ.. च
5 लिङ्गमिति ग.. , घ.. , ज.. च
6 विन्यास इति ग..
7 कृतस्नातामिति ख.. , घ.. , ज.. च
8 सहस्रैः साहमासाद्येति ज..
9 यवरत्नादिसंयुक्तामिति घ.. , ज.. च
10 लिङ्गवत्कृतविन्यासमिति ख.. , छ.. च
11 कृतस्नानादिकामिति तद्वल्लिङ्गमूले शिलामिति ख.. , घ.. , ङ.. च /
कृतस्नानादिकं तद्वल्लिङ्गमूले शिवामिति ज..
:प् 322
96.m:
There at the base of the liṅga one should deposit the stone, which has undergone bathing and other rites; / likewise the bull, having undergone bathing and other consecrations, up to the Śakti.

4. "niṣphalam" in manuscript kha, gha, and ṅa.
5. "liṅgam" in manuscript ga, gha, and ja.

"kṛtasnānādikaṃ tadvalliṅgamūle śivām" in manuscript ja.
[Page 322]

96.s:
praṇavapūrvaṃ huṃ pūṃ hrīṃ(1) madhyādanyatamena ca /
kriyāśaktiyutāṃ piṇḍīṃ śilāmādhararūpiṇīṃ //
96.d:
प्रणवपूर्वं हुं पूं ह्रीं(1) मध्यादन्यतमेन च /
क्रियाशक्तियुतां पिण्डीं शिलामाधररूपिणीं //
96.m: Preceded by the Praṇava, with any one from the midst of "huṃ", "pūṃ", and "hrīṃ", / [one should deposit] the pedestal endowed with the power of action (kriyāśakti), and the stone in the form of the foundation;

96.s:
bhasmadarbhatilaiḥ kuryāt prākāratritayantataḥ /
rakṣāyai lokapālāṃś ca sāyudhānyājayedvahiḥ(2) //
oṃ hūṃ hraṃ(3) kriyāśaktaye namaḥ / oṃ hūṃ hrāṃ
haḥ(4) mahāgaurī rudradayite svāheti ca(5) piṇḍikāyāṃ / oṃ
hāṃ(6) ādhāraśaktaye namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ vṛṣabhāya
namaḥ
96.d:
भस्मदर्भतिलैः कुर्यात् प्राकारत्रितयन्ततः /
रक्षायै लोकपालांश् च सायुधान्याजयेद्वहिः(2) //
ओं हूं ह्रं(3) क्रियाशक्तये नमः / ओं हूं ह्रां
हः(4) महागौरी रुद्रदयिते स्वाहेति च(5) पिण्डिकायां / ओं
हां(6) आधारशक्तये नमः / ओं हां वृषभाय
नमः
96.m:
then, with ashes, darbha grass, and sesamum seeds, one should make a threefold enclosure. / For protection, one should also worship the world-guardians outside with their weapons:
“Oṃ hūṃ hraṃ, obeisance to Kriyāśakti”; “Oṃ hūṃ hrāṃ haḥ, svāhā to Mahāgaurī, the beloved of Rudra” upon the pedestal; “Oṃ hāṃ, obeisance to Ādhāraśakti”; “Oṃ hāṃ, obeisance to the bull.”

96.s:
dhārikāṃ dīptimatyugrā jyotsnā caitā balotkaṭāḥ /
tathā dhātrī vidhātrī ca nyasedvā pañcanāyikāḥ //
96.d:
धारिकां दीप्तिमत्युग्रा ज्योत्स्ना चैता बलोत्कटाः /
तथा धात्री विधात्री च न्यसेद्वा पञ्चनायिकाः //
96.m: Dhārikā, Dīptimatī, Ugrā, and Jyotsnā—these exceedingly strong ones— / and likewise Dhātrī and Vidhātrī, or else one should deposit the five mistresses:

96.s:
vāmā jyeṣṭhā kriyā jñānā(7) bedhā tisrīthavā nyaset /
kriyājñānā tathecchā ca(8) pūrvavacchāntimūrtiṣu //
96.d:
वामा ज्येष्ठा क्रिया ज्ञाना(7) बेधा तिस्रीथवा न्यसेत् /
क्रियाज्ञाना तथेच्छा च(8) पूर्ववच्छान्तिमूर्तिषु //
96.m: Vāmā, Jyeṣṭhā, Kriyā, Jñānā, and Bedhā; or one should deposit three: / Kriyā, Jñānā, and Icchā, upon the peaceful icons as before;

96.s:
tamo mohā kṣamī niṣṭhā mṛtyurmāyābhavajvarāḥ(9) /
pañca cātha mahāmohā ghorā ca tritayajvarā //
:n
1 praṇavaṃ pūrvaṃ hūṃ prauṃ hrīṃ iti kha.. / praṇavapūrvaṃ
hūṃ sūṃ iti ga.. / praṇavapūrvaṃ krūṃ sūṃ kloṃ krīṃ iti
cha.. / praṇavaṃ pūrvahūṃ srīṃ sūṃ hrīṃ iti gha.. /
praṇavapūrvaṃ hūṃ sūṃ hūṃ iti ja..
2 sāyudhān pūjayettata iti kha.. , cha.. ca / sāyudhān pūjayedvahiriti ga.. ,
ṅa.. ca / sāyudhāś ca tyajedvahiriti gha.. / sāyudhānyājagredvahiriti
ja..
3 oṃ hūṃ hrīṃ iti ga.. , ṅa.. ca / oṃ hrīṃ iti gha.. / oṃ hrīṃ
hrīṃ sa iti ga..
4 oṃ hūṃ hrīṃ sa iti kha.. / oṃ krūṃ hrīṃ sa iti gha.. / oṃ
hrīṃ hrīṃ sa iti ga.. / oṃ hrīṃ sa iti gha.. , ṅa.. ca
5 svāheti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca
6 oṃ hrīṃ iti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca
7 kriyā medheti ṅa..
8 tathaivaiccheti ṅa..
96.d:
तमो मोहा क्षमी निष्ठा मृत्युर्मायाभवज्वराः(9) /
पञ्च चाथ महामोहा घोरा च त्रितयज्वरा //
:न्
1 प्रणवं पूर्वं हूं प्रौं ह्रीं इति ख.. / प्रणवपूर्वं
हूं सूं इति ग.. / प्रणवपूर्वं क्रूं सूं क्लों क्रीं इति
छ.. / प्रणवं पूर्वहूं स्रीं सूं ह्रीं इति घ.. /
प्रणवपूर्वं हूं सूं हूं इति ज..
2 सायुधान् पूजयेत्तत इति ख.. , छ.. च / सायुधान् पूजयेद्वहिरिति ग.. ,
ङ.. च / सायुधाश् च त्यजेद्वहिरिति घ.. / सायुधान्याजग्रेद्वहिरिति
ज..
3 ओं हूं ह्रीं इति ग.. , ङ.. च / ओं ह्रीं इति घ.. / ओं ह्रीं
ह्रीं स इति ग..
4 ओं हूं ह्रीं स इति ख.. / ओं क्रूं ह्रीं स इति घ.. / ओं
ह्रीं ह्रीं स इति ग.. / ओं ह्रीं स इति घ.. , ङ.. च
5 स्वाहेति ख.. , ग.. , ङ.. , छ.. च
6 ओं ह्रीं इति ख.. , ग.. , ङ.. , छ.. च
7 क्रिया मेधेति ङ..
8 तथैवैच्छेति ङ..
96.m:
Tamas, Mohā, Kṣamī, Niṣṭhā, Mṛtyu, Māyā, and the fevers of worldly existence; / and then five: Mahāmohā, Ghorā, and the threefold fever;

"praṇavaṃ pūrvahūṃ srīṃ sūṃ hrīṃ" in manuscript gha;
"praṇavapūrvaṃ hūṃ sūṃ hūṃ" in manuscript ja.

3. "oṃ hūṃ hrīṃ" in manuscript ga and ṅa; "oṃ hrīṃ" in manuscript gha; "oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ sa" in manuscript ga.
4. "oṃ hūṃ hrīṃ sa" in manuscript kha; "oṃ krūṃ hrīṃ sa" in manuscript gha; "oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ sa" in manuscript ga; "oṃ hrīṃ sa" in manuscript gha and ṅa.

6. "oṃ hrīṃ" in manuscript kha, ga, ṅa, and cha.

8. "tathaiva icchā" in manuscript ṅa.

96.s:
9 tamā mohā kṣamā niṣṭhā mṛtyurmāya bhayā jvareti kha.. /
umā mohā kṣamā nityā mṛtyurmāyābhayājvarā iti ja..
:p 323
96.d:
9 तमा मोहा क्षमा निष्ठा मृत्युर्माय भया ज्वरेति ख.. /
उमा मोहा क्षमा नित्या मृत्युर्मायाभयाज्वरा इति ज..
:प् 323

96.s:
tisrothavā kriyājñānā(1) tathā bādhādhināyikā /
ātmāditriṣu(2) tattveṣu tīvramūrtiṣu vinyaset //
96.d:
तिस्रोथवा क्रियाज्ञाना(1) तथा बाधाधिनायिका /
आत्मादित्रिषु(2) तत्त्वेषु तीव्रमूर्तिषु विन्यसेत् //
96.m: or three: Kriyā, Jñānā, and Bādhādhināyikā; / one should deposit them into the three principles beginning with the self (ātman), upon the fierce icons.

96.s:
atrāpi piṇḍikā brahmaśilādiṣu yathāvidhi /
gauryādisaṃvarair eva(3) pūrvavat sarvamācaret(4) //
96.d:
अत्रापि पिण्डिका ब्रह्मशिलादिषु यथाविधि /
गौर्यादिसंवरैर् एव(3) पूर्ववत् सर्वमाचरेत्(4) //
96.m: Here too, upon the pedestal, the foundation stone of Brahmā, and others, according to rule, / one should perform everything as before, with the coverings of Gaurī and the rest.

96.s:
evaṃ vidhāya vinyāsaṃ gatvā kuṇḍāntikaṃ tataḥ /
kuṇḍamadhye maheśānaṃ mekhalāsu maheśvaraṃ //
96.d:
एवं विधाय विन्यासं गत्वा कुण्डान्तिकं ततः /
कुण्डमध्ये महेशानं मेखलासु महेश्वरं //
96.m: Having performed the deposition thus, then going near the fire-pit, / [one should deposit] Maheśāna in the middle of the fire-pit, Maheśvara upon the tiers,

96.s:
kriyāśaktiṃ tathānyāsu nādamoṣṭhe ca(5) vinyaset /
ghaṭaṃ sthaṇḍilavahnīśaiḥ(6) nāḍīsandhānakantataḥ(7) //
96.d:
क्रियाशक्तिं तथान्यासु नादमोष्ठे च(5) विन्यसेत् /
घटं स्थण्डिलवह्नीशैः(6) नाडीसन्धानकन्ततः(7) //
96.m: Kriyāśakti on the others, and Nādam upon the lip. / Then, [one should perform] the union of channels between the pitcher, the sacrificial ground, the fire, and the Lord:

96.s:
padmatantusamāṃ śaktimudvātena samudyatāṃ(8) /
viśantī sūryamārgeṇa niḥsarantīṃ samudgatāṃ(9) //
96.d:
पद्मतन्तुसमां शक्तिमुद्वातेन समुद्यतां(8) /
विशन्ती सूर्यमार्गेण निःसरन्तीं समुद्गतां(9) //
96.m: visualising one's own power, which is like a lotus-fibre, raised by the upward breath, / entering along the solar path, issuing forth, arisen,

96.s:
punaś ca śūnyamārgeṇa(10) viśatīṃ svasya cintayet /
evaṃ sarvatra sandheyaṃ mūrtipaiś ca parasparaṃ //
96.d:
पुनश् च शून्यमार्गेण(10) विशतीं स्वस्य चिन्तयेत् /
एवं सर्वत्र सन्धेयं मूर्तिपैश् च परस्परं //
96.m: and entering again through the path of the void. / In this way union should be effected everywhere mutually by the guardians of the icons.

96.s:
sampūjya dhārikāṃ śaktiṃ kuṇḍe santarpya ca kramāt /
tattvatattveśvarā murtīrmūrtīrśāṃś ca(11) ghṛtādibhiḥ(12) //
96.d:
सम्पूज्य धारिकां शक्तिं कुण्डे सन्तर्प्य च क्रमात् /
तत्त्वतत्त्वेश्वरा मुर्तीर्मूर्तीर्शांश् च(11) घृतादिभिः(12) //
96.m: Having worshipped the power Dhārikā, and having propitiated in the fire-pit in proper sequence / the principles, the lords of principles, the icons, and the lords of the icons with clarified butter and other substances,

96.s:
sampūjya tarpayitvā tu sannidhau saṃhitāṇubhiḥ(13) /
:n
1 kriyājñānīti ga.. , gha.. ca
2 ājñāditriṣu iti gha..
3 gauryādisañcarair eveti gha.. , ja.. ca
4 pūrvavat sarvamarcayediti kha.. , cha.. ca / pūrvavacca samācarediti ja.. /
nyāsaṃ pūrvavadācare sadidi ḍa..
5 nādamadhye ceti ja..
6 ghaṭaṃ sthaṇḍilavargīśair iti kha.. , cha.. ca
7 nāḍīsambhārakaṃ tata iti ja..

pañcatattvasamāṃ śaktiṃ svadhā tena samudyatāmiti ṅa..

11 mūrti mūrtīśāṃśceti ja..

pustake nāsti
13 saṃhitātmabhiriti kha.. / sahitātmabhiriti cha.. / saṃghaṭāṇubhiriti
ja..
:p 324
śataṃ sahasramardhaṃ vā pūrṇayā saha homayet(1) //
96.d:
सम्पूज्य तर्पयित्वा तु सन्निधौ संहिताणुभिः(13) /
:न्
1 क्रियाज्ञानीति ग.. , घ.. च
2 आज्ञादित्रिषु इति घ..
3 गौर्यादिसञ्चरैर् एवेति घ.. , ज.. च
4 पूर्ववत् सर्वमर्चयेदिति ख.. , छ.. च / पूर्ववच्च समाचरेदिति ज.. /
न्यासं पूर्ववदाचरे सदिदि ड..
5 नादमध्ये चेति ज..
6 घटं स्थण्डिलवर्गीशैर् इति ख.. , छ.. च
7 नाडीसम्भारकं तत इति ज..
8 तत्त्वतत्त्वेश्वरा मूर्तिः स्वर्ग्या तेन समुच्यतामिति ख.. , छ.. च /
पञ्चतत्त्वसमां शक्तिं स्वधा तेन समुद्यतामिति ङ..
9 समुद्गमानिति ज..
10 सूर्यमार्गेणेति छ..
11 मूर्ति मूर्तीशांश्चेति ज..
12 घटस्थण्डिलेत्यादिः, घृतादिभिरत्यन्तः पाठो घ..
पुस्तके नास्ति
13 संहितात्मभिरिति ख.. / सहितात्मभिरिति छ.. / संघटाणुभिरिति
ज..
:प् 324
शतं सहस्रमर्धं वा पूर्णया सह होमयेत्(1) //
96.m:
and having worshipped and propitiated [them] in the vicinity with the saṃhitā mantras:
[Footnotes:]
1. "kriyājñānī" in manuscript ga and gha.
2. "ājñāditriṣu" in manuscript gha.
3. "gauryādisañcarair eva" in manuscript gha and ja.
4. "pūrvavat sarvamarcayet" in manuscript kha and cha; "pūrvavacca samācarediti" in manuscript ja;
"nyāsaṃ pūrvavadācaresadidi" in manuscript ḍa.
5. "nādamadhye ca" in manuscript ja.
"6 ghaṭaṃ sthaṇḍilavargīśaiḥ" thus in MSS kha and cha.
"7 nāḍīsambhārakaṃ tataḥ" thus in MS ja.
"8 tattvatattveśvarā mūrtiḥ svargyā tena samucyatām" thus in MSS kha and cha.
"pañcatattvasamāṃ śaktiṃ svadhā tena samudyatām" thus in MS ṅa.
"9 samudgamān" thus in MS ja.
10. 'By the path of the sun' in manuscript cha.
11. 'Icons and the lords of icons' in manuscript ja.
12. The text beginning with 'ghaṭasthaṇḍila' and ending with 'ghṛtādibhiḥ' is absent in manuscript gha.

One should offer a hundred, a thousand, or half [a thousand] oblations along with the full offering.

96.s:
tattvatattveśvarā mūrtirmūrtīśāṃś ca kareṇukān(2) /
tathā santarpya sānnidhye juhuyurmūrtipā api //
96.d:
तत्त्वतत्त्वेश्वरा मूर्तिर्मूर्तीशांश् च करेणुकान्(2) /
तथा सन्तर्प्य सान्निध्ये जुहुयुर्मूर्तिपा अपि //
96.m: The cosmic principles, the lords of cosmic principles, the icon, the lords of icons, and the Kareṇukas— / having gratified them thus in proximity, the guardians of the icons should also offer oblations.

96.s:
tato brahmabhiraṅgaiś ca(3) dravyakālānurodhataḥ /
santarpya śaktiṃ kumbhāmbhaḥprokṣite(4) kuśamūlataḥ //
96.d:
ततो ब्रह्मभिरङ्गैश् च(3) द्रव्यकालानुरोधतः /
सन्तर्प्य शक्तिं कुम्भाम्भःप्रोक्षिते(4) कुशमूलतः //
96.m: Then, by means of the brahma- and aṅga-mantras, in accordance with the materials and time, / having gratified the power sprinkled with water from the pitcher, from the base of the kuśa grass,

96.s:
liṅgamūlaṃ ca saṃspṛśya(5) japeyurhomasaṅkhyayā /
sannidhānaṃ hṛdā kuryurvarmaṇā cāvaguṇṭhanaṃ //
96.d:
लिङ्गमूलं च संस्पृश्य(5) जपेयुर्होमसङ्ख्यया /
सन्निधानं हृदा कुर्युर्वर्मणा चावगुण्ठनं //
96.m: and touching the base of the liṅga, they should recite [the mantras] to the number of the fire oblations. / They should effect the presence [of the deity] with the heart-mantra, and the veiling with the armor-mantra.

96.s:
evaṃ saṃśodhya brahmādi(6) viṣṇvantādi viśuddhaye /
vidhāya pūrvavatsarvaṃ homasaṅkhyājapādikam //
96.d:
एवं संशोध्य ब्रह्मादि(6) विष्ण्वन्तादि विशुद्धये /
विधाय पूर्ववत्सर्वं होमसङ्ख्याजपादिकम् //
96.m: Having thus purified, beginning with Brahmā, for the complete purification up to Viṣṇu, / performing everything as before, including recitation corresponding to the number of fire oblations,

96.s:
kuśamadhyāgrayogena liṅgamadhyāgrakaṃ spṛśet /
yathā yathā ca sandhānaṃ tadidānīmihocyate //
oṃ hāṃ haṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ eṃ oṃ bhūṃ bhūṃ vāhyamūrtaye
namaḥ(7)
:n
1 evaṃ vidhāyetyādiḥ, pūrṇayā saha homayedityantaḥ
saptaślokātmakaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti
2 mūrtipāṃś ca kareṇukān iti gha.. , ṅa.. ca
3 brahmabhiraṃśaiśceti kha.. , gha.. ca / brahmabhirajñaiśceti cha.. , ja..
ca
4 santarpya śaktikumbhāmbhaḥprokṣite iti ka.. /
santarpyaśāntikumbhasthaiḥ prokṣite iti ja.. / santarpya
śāntikumbhāmbhaḥ prokṣite iti gha..
5 sampūjyeti kha.. , cha.. ca
6 brahmādīniti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha ca
96.d:
कुशमध्याग्रयोगेन लिङ्गमध्याग्रकं स्पृशेत् /
यथा यथा च सन्धानं तदिदानीमिहोच्यते //
ओं हां हं ओं ओं ओं एं ओं भूं भूं वाह्यमूर्तये
नमः(7)
:न्
1 एवं विधायेत्यादिः, पूर्णया सह होमयेदित्यन्तः
सप्तश्लोकात्मकः पाठो ग.. पुस्तके नास्ति
2 मूर्तिपांश् च करेणुकान् इति घ.. , ङ.. च
3 ब्रह्मभिरंशैश्चेति ख.. , घ.. च / ब्रह्मभिरज्ञैश्चेति छ.. , ज..
च
4 सन्तर्प्य शक्तिकुम्भाम्भःप्रोक्षिते इति क.. /
सन्तर्प्यशान्तिकुम्भस्थैः प्रोक्षिते इति ज.. / सन्तर्प्य
शान्तिकुम्भाम्भः प्रोक्षिते इति घ..
5 सम्पूज्येति ख.. , छ.. च
6 ब्रह्मादीनिति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , छ च
96.m:
one should touch the middle and tip of the liṅga with the middle and tip of the kuśa grass. / And in whatever manner the unification is [performed], that is now stated here:
'Oṃ hāṃ haṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ eṃ oṃ bhūṃ bhūṃ, homage to the outer icon.'
[Footnotes]
1. The text consisting of seven verses beginning with 'evaṃ vidhāya' and ending with 'pūrṇayā saha homayet' is absent in manuscript ga.
2. 'mūrtipāṃś ca kareṇukān' in manuscripts gha and ṅa.
3. 'brahmabhiraṃśaiśca' in manuscripts kha and gha; 'brahmabhirajñaiśca' in manuscripts cha and ja.
4. 'santarpya śaktikumbhāmbhaḥprokṣite' in manuscript ka.
'santarpyaśāntikumbhasthaiḥ prokṣite' in manuscript ja; 'santarpya śāntikumbhāmbhaḥ prokṣite' in manuscript gha.
5. 'sampūjya' in manuscripts kha and cha.
6. 'brahmādīn' in manuscripts kha, ga, gha, and cha.

96.s:
7 oṃ hāṃ hāṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ bīṃ oṃ bhūṃ bhūṃ
vāstumūrtaye nama iti kha.. , cha.. ca / oṃ hāṃ oṃ hāṃ oṃ oṃ
vāṃ oṃ bhūṃ hāṃ vāṃ kṣmāmūrtaye nama iti ja.. / gha.. pustake
bhūṃ bhūṃ vāṃ iti viśeṣaḥ / oṃ hāṃ hāṃ oṃ oṃ
vāṃ oṃ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ vāhyamūrtaye nama iti ṅa..
:p 325
o hāṃ vāṃ āṃ oṃ āṃ ṣāṃ oṃ bhūṃ bhūṃ vā(1)
vahnimūrtaye namaḥ
96.d:
7 ओं हां हां ओं ओं ओं बीं ओं भूं भूं
वास्तुमूर्तये नम इति ख.. , छ.. च / ओं हां ओं हां ओं ओं
वां ओं भूं हां वां क्ष्मामूर्तये नम इति ज.. / घ.. पुस्तके
भूं भूं वां इति विशेषः / ओं हां हां ओं ओं
वां ओं ओं हूं हूं वाह्यमूर्तये नम इति ङ..
:प् 325
ओ हां वां आं ओं आं षां ओं भूं भूं वा(1)
वह्निमूर्तये नमः
96.m:
"7 oṃ hāṃ hāṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ bīṃ oṃ bhūṃ bhūṃ vāstumūrtaye namaḥ" thus in MSS kha and cha. / "oṃ hāṃ oṃ hāṃ oṃ oṃ vāṃ oṃ bhūṃ hāṃ vāṃ kṣmāmūrtaye namaḥ" thus in MS ja. / In manuscript gha: "bhūṃ bhūṃ vāṃ" is the variation. / "oṃ hāṃ hāṃ oṃ oṃ vāṃ oṃ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ vāhyamūrtaye namaḥ" thus in MS ṅa.
'Oṃ hāṃ vāṃ āṃ oṃ āṃ ṣāṃ oṃ bhūṃ bhūṃ vā, homage to the fire-icon.'

96.s:
evañca yajamānādimūrtibhirabhisandheyaṃ(2) /
pañcamūrtyātmakepyevaṃ sandhānaṃ hṛdayādibhiḥ //
96.d:
एवञ्च यजमानादिमूर्तिभिरभिसन्धेयं(2) /
पञ्चमूर्त्यात्मकेप्येवं सन्धानं हृदयादिभिः //
96.m: And thus unification is to be effected with the icons of the sacrificer and others; / so too, in that which consists of the five icons, unification [is effected] by means of the heart and other [mantras].

96.s:
mūlena svīyavījair vā jñeyantattvatrayātmake(3) /
śilāpiṇḍo vṛṣeṣvevaṃ pūrṇāchinnaṃ susaṃvaraiḥ(4) //
96.d:
मूलेन स्वीयवीजैर् वा ज्ञेयन्तत्त्वत्रयात्मके(3) /
शिलापिण्डो वृषेष्वेवं पूर्णाछिन्नं सुसंवरैः(4) //
96.m: By the root-mantra or by one's own seed-syllables, it is to be known in what consists of the three tattvas. / So too, the stone pedestal on the bulls, complete and uninterrupted, with good restraints.

96.s:
bhāgābhāgaviśuddhyarthaṃ homaṃ kuryācchatādikaṃ(5) /
nyūnādidoṣamoṣāya śivenāṣṭādhikaṃ śataṃ //
96.d:
भागाभागविशुद्ध्यर्थं होमं कुर्याच्छतादिकं(5) /
न्यूनादिदोषमोषाय शिवेनाष्टाधिकं शतं //
96.m: To purify the divided and undivided parts, one should perform a fire oblation of a hundred or more [offerings]; / to destroy faults such as deficiency and excess, one hundred and eight [oblations] with [the mantra of] Śiva.

96.s:
hutvātha(6) yat kṛtaṃ karma śivaśrotre(7) nivedayet /
etatsamanvitaṃ(8) karma tvacchaktau ca mayā prabho //
96.d:
हुत्वाथ(6) यत् कृतं कर्म शिवश्रोत्रे(7) निवेदयेत् /
एतत्समन्वितं(8) कर्म त्वच्छक्तौ च मया प्रभो //
96.m: Then, having offered oblations, he should announce into Śiva's ear the rite that was performed: / 'Accompanied by this rite, O Lord, and in your power, by me,

96.s:
oṃ namaḥ bhagavate rudrāya rudra namostu te(9)/
vidhipūrṇamapūrṇaṃ vā svaśaktyāpūrya(10) gṛhyatāṃ //
96.d:
ओं नमः भगवते रुद्राय रुद्र नमोस्तु ते(9)/
विधिपूर्णमपूर्णं वा स्वशक्त्यापूर्य(10) गृह्यतां //
96.m: Oṃ, homage to the Blessed Rudra! O Rudra, homage to you! / Whether complete according to the rule or incomplete, may it be accepted, having made it full by your own power.'

96.s:
oṃ hrīṃ(11) śāṅkari pūraya(12) svāhā iti piṇḍikāyāṃ /
atha liṅge nyasej jñānī kriyākhyaṃ pīṭhavigrahe //
96.d:
ओं ह्रीं(11) शाङ्करि पूरय(12) स्वाहा इति पिण्डिकायां /
अथ लिङ्गे न्यसेज् ज्ञानी क्रियाख्यं पीठविग्रहे //
96.m: 'Oṃ hrīṃ, O Śāṅkarī, make it full! Svāhā'—thus on the pedestal. / Then the wise man should deposit the body [named] Knowledge on the liṅga, and the body called Action on the pedestal.

96.s:
ādhārarūpiṇīṃ śaktiṃ nyased brahmaśilopari /
nibadhya(13) saptarātraṃ vā pañcarātraṃ trirātrakaṃ //

96.d:

निबध्य(13) सप्तरात्रं वा पञ्चरात्रं त्रिरात्रकं //

ङ..

96.m:
One should deposit the power that has the form of the base upon the foundation stone; / having bound [it] for seven nights, five nights, or three nights,

96.s:
ekarātramatho vāpi yadvā sadyodhivāsanaṃ(1) /
vinādhivāsanaṃ yāgaḥ kṛto 'pi phalapradaḥ //
96.d:
एकरात्रमथो वापि यद्वा सद्योधिवासनं(1) /
विनाधिवासनं यागः कृतो ऽपि फलप्रदः //
96.m: or else for one night, or indeed immediate preliminary consecration. / Even performed without preliminary consecration, the sacrifice yields its fruit.

96.s:
svamantraiḥ pratyahaṃ deyamāhutīnāṃ śataṃ śataṃ /
śivakumbhādipūjāñca digbilañca nivedayet //
96.d:
स्वमन्त्रैः प्रत्यहं देयमाहुतीनां शतं शतं /
शिवकुम्भादिपूजाञ्च दिग्बिलञ्च निवेदयेत् //
96.m: Every day one should offer a hundred oblations each with their own mantras, / and one should present worship to the pitcher of Śiva and the rest, and the cavity of the directions.

96.s:
gurvādisahito vāso(2) rātrau niyamapūrvakam /
adhivāsaḥ sa vasatevadherbhāvaḥ samīritaḥ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe adhivāsanavidhirnāma ṣaṇṇavatitamo
'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha saptanavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
śivapratiṣṭhākathanaṃ
96.d:
गुर्वादिसहितो वासो(2) रात्रौ नियमपूर्वकम् /
अधिवासः स वसतेवधेर्भावः समीरितः //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे अधिवासनविधिर्नाम षण्णवतितमो
ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ सप्तनवतितमो ऽध्यायः
शिवप्रतिष्ठाकथनं
96.m:
Residing at night accompanied by the guru and others, preceded by vows— / that is preliminary consecration (adhivāsa), declared from the verbal root vas ('to dwell') with the sense of [following] a rule.
Thus ends the ninety-sixth chapter, named 'The Rule of Preliminary Consecration,' in the great Purāṇa of Agni.
Now begins the ninety-seventh chapter:
The description of the consecration of Śiva.
